# Flow: US Stocks (`us-stocks`)

> One self-contained file for converting this flow to another platform. Read https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/CONVERT.md first. Design system: Lemonnade V3 @ `6de43c8` (components, tokens and rules: https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonnade-v3-docs/llms.txt).

Activate US Stocks, add money to the USD wallet, buy and sell, withdraw (teammate import, under review).

Prototype: https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/#/us-stocks · machine-readable: https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/us-stocks.json

- **Prototype:** `#/us-stocks` · single screen: `#/us-stocks-02` … `#/us-stocks-70` (`04` is gone — see Market; `01`, `08`–`12`, `16`–`19`, `29`, `30` are gone — see Home)
- **Figma:** file `8HEY699cTPiWiQeAVX3122` (every screen's node is in `registry.ts`)

### Screens

58 screens in 4 sections — the list (id, Figma node, name, what it shows) is `registry.ts`:

| Section | Screens | What |
|---|---|---|
| Entry points | `us-stocks-02`, `05`–`07` | Ways into US Stocks: S&P 500, Portfolio, MF (the Home entry is `stocks-09`; Search is the Search flow's US tab, `search-29`) |
| FTUX | `13`, `20`–`28`, `74`, `94`–`97` | Stock page (not activated; KYC not done), activation (declarations, bank), $0 wallet, add money (the Home screens of the flow are `stocks-11`…`18`) |
| Activated user | `31`–`52` | Stock page (no holdings / holding), buy (amount / shares / limit / SL / AMO / errors), results, sell |
| USD wallet | `53`–`70` | Wallet states, balance details, withdraw, withdrawal tracking |

### How the folder is put together

- `screens/<part>/` — his parts as he split them: `activation` (stock page + activation sheets), `entry`, `money`,
  `trade`, `wallet` (his `home` and `ftux` parts are gone — see Home). Each `index.tsx` maps Figma node ids to screens.
- `nav.tsx` — his screens navigate by Figma node id (`go('5837:95201')`); this maps them onto the app's screen ids and
  adds `back`.
- `components/Phone.tsx` — his screen frame (minus the status / navigation bar the preview draws); `UsMainNav` — the
  shared MainNav pointed at this flow's tabs.
- `data.ts` — the stock being viewed and logos, on top of the shared US data (`src/shared/data/usStocks.ts`: catalogue, `usLogo`, the viewed-stock store; logos in `src/shared/assets/us-logos`). Each part keeps its own sample data in its folder.
- `asset.ts` + `assets/` — his images, by the paths his code uses.

### Market

The Market tab is the app's own flow (`src/flows/market`), not his redraw: it has an IND / US picker next to its tabs.
His E3 frame (`5796:88869`) maps to `market-10` (US list, S&P 500 filter) in `nav.tsx`; the navbar's Market tab and the
home's "View all" land there. A US row opens `us-stocks-31` (stock page, activated, no holdings) for that stock.

### Home

Home (the Stocks tab, IND and US) is the app's own Stocks flow (`src/flows/stocks`), not his redraw. The IND / US tabs
and every US activation state are there as `stocks-09`…`stocks-18` (US tab: activate, risk disclosure, under review,
failed, activated · add money, money ready, activated · holding; plus the intro sheet `stocks-11` and the "activation
submitted" sheet `stocks-18`). His frames map to them in `nav.tsx` (`FIGMA_IN_OTHER_FLOWS`): `5796:91576` / `5756:74756`
→ `stocks-09`, `5714:64982` → `stocks-01`, `5714:65691` / `5740:67333` → `stocks-02`, `5756:68986` → `stocks-11`,
`5756:75539` → `stocks-13`, `5776:81034` → `stocks-14`, `5776:81870` → `stocks-15`, `5796:87332` → `stocks-16`,
`5826:92885` → `stocks-17`, `5756:73797` → `stocks-18`. From Home, a US stock opens `us-stocks-13` (not activated) or
`us-stocks-31` / `32` (activated); the Home's wallet icon opens the wallet screens (`53`, `55`, `56`, `20`, `59`).

### User status

Two screens follow the app-level User status (`src/shared/userStatus.ts`, read through `useUsJourney()`), not a flow option:

- `us-stocks-13` "S03 · Stock page" shows the stock for the user's status: KYC pending (Complete KYC), not activated
  (Activate), activated, or holding NVDA.
- `us-stocks-54` "W0 · Wallet · US tab" shows the USD wallet for the status: $0, money on the way, or has money.

`us-stocks-74`, `31`, `32`, `55`, `56`, `57`, `58`, `59` are `hidden: true` in `registry.ts`: still routes (taps and
other flows land on them) but not listed in the preview. `FlowScreen.hidden` is in `src/flows/types.ts`; the list uses
`listed()` in `src/preview/screenTree.ts`.

### Add money (`us-stocks-21`…`26`, `screens/money/AddMoneyScreen.tsx`)

Groww-style $ entry (user's 3 Nov ask; reference `references/2026-11-03/wallet/1-us-add-money-keypad.png`). The user types
**US dollars**, what they want in the wallet; the ₹ it costs is the line under the amount.

- Top: L3 Actionbar "Add money", back → wallet; description "$0.00 available" (the wallet balance, left-aligned).
- Body: the shared `AmountEntry` (`src/shared/ui/AmountEntry`): big centred `$` amount with a caret, empty = grey `$0`;
  under it "You pay ≈ ₹X · incl. charges", a Tertiary Small button that opens the charges breakdown sheet; under that the
  quick-add chips +$50 / +$100 / +$500 (they add to the amount).
- Dock (`AmountDock`): a "Net Banking (Remittance) · HDFC Bank ••1861" ListCell between hairlines (no bank change in this
  flow, so no "Change"), the app's number keypad with "." (up to 2 decimals, 7 whole digits), and a Large primary
  "Add $X" button, disabled while the amount is empty, invalid or the bank name mismatches.
- Limits: minimum $50 (`MIN_DEPOSIT_USD`; red "Minimum $50" under the amount when below), maximum $2,50,000 a year under
  LRS (`LRS_LIMIT_USD`; red "Maximum $250,000 per financial year under LRS"). An empty amount shows "Minimum $50" in grey.
- ₹ maths (`money/amounts.ts`): `inr = inrForUsd(usd, rate)` is the exact inverse of `depositBreakdown(inr, rate).lands`
  (rate = live + ₹1.43; partner fee $1.18; GST on the conversion charge). The "≈ ₹X" is that, rounded up to whole rupees.
  The sheet (`ChargesBreakdownSheet`) shows the same ₹ and its breakdown; "Lands in your US wallet" = the typed $.
- Amounts on this screen are plain `$` (`formatUsd`), not the app's "₹ equivalent" setting: the entry is in $ and the ₹ line
  is always there, because paying is in ₹, so a second ≈ ₹ (or a ₹ switch) would only repeat or contradict it.
- Next: "Add $X" → the bank page directly → wallet (no "pay on your bank's page" sheet; M08 was removed 3 Nov). Back on
  the bank page keeps the typed $.
- States (same Figma nodes as before): M01 `5776:84630` $1,000 · M02 `5776:85779` charges sheet open · M03 `5776:84513`
  below minimum, prefilled "20" · M07 `5796:86175` above LRS, prefilled 300000 · M05 `5796:86009` bank name mismatch
  (Aerobar, button disabled). (M08 `5776:84258`, the pay-on-bank sheet, is dropped: Add $X opens the bank's page.)
- Copy: `copy.json` (`addMoney.*`), read with `t()` from `screens/money/copy.ts`.

**Differences from Figma:** M01 had a ₹ TextField with min / max helper text, a "US Wallet Balance" card, ₹ chips
(+5,000…) and a bank strip + timing note in the dock; here the amount is typed in $ on an in-app keypad, the balance moves to
the Actionbar description, the chips are +$, the bank is a ListCell and the timing note is dropped. M03 / M07 keep their
meaning (below minimum / above LRS) with $ limits; the ₹ limits in the Figma helper text are gone.

**L3 gaps:** no big amount input and no in-app number keypad (both drawn in `AmountEntry`, on L3 tokens, flagged there);
quick-add chips are L3 Tabs (pill, action) used as buttons.

### Portfolio (`us-stocks-05`, `06`, `77`, `screens/entry/PortfolioScreen.tsx`)

- `PortfolioScreen` is the frame only: Actionbar (search, wallet) with the Positions · Holdings · Orders tabs in its
  bottom slot, swiping between tabs, the navbar, and the Sort sheet (screen level, in `Phone`'s overlay).
- Each tab is its own page in `screens/entry/portfolio/`: `PortfolioPage` gives the grey top and the white sheet under
  it (rounded top; Orders' is square). `PositionsTab` (Market Indices rail, Your positions + Refresh, empty state →
  F&O), `HoldingsTab` (summary cards rail, IN / US tabs, Your holdings + Sort, the list or the US empty state for the
  user status), `HoldingCard` (one holding: logo, name, qty, 1D; Current · Invested · Returns). Laid out with L3
  Stack / Section / Inset / Grid; strings in `copy.json` under `portfolio.*`.
- Differences from Figma (L3 wins): Sort and Refresh are L3 Ghost Small buttons (Label/12, primary text — Figma: blue
  Label/14). A US holding is a clickable L3 Card (raised, opens its stock page); Indian ones are static Cards, and every holding card has L3's soft shadow `--l3-shadow-elevation-soft` (from L3 on the clickable US cards; added locally on the static Indian ones — L3 gap: no shadow option on a static Card). The index
  cards' width comes from the shared Rail (1.85 visible). Orders' sheet ends 16 below its content (was 24).

### Orders & Positions (`screens/orders/`, Portfolio's Orders and Positions tabs)

Layout from the F&O dev-handoff file's "Positions & orders" (Figma `nLs24dTJdPz9A5pu3AWMbe`, `6754:65598`), drawn there
for commodities; US content here. The data contract is `screens/orders/data.ts`: an order has one status, and its list,
tags, timeline and dock follow from it.

- **Orders tab (USD side):** Open (n) · History (n) (no SIP for US), "All orders ⇕" picker (All / Stocks / ETFs),
  Filters sheet (Side, Order type, and Status on History) with a count badge. Card: "Limit · Day", status + Buy/Sell
  tags, logo + symbol, Qty (filled/qty while partly filled), LTP (live) and At limit / Trigger / Mkt / Avg. Empty
  states for no orders, a narrowed picker and filters that match nothing. Sample orders show for the "holding" user
  status only.
- **Statuses:** Open list — open, queued (placed while the US market is closed), partly filled. History — executed,
  partly executed (rest cancelled at the close), failed, cancelled, expired (Day order not filled by the close).
- **Order Details (`us-stocks-79`, and one preview screen per status `us-stocks-81`…`90`):** asset row (→ stock / ETF
  page), status line with filled/qty shares, the reason (Aerobar) for failed / cancelled / expired / partly executed,
  details (KeyValueList), Order status timeline (L3 Steps). Dock: Cancel order + Modify (open, queued, partly filled;
  Cancel asks in a sheet first), Repeat order (executed), Retry (failed), Place again (cancelled, expired).
- **Positions tab:** Indian Stocks / US Stocks tabs as on Holdings. US positions are today's trades before they settle
  into Holdings (T+1): Today's returns (unrealised / realised) and position cards. Empty state for an activated user
  with no trades today.
- **Position Details (`us-stocks-80`):** header (shares, live LTP), Bought / Sold today block, Returns ⓘ (sheet on
  realised vs unrealised). Dock: Buy more + Exit position for a buy; Buy again for a sell.
- **Sample story (data.ts):** every sell is of shares the user holds — the one US holding is 12 NVDA (13 bought
  27 Oct + 5 of 8 on 28 Oct, minus 6 sold today by the partly filled sell). Today's executed AMD and VTI buys and that
  NVDA sale are the Positions (prices inside today's live range). Times are IST: the US market runs 8:00 PM – 2:30 AM
  since US daylight time ended on 1 Nov, 7:00 PM – 1:30 AM before.
- **Back:** Order Details goes back to Portfolio on Orders, USD side (`us-stocks-91`), Position Details to Portfolio
  on Positions, US Stocks (`us-stocks-92`); the Orders tab keeps its Open / History, picker and filters.
- **Differences from Figma (US Stocks rules):** no Intraday, Convert to delivery / intraday, tender-period margin,
  Target profit / Trailing SL or Manage TP/SL; Buy / Sell tags are profit / loss coloured (L3), not blue; done timeline
  steps show L3's green tick, not grey dots; cards are 16 apart (L3), not 12.
- **L3 gaps:** Steps has no tone (the current step's colour is overridden in CSS); no status-dot component; no
  destructive button for "Cancel order"; no text link with a badge (Filters is an action pill + Badge); sheet ListCell
  rows need a -16 inset to line up with section titles; PriceChange formats ₹ only (signed $ coloured by hand); no card
  with a grey title strip (Position Details uses a section header over a KeyValueList card); a clickable Card announces
  itself as a toggle (`aria-pressed`). No sell Limit / SL pad yet, so Modify / Retry on a sell open the plain sell pad.

### Activate US Stocks (`us-stocks-94`…`97`, `screens/activate/`)

Two bottom sheets, like the app's Terms & Conditions sheet, that open over the screen the user tapped Activate on (Home's
US tab, the FTUX sheet's Home, a stock page, the wallet …) — no new page. In the registry they are `over: 'us-stocks-13'`
screens (FlowScreen.over): the preview keeps the screen the user was on under the sheet, each step only swaps the sheet,
and closing (✕, scrim, drag, back) goes back to that screen (Preview.under). Opened straight from the screen list, they
sit over the stock page. Every Activate US Stocks / Retry (Home card, FTUX sheet, stock page, Portfolio's US empty states) opens
`us-stocks-94`. Not in Figma — built from the brief; they replace the risk disclosure sheet (removed).

**L3 gap:** IDFC FIRST Bank has no logo in `@l3/assets/company-logos`; its mark (cropped from the Wikimedia Commons
logo, 128 px) is kept in `screens/activate/assets/idfcfirstb.png` until L3 adds it.

- **94 · Declarations** — header "Agree to invest abroad", then two checkbox rows, the declaration written beside each
  box: LRS (resident, own money, $250,000 a year, allowed purposes) and US tax (Form W-8BEN: not a US person, 25% on
  dividends, report in your ITR). The scheme / form name is an inline link to the full text; the rest of the row is a
  label, so tapping anywhere on it ticks the box. "I agree and continue" (Large, full width) turns on once both are
  ticked → 95.
- **95 · Bank** — only ICICI, HDFC, Kotak, IDFC FIRST and Axis can send money abroad for us (`screens/activate/data.ts`).
  Their logos show only where the user has to add a bank (none supported, or "Add bank"), not over a list that already
  has an eligible bank.
  - A supported bank linked (User status → Bank accounts): every linked bank as a card row — supported ones with a Radio
    and an "Eligible" Tag (the first picked already), others greyed out with a disabled "Not supported" Tag (can't be
    picked); Verify and activate (always on) → 97. No consent checkbox. "Add bank" (Tertiary Small, the sheet header's
    trailing slot) swaps the sheet to "Add a supported bank": the five logos + Add bank account (→ `deposit-12`). No back
    arrow there (L3: the first sheet over a screen has none), so closing it closes the sheet.
  - None supported (or `us-stocks-96`): a card on top explains it ("<bank> can't send money abroad for US Stocks yet.
    Supported banks are ICICI, HDFC, Kotak, IDFC FIRST and Axis Bank. Add an account with one of them." + the five logos), then the user's own banks greyed out and tagged "Not
    supported", Add bank account (the
    Deposit flow's `deposit-12`, which comes back to 95) — no Not now: closing the sheet (back, scrim) returns to the stock page.
  - The user always has a bank (KYC adds one): with Bank accounts: None, the sheet shows the sample SBI account.
  - "Three (+ SBI)" and "SBI only" in User status → Bank accounts add a State Bank of India account to show both cases.
- **97 · Verifying** — the bank check as a loader sheet (we run it on the bank details we already have: no money sent,
  nothing for the user to do) (can't be closed); moves on by itself to activation submitted
  (`stocks-18`).

### Navigation

Every tap he wired is kept. The main path: FTUX sheet → Activate → Declarations → Bank (automatic check) → Under review → Approved → Add money
→ Pay on bank → Money ready → Stock → Buy → Executed → Wallet → Withdraw.

## Source — this flow

### `src/flows/us-stocks/FLAGS.md`

```md
# US Stocks import — what isn't our system yet

Teammate's prototype (`US-Stocks-Happy-Flow.html`, 2026-10-30) rebuilt from its compiled bundle into readable source on
branch `jojo`, **as he built it**. Nothing below is fixed: every item is marked `FLAG:` in the code (search the folder for
`FLAG`, ~650 marks) so we can decide one by one.

## Decide first (big calls)

1. **Screens that redraw existing app flows.** Indian Home redrew `src/flows/stocks`; Search
   (`screens/entry`) redraws `src/flows/search`; the order pad and results (`screens/trade`) overlap
   `src/flows/stocks`; Add money (`screens/money`) overlaps `src/flows/deposit`. Portfolio, Mutual Fund and the wallet have
   no flow in the app yet. → Keep his versions, or point these entry points at our flows and keep only the US-specific parts?
   **Decided for Home (2026-10-30):** the app's Stocks home is used (IND / US tabs, every US activation state =
   `stocks-09`…`18`); his `screens/home` and `screens/ftux` are deleted and `nav.tsx` maps his Home frames to them. His FTUX
   sheet look is kept (hand-made, marked `FLAG:`) in `src/flows/stocks/components/us/sheets/`.
   **Decided for Market (2026-10-30):** the app's own Market flow is kept and got an IND / US picker; his E3 screen
   (`5796:88869`) was removed and `nav.tsx` (`FIGMA_IN_OTHER_FLOWS`) sends that node to `market-10`. Home's "View all"
   hands Market what to open on through `src/shared/data/marketHandoff.ts`: Top Movers → US, its list (gainers / losers;
   Most Active / 52W have no Market list → All) + the cap picked on Home; Trillion Dollar Titans → mega caps, biggest
   first; a theme card → the US list. (His sessionStorage hand-off is gone.)
2. **Frame width 360, not 392.** His screens were designed at 360 × 800 (the app is 392 × 872). Fixed 360px widths remain in
   the FTUX sheet, the bank-app placeholder (360 × 815), the search keypad and the activation `.frame`.
3. **Own screen frame.** `components/Phone.tsx` is his frame (header · body · footer + his own sheet layer), not
   `src/shared/ui/Screen`. Sheets portal into it instead of the Screen's SheetHost.
4. **Copy isn't in `copy.json`.** All UI text is hard-coded in the screens (one flag per part).
5. **Keypads.** Search shows a **screenshot of a keyboard** (`assets/entry/keyboard.png`); Add money / Withdraw use a
   TextField on the device keyboard; the order pad uses a raw `<input>`. None use `src/shared/ui/Keyboard` or show the
   Typing state with our keypad.

## Hand-made controls (L3 has a component)

| What | Where | L3 instead |
|---|---|---|
| FTUX sheet + scrim + close button | `src/flows/stocks/components/us/sheets/UsFtuxSheet.tsx` (moved from `screens/ftux`) | BottomSheet (large header + icon) |
| Sort sheet radio rows | `screens/entry/sheets/SortSheet.tsx` | — (L3 has no radio: gap) |
| Activation sheets' own layer + hand-drawn gesture bar | `screens/activation/sheets/SheetFrame.tsx` | BottomSheet |
| Sheet grabbers drawn by hand in the `utility` slot | `screens/money/Money.module.css`, `wallet/sheets` | BottomSheet's own handle |
| Chips / pills / filter buttons | money (Tab used as chip) | Tag / Tabs (pill) / Button |
| Market tabs (SVG outline), underline tabs with sliding bar, tab "thumb" over Tabs | entry `SlidingTabs.tsx`, wallet `WalletScreen.tsx` | Tabs |
| Text / icon / round buttons | stock page tools | Button (Ghost / Tertiary) |
| Logo discs | stock page, entry `Primitives.tsx` | Avatar / BrandLogo |
| Hand-drawn price chart, bar chart, day-range meter, rating gauge, progress bars | stock page, entry `SpxChart.tsx` | Chart / ProgressBar |
| Cards, banners, carousels, pager dots | entry `HoldingsCards.tsx`, wallet `BalanceCard.tsx`, `PendingBanner.tsx` | Card (+ gaps for carousel / dots) |
| Success tick, result art | money `WithdrawPlacedScreen.tsx`, trade `OrderResult.tsx` | EmptyState-style art / L3 icon |
| L3 components restyled from outside (Tabs, Tag, Stepper, Select, Actionbar title) | stock page `.periods` / `.tags`, trade `OrderPad.module.css`, wallet, entry `OrdersTab` | use props, or an L3 change |

## Layout and values

- **Layout by hand:** `display:flex` + gap/padding everywhere (~500 rules) instead of `Stack` / `Section` / `Inset` /
  `Grid` — flagged once per file.
- **Raw px:** ~330 values that aren't 1px hairlines (flagged inline in the CSS).
- **Raw colours:** `#0000` / `#000` text tricks, logo plates `#000` / `#fff` (`data.ts`), coin art gradient (`wallet/CoinArt.module.css`), NVIDIA green `#76b900` (entry MF home).
- **Inline styles / inlined Material-symbol SVGs** as data URIs in each part's `icons.ts` (L3 Icon set instead).
- **sessionStorage** hand-offs between screens (market choice, mover filters, wallet flip, typed amounts).

## Assets

- US company logos are full-colour SVGs from TradingView (`npm run us:logos`; a PNG for the few without one) in `src/shared/assets/us-logos`, shared with the Market flow — L3 has Indian company logos only → **L3 gap**. The L3 Avatar's grey fill (meant for white marks) is hidden by these edge-to-edge logos; removing it from Avatar itself is a design-system change.
- The FTUX `flag.gif` was a 29 MB GIF → converted to `flag.webp` (4 MB, same animation; now in `src/flows/stocks/assets/us/ftux/`). `entry/portfolio/us-flag.gif`
  (2.9 MB) and `wallet-3d.gif` are still GIFs.
- 30 images are byte-identical duplicates under different names (e.g. the same logo in `entry/` and `activation/`).
- His Figma-screenshot fallbacks (`frames/*.png`, 72 files) were dropped — every screen is coded.

## His behaviour that's off (kept as is)

- Both Portfolio screens (E4, E4 live) look the same: his code never draws the US-market banner the registry describes.
- The three activation-state wallet frames (under review / failed / contact support) all show the $0 wallet.
- The "Your money is ready" toast passed `closable` to Aerobar — an option L3 doesn't have (not even on Lemonnade-v3
  main), so his L3 copy was patched. Here it just times out.
- ~~Sample rates disagree~~ — fixed 2026-11-02: every rate follows the live USD→INR rate (src/shared/money.tsx).
- `?link=1|2|3` URL switch in the wallet (an experiment of his).

## Code to tidy once decided (duplicates from the rebuild)

The rebuild ran per part, so a few helpers exist more than once: the mask-image helper (`MaskImg` / `MaskImage` /
`ImgIcon` in entry, money, activation), swipe-between-tabs (`entry/components/swipePages.ts`,
`wallet/lib/swipeTabs.ts`), sheet-close delay (`money/useSheetClose.ts`, `wallet/lib/useSheetClose.ts`), screen backdrop
(`activation/components/ScreenBackdrop.tsx`). Entry's copies are the originals.
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/ab-tests/leverage-tag.md`

```md
# A/B test: the leverage tag on leveraged ETF cards

Where: US Stocks → ETFs → **Leveraged** tab (us-stocks-71). In the prototype, every version is in the prototype
settings under **ETFs → Leverage tag** (flow option `levTag`).

## Versions

| | Version | What the card shows |
|---|---|---|
| V1 | Logo foot | "3x Long" pill across the bottom of the logo |
| V2 | Logo badge | "3x ▲" pill on the logo's top-right |
| V3 | Logo ring | Logo ringed green / red, "3x ▲" pill under it |
| V4 | Card corner | "3x Long" cut into the card's top-right corner |
| **V5** | **After heading (current, control)** | "Nasdaq 100 **[3x Long]**" — the tag right after the heading |
| V6 | Pill on foot | "3x ▲" pill under the logo, no ring |
| V7 | Slice | The logo's bottom is a green / red band, "3x ▲" in it |
| V8 | Notch | V6's pill, the logo's circle cut around it |

## Why not test all eight live

Eight arms split the traffic eight ways: each arm needs roughly 3,000–3,500 people who open the Leveraged tab, so
about 25,000–28,000 in all, and with seven comparisons against the control the false-positive risk climbs unless the
bar is raised further. The versions also differ in two ways at once (where the tag sits, and whether it says "Long" /
"Short" or only "▲" / "▼"). So it runs in two steps.

## Step 1 — comprehension pre-test (all eight, unmoderated, ~1 week)

The risk with leveraged funds is a user buying the short fund thinking it is the long one. Test that first, before
any traffic is spent.

- **Who:** 40–50 people per version (Lemonn users who have activated US Stocks, or a matching panel), each shown one
  version — 320–400 in all.
- **Task:** show the Leveraged list for 5 seconds, then ask: "If the Nasdaq 100 goes up today, which of these two goes
  up: the first or the second?" and "How many times the move?" Then a preference question across all eight.
- **Pass mark:** at least 90% answer the direction right. Drop any version below it.
- **Shortlist:** the two that pass with the best direction score (ties → faster answer), to take to Step 2 against V5.

Expect the "▲ / ▼ only" versions (V2, V3, V6, V7, V8) to need this check most: an arrow alone can read as "the price
went up today", not "this fund goes the same way".

## Step 2 — live A/B test (control + two, ~2–3 weeks)

**Hypothesis.** If the leverage tag sits where people look first on the card (the shortlisted version), then more
people who open the Leveraged tab will open a fund's page — and fewer will open the wrong side — because the leverage
and direction are read before the fund is chosen.

**Variants.** A: V5 After heading (control). B and C: the two from Step 1. Nothing else on the card or page changes.

**Primary metric.** Card tap-through: share of users who view the Leveraged tab and open at least one leveraged ETF
page in that session.

**Guardrails (must not get worse).**
- Wrong-side bounce: opens a fund page and goes back within 10 seconds, then opens its pair (e.g. SQQQ → back → TQQQ).
- Order reversal: a leveraged order cancelled, or the opposite side bought, within 15 minutes.
- Support contacts mentioning leveraged / short ETFs.

**Secondary.** Time from opening the tab to the first card tap; Go Long / Go Short taps on the fund page; scroll depth
on the tab.

**Sample size.** Assuming 20% of Leveraged-tab viewers open a fund today, to detect a 3-point lift (20% → 23%) at 95%
confidence and 80% power, with the 5% split across the two comparisons (2.5% each): about **3,600 users per arm,
~10,700 in all**. Replace the 20% with the real baseline from analytics before starting; a lower baseline needs more
users.

**Duration.** At least two full weeks (weekday and weekend use differ), and until every arm reaches its sample.
Users are randomised once and keep their version across sessions.

**Rules.** Write down the decision rule before starting: ship B or C only if it beats A on the primary metric and no
guardrail is worse. Don't stop early on a good result. Look at new vs returning users and Android vs iOS after the
overall result, not to pick a winner.

## If traffic is too low

If the Leveraged tab sees fewer than ~1,000 users a week, skip Step 2: ship the Step 1 winner and watch the
guardrails for a month instead.
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/asset.ts`

```ts
// The flow's images, by the path the imported screens use ('assets/trade/loading.svg'). Vite bundles every file under
// ./assets and hands back its URL.
const files = import.meta.glob('./assets/**/*', { eager: true, query: '?url', import: 'default' }) as Record<string, string>

/** URL of an imported image: asset('assets/trade/loading.svg'). */
export function asset(path: string): string {
  const key = './assets/' + path.replace(/^assets\//, '')
  const url = files[key]
  if (!url && import.meta.env.DEV) console.warn(`us-stocks: missing asset ${path}`)
  return url ?? ''
}

// The same SVGs as markup, for InlineSvg: drawn inline, their var(--l3-…) colours follow light / dark.
const svgs = import.meta.glob('./assets/**/*.svg', { eager: true, query: '?raw', import: 'default' }) as Record<string, string>

/** Markup of an imported SVG: svgMarkup('assets/entry/mf/tile.svg'). */
export function svgMarkup(path: string): string {
  const markup = svgs['./assets/' + path.replace(/^assets\//, '')]
  if (!markup && import.meta.env.DEV) console.warn(`us-stocks: missing svg ${path}`)
  return markup ?? ''
}
```

```tsx
// An SVG drawn inline instead of as an <img>, so the L3 colour tokens inside it (style="fill:var(--l3-…)") follow
// light / dark. For the flow's two-tone icons and art, which a single-colour MaskImg can't draw.
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react'
import { svgMarkup } from '../asset'
import styles from './InlineSvg.module.css'

export function InlineSvg({ src, w, h = w, className }: { src: string; w?: number; h?: number; className?: string }) {
  // FLAG: raw inline px size (the art's own Figma size), like MaskImg.
  const size: CSSProperties | undefined = w === undefined ? undefined : { width: w, height: h }
  return (
    <span
      className={[styles.svg, className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}
      style={size}
      aria-hidden="true"
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: svgMarkup(src) }}
    />
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/components/Phone.tsx`

```tsx
// The teammate's screen frame, imported as-is minus the device chrome: the app preview (src/preview/Mockup) already
// draws the OS status bar and navigation bar, so this keeps only header · scrolling body · footer, the backdrop art and
// the layer sheets portal into.
// FLAG: own screen frame — the app uses src/shared/ui/Screen (top · body · bottom · toast · sheet) for every screen.
import { createContext, useContext, useState, type CSSProperties, type ReactNode, type Ref } from 'react'
import styles from './Phone.module.css'

const SheetLayer = createContext<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
/** The element a sheet of this screen portals into (null until mounted). */
export const useSheetLayer = () => useContext(SheetLayer)

type Surface = 'default' | 'primary' | 'secondary'

export function Phone({
  header,
  children,
  footer,
  surface = 'default',
  statusbar,
  backdropArt,
  overlay,
  label,
  bodyRef,
  topLine,
  className,
  style,
}: {
  header?: ReactNode
  children?: ReactNode
  footer?: ReactNode
  surface?: Surface
  /** The status bar's colour in the original (the app's status bar samples what's under it instead). */
  statusbar?: Surface | 'transparent'
  /** Kept for the original's API; the app draws the OS navigation bar. */
  gesture?: Surface | 'transparent' | 'none'
  backdropArt?: ReactNode
  overlay?: ReactNode
  label?: string
  bodyRef?: Ref<HTMLDivElement>
  /** The top bar's line from the start (L3's own default), not only once the page has scrolled under it. */
  topLine?: boolean
  className?: string
  style?: CSSProperties
}) {
  const [layer, setLayer] = useState<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  // The top bar's line shows only once the page has scrolled under it.
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false)
  return (
    <SheetLayer.Provider value={layer}>
      <section className={[styles.phone, className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')} data-surface={surface} aria-label={label} style={style}>
        {/* data-part="page" + the footer last: on a tab switch the preview slides the page and holds the navbar still. */}
        <div className={styles.page} data-part="page">
          {layer && (
            <>
              {backdropArt && <div className={styles.art} aria-hidden="true">{backdropArt}</div>}
              <header className={styles.top} data-statusbar={statusbar ?? surface} data-scrolled={topLine || scrolled || undefined}>{header}</header>
              <div className={styles.body} ref={bodyRef} onScroll={(e) => setScrolled(e.currentTarget.scrollTop > 0)}>{children}</div>
              {overlay}
              {footer && <footer className={styles.footer} data-surface={surface === 'default' ? undefined : surface}>{footer}</footer>}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.sheets} ref={setLayer} />
      </section>
    </SheetLayer.Provider>
  )
}
```

```tsx
// The bottom navbar on the imported screens: the app's shared MainNav with the app's own tab targets — the navbar is the

import { usePreview } from '../../../shared/prototype'
import { MainNav, goToTab, type Section } from '../../../shared/ui/MainNav'

export function UsMainNav({ value }: { value: Section }) {

  return <MainNav value={value} onChange={(next) => next !== value && goToTab(go, next)} />
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/data.ts`

```ts
// US stocks sample data shared by the imported screens: the catalogue, the stock being looked at, and logos.
// FLAG: US logos are PNG/SVG files in ./assets — L3 has company logos for Indian stocks only (@l3/assets/company-logos).
import { companyLogo } from '@l3/assets/company-logos'
import { asset } from './asset'
import { catalogue, usLogo, usLogoPlate, viewedUsStock, viewUsStock, type UsStock } from '../../shared/data/usStocks'

export type { UsStock }
export { catalogue }

const aliases: Record<string, string> = { GOGL: 'GOOGL' }

/** NVIDIA — the stock the flow is designed around. */
// Price and day change are read from the catalogue each time, so they follow the runtime refresh of the US snapshot.
export const NVDA: UsStock = {
  sym: 'NVDA',
  ...catalogue.NVDA,
  get price() { return catalogue.NVDA.price },
  get change() { return catalogue.NVDA.change },
  logo: 'assets/activation/nvda-logo.svg',
}

// The symbol of the stock being viewed lives in the shared store (the Market tab sets it too); `current` keeps the
// details a list row passed along (its price / name strings) for that same symbol.
/** The sample US holding (user status "holding"): 12 NVDA bought at $172.50. Its value follows the live price.
 * The stock page's Your Holdings and Portfolio's Holdings both read it, so they always agree. */
export const NVDA_HOLDING = { qty: 12, avg: 172.5 }

let current: UsStock = NVDA
/** The stock page / order pad's stock: the one tapped last (here or on the Market tab). */
export const currentStock = (): UsStock => {
  const sym = viewedUsStock()
  if (!sym || sym === current.sym) return current
  return stockFor(sym)
}
export const resetStock = () => { current = NVDA; viewUsStock(NVDA.sym) }

/** A stock by symbol: the catalogue's (real, snapshot) data, or made-up but stable numbers for symbols not in it. */
export function stockFor(symbol: string, extra: Partial<UsStock> = {}): UsStock {
  const sym = aliases[symbol] ?? symbol
  if (sym === 'NVDA') return { ...NVDA, ...(extra.logo ? { logo: extra.logo, plate: extra.plate } : {}) }
  const known = catalogue[sym]
  const seed = [...sym].reduce((n, c) => n * 31 + c.charCodeAt(0), 7) % 9000
  return {
    sym,
    name: known?.name ?? extra.name ?? sym,
    price: known?.price ?? 20 + seed / 20,
    change: known?.change ?? ((seed % 400) - 200) / 100,
    exchange: known?.exchange ?? 'NASDAQ',
    ...extra,
    ...(known ? { name: known.name } : {}),
  }
}

/** A stock from a list row's display strings ('$188.42', '1.24%', up). */
export function stockFromRow(row: { sym: string; name?: string; price?: string; change?: string; up?: boolean; logo?: string; plate?: string }): UsStock {
  const num = (s?: string) => (s ? Number(s.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')) : undefined)
  const extra: Partial<UsStock> = { logo: row.logo, plate: row.plate }
  if (row.name) extra.name = row.name
  const price = num(row.price)
  const change = num(row.change)
  // A stock in the snapshot keeps its real price; the row's strings only fill in for one that isn't.
  const known = catalogue[aliases[row.sym] ?? row.sym]
  if (price && !known) extra.price = price
  if (change !== undefined && !known) extra.change = row.up === false ? -change : change
  return stockFor(row.sym, extra)
}

// The stock page follows the app's User status (src/shared/userStatus.ts), so every opener goes to the one status page.
// (Was: where the stock page opens from decides its variant.) Home is now the Stocks flow's (src/flows/stocks): its screens
// open the page themselves (not activated → `STOCK_PAGE.notActivated`; the activated page → no holdings, or holding
// NVDA), so `openStock` only has to cover the screens of this flow.
const STOCK_PAGE = { notActivated: '5826:93627', noHoldings: '5826:94125', holding: '5837:94648' }

/** Open a stock's page from a screen of this flow (search, portfolio …): the status-following page (us-stocks-13). */
export function openStock(go: (figma: string) => void, stock: UsStock) {
  current = stock
  viewUsStock(stock.sym)
  go(STOCK_PAGE.notActivated)
}

// Indian companies listed in the US as ADRs (ETF holdings): their logo is the design system's NSE one.
const ADR_NSE: Record<string, string> = { HDB: 'HDFCBANK', IBN: 'ICICIBANK', INFY: 'INFY' }

/** The logo of a US company (PNG), an Indian ADR's NSE logo, or undefined (show initials). */
export const logoFor = (sym: string) => usLogo(sym) ?? (ADR_NSE[sym] ? companyLogo(ADR_NSE[sym]) : undefined)

const ON_BLACK = new Set('BA DIS IRBT NKE SNBR SONO UBER UNH V'.split(' '))
/** Plate behind a logo: L3 static black or white (the same in light and dark, like the logo). */
export const plateFor = (sym: string) => (ON_BLACK.has(sym) ? 'var(--l3-static-black)' : 'var(--l3-static-white)')

/** The plate a holding's logo needs inside an Avatar ('white' / 'black'), or undefined — shared/data/usStocks. */
export const logoPlate = usLogoPlate

const US_HOME_LOGOS: Record<string, string> = {
  TSLA: 'assets/entry/ushome/tsla.png', GOGL: 'assets/entry/ushome/googl.svg', GOOGL: 'assets/entry/ushome/googl.svg',
  AAPL: 'assets/entry/ushome/aapl.svg', MSFT: 'assets/entry/ushome/msft.svg', NVDA: 'assets/entry/ushome/nvda.svg',
  META: 'assets/entry/ushome/meta.png', AMZN: 'assets/entry/ushome/amzn.svg', NFLX: 'assets/entry/ushome/nflx.png',
}
/** The larger logos the US home uses. */
export const homeLogoFor = (sym: string) => (US_HOME_LOGOS[sym] ? asset(US_HOME_LOGOS[sym]) : undefined)

const FULL_BLEED = new Set('AVGO BYND CAVA CROX EB GM GPRO MSFT SBUX TGT'.split(' '))
/** Logos that fill their circle (no plate padding). */
export const isFullBleedLogo = (sym: string) => FULL_BLEED.has(sym)
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/nav.tsx`

```tsx
// Navigation for the imported screens. The teammate's screens move by Figma node id (go('5837:95201')) and can go back;
// this maps those calls onto the app prototype's `go` (screen ids 'us-stocks-NN', see registry.ts).
import { createContext, useContext, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { markMove, usePreview } from '../../shared/prototype'
import type { Go } from '../types'
import { idForFigma } from './registry'

/**
 * Figma frames of the imported flow that now live in another flow of the app (screen ids there). The imported screens
 * still call go('5796:88869'); it lands on the app's own screen.
 */
export const FIGMA_IN_OTHER_FLOWS: Record<string, string> = {
  '5796:88869': 'market-10', // E3 · Market tab · S&P 500 filter → Market flow, US list with the S&P 500 filter
  // Home (Stocks tab, IND / US) is the app's own Stocks flow (src/flows/stocks), in every US activation state.
  '5796:91576': 'stocks-09', // Home · US tab · Entry points
  '5796:89230': 'search-29', // E2a · Search · US tab · idle (the Search flow's US tab)
  '5714:64982': 'stocks-01', // Home · IND tab · FTUX closed
  '5714:65691': 'stocks-02', // Home · Scrolled down
  '5740:67333': 'stocks-02', // Home · Scrolled down then up
  '5756:74756': 'stocks-09', // Home · US tab · Activate US Stocks card
  '9001:11': 'stocks-21', // Home · US tab · KYC not done (not in Jojo's Figma)
  '5756:68986': 'stocks-11', // Home · FTUX sheet · US Stocks intro
  '5756:75539': 'stocks-13', // A00 · Home · Activation under review
  '5776:81034': 'stocks-14', // A00 · Home · Activation failed
  '5776:81870': 'stocks-15', // A00 · Home · Activated · Add money
  '5776:80202': 'stocks-19', // A00 · Home · Under review · Contact Support
  '5796:86490': 'stocks-20', // A00 · Home · Money on the way
  '5796:87332': 'stocks-16', // A00 · Home · Money ready
  '5826:92885': 'stocks-17', // Home · US tab · Activated · full page
  '5756:73797': 'stocks-18', // Activation submitted · under review sheet (over the under-review Home)
}

export type UsNav = {
  /** Go to a screen by its Figma node id. */
  go: (figma: string) => void
  /** Open a page on top of this one (pushes in from the right), even one listed earlier in the flow (Deposit → Add money). */
  open: (figma: string) => void
  /** Back to the screen shown before this one (or `fallback`). */
  back: (fallback?: string) => void
  /** Figma node id of the screen being shown. */
  current: string
  /** Figma node id of the screen shown before. */
  prev?: string
  /** How this screen was reached — the original preview's 'jump' (picked in the list) vs a tap. */
  via: 'jump' | 'tap'
}

const UsNavContext = createContext<UsNav>({ go: () => {}, open: () => {}, back: () => {}, current: '', via: 'jump' })
export const useUsNav = () => useContext(UsNavContext)

// Screens shown in this flow, oldest first (Figma ids) — what `back` walks.
const history: string[] = []

export function UsNavProvider({ figma, go, children }: { figma: string; go: Go; children: ReactNode }) {
  const preview = usePreview()
  if (history[history.length - 1] !== figma) {
    const at = history.lastIndexOf(figma)
    if (at >= 0) history.splice(at + 1)
    else history.push(figma)
  }
  const prev = history.length > 1 ? history[history.length - 2] : undefined
  const screenOf = (f: string) => FIGMA_IN_OTHER_FLOWS[f] ?? idForFigma.get(f) ?? f
  const to = (f: string) => go(screenOf(f))
  const value: UsNav = {
    go: to,
    open: (f) => { markMove(screenOf(f), 'forward'); to(f) },
    // Back = the screen shown before in the app (the preview's history spans flows, e.g. back to the Stocks home);
    // a screen opened straight from the list goes to `fallback`.
    back: (fallback) => {
      if (preview.back?.()) return
      // Nothing to go back to: the fallback replaces this page, sliding in from the left (so its own back doesn't return here).
      const target = fallback ?? prev
      if (target) { markMove(screenOf(target), 'back'); to(target) }
    },
    current: figma,
    prev,
    via: prev ? 'tap' : 'jump',
  }
  return <UsNavContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</UsNavContext.Provider>
}
```

```css
/* US Stocks activation pages: layout is L3 Section / Stack; only text styles and what those blocks don't cover. */

.fine {
  margin: 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-description-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

.fineCentre {
  text-align: center;
}

/* A declaration in a sheet: its checkbox, and the text beside it (the scheme / form name is a link). */
.declaration {
  display: block;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.declaration > * > :first-child {
  flex: none;
}

.declarationText {
  display: block;
  font: var(--l3-text-description-14);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

/* FLAG: inline text link — L3 Button has no inline link variant. */
.inlineLink {
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  font: inherit;
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-discover-default);
  text-decoration: underline;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* A supported bank's short name under its logo (no-supported-bank sheet). */
/* A linked bank US Stocks can't use: the row greyed out (its Tag says why). FLAG: ListCell has no disabled state. */
.unsupported {
  opacity: var(--l3-opacity-60);
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/activate/ActivateSheet.tsx`

```tsx
// The frame of every Activate US Stocks step: an L3 BottomSheet over the screen the user tapped "Activate US Stocks" on
// (Home, a stock page, the wallet …). The steps are `over` screens in the registry: the preview keeps that screen under
// the sheet, and moving between steps only swaps the sheet. Closing it (✕, scrim, drag, back) goes back to that screen.
// Drawn on its own (the board, or as another screen's backdrop) it sits over the stock page.
// FLAG: own sheet layer (activation/Activation.module.css .frame / .sheets) — the screens under it have no `sheet` slot.
import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { BottomSheet } from '@l3/components/BottomSheet'
import { usePreview } from '../../../../shared/prototype'
import { ScreenBackdrop } from '../activation/components/ScreenBackdrop'
import { STOCK_NOT_ACTIVATED } from '../activation/ids'
import frame from '../activation/sheets/Activation.module.css'

/** How long the sheet takes to slide away before the stock page comes back (≈ L3 motion/duration-medium). */
const CLOSE_MS = 250

type ActivateSheetProps = {
  /** Drawn behind another screen: only the stock page. */
  backdrop?: boolean
  header: ReactNode
  /** The heading's id (BottomSheetHeader `headingId`). */
  labelledBy: string
  footer?: ReactNode
  /** `false`: can't be closed (the bank check running). */
  dismissible?: boolean
  children?: ReactNode
}

export function ActivateSheet({ backdrop, header, labelledBy, footer, dismissible = true, children }: ActivateSheetProps) {
  const { go, under } = usePreview()
  const [layer, setLayer] = useState<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(true)
  if (backdrop) return <ScreenBackdrop id={STOCK_NOT_ACTIVATED} />
  // In the prototype the screen under the sheet is the one the user was on (Preview.under); on its own, the stock page.
  const close = () => {
    if (!dismissible) return
    setOpen(false)
    window.setTimeout(() => go(under ?? 'us-stocks-13'), CLOSE_MS)
  }
  return (
    <div className={frame.frame}>
      {!under && <ScreenBackdrop id={STOCK_NOT_ACTIVATED} />}
      <div className={frame.sheets} ref={setLayer} />
      {layer && (
        <BottomSheet open={open} onClose={close} container={layer} aria-labelledby={labelledBy} header={header} footer={footer}>
          {children}
        </BottomSheet>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/activate/BankCheckScreen.tsx`

```tsx
// us-stocks-95 / 96 / 97 · Activate US Stocks, step 2: the bank money for US Stocks will go from, as a bottom sheet over
// the stock page (swapped in for the declarations sheet). Only ICICI, HDFC, Kotak, IDFC FIRST and Axis can send it (LRS
// partners), so there are two cases (User status → Bank accounts picks which):
// - At least one of the user's banks is supported: every linked bank is listed — the supported ones as radio rows tagged
//   "Eligible" (the first picked already), the others greyed out and tagged "Not supported" (can't be picked). Verify and
//   activate → we check the bank on our side (us-stocks-97, nothing for the user to do) → activation submitted. "Add bank" sits in the sheet's header: it swaps
//   the sheet to the five supported banks' logos and Add bank account (no back arrow: L3 gives the first sheet over a
//   screen none, so closing it closes the sheet).
// - None is (us-stocks-96): a card on top says why — their bank can't send money abroad, these five can (logos) — then
//   the user's own banks greyed out and tagged "Not supported", and Add bank account (the Deposit flow's, which comes
//   back here); closing the sheet (back, scrim) returns to the stock page. The user always has a bank (KYC adds one).
// The five supported banks' logos show only where the user has to add one (no supported bank, or "Add bank"), so the
// list stays simple when they already have one.
// Not in Jojo's Figma: built on 4 Nov from the brief.
import { useId, useState } from 'react'
import { Avatar } from '@l3/components/Avatar'
import { BottomSheetHeader } from '@l3/components/BottomSheet'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@l3/components/ButtonGroup'
import { Radio } from '@l3/components/Checkbox'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { ListCell } from '@l3/components/ListCell'
import { Loader } from '@l3/components/Loader'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { msAdd } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { getCompany } from '../../../../shared/data/companies'
import { otherBank, type LinkedBank } from '../../../../shared/data/user'
import { useAutoAdvance } from '../../../../shared/prototype'
import { supportedBanksLine, supportedOf } from '../../../../shared/data/usBanks'
import { bankLine } from '../../../../shared/ui/BankPicker'
import { SupportedBanks } from '../../../../shared/ui/SupportedBanks'
import { startAddBank, useLinkedBanks } from '../../../../shared/userStatus'
import { useUsNav } from '../../nav'
import { ActivateSheet } from './ActivateSheet'
import { t } from './copy'
import { ACTIVATE_BANK_SCREEN, ACTIVATE_VERIFYING, ACTIVATION_SUBMITTED, ADD_BANK } from './ids'
import styles from './Activate.module.css'

// The bank picked here, kept for the verifying sheet that follows (a screen of its own in the prototype).
let pickedBankId: string | undefined

/**
 * `none`: show the no-supported-bank case whatever the user status. `verifying`: the bank check runs and moves on to
 * activation submitted by itself.
 */
export function BankCheckScreen({ none = false, verifying = false, backdrop }: { none?: boolean; verifying?: boolean; backdrop?: boolean }) {
  const { go } = useUsNav()
  const headingId = useId()
  // KYC needs a bank account, so the user always has at least one: with none picked (or on us-stocks-96), they show the
  // sample account at a bank US Stocks can't use.
  const statusBanks = useLinkedBanks()
  const linked = none || statusBanks.length === 0 ? [otherBank] : statusBanks
  const supported = supportedOf(linked)
  const unsupported = linked.filter((b) => !supported.includes(b))
  const addBank = () => { startAddBank(ACTIVATE_BANK_SCREEN, { usStocks: true }); go(ADD_BANK) }

  const [picked, setPicked] = useState(() => supported.find((b) => b.id === pickedBankId)?.id ?? supported[0]?.id)
  // "Add bank" tapped: the sheet shows which banks can be added.
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false)

  if (supported.length === 0) {
    return (
      <ActivateSheet
        backdrop={backdrop}
        labelledBy={headingId}
        header={<BottomSheetHeader size="sm" heading={t('bankCheck.none.title')} headingId={headingId} description={t('bankCheck.none.description')} />}
        footer={
          <ButtonGroup aria-label={t('bankCheck.none.cta')}>
            <Button size="lg" fullWidth iconLeft={<Icon icon={msAdd} />} onClick={addBank}>{t('bankCheck.none.cta')}</Button>
          </ButtonGroup>
        }
      >
        <Stack gap="24">
          {/* Why: the user's bank can't be used, and which ones can. */}
          <Card surface="secondary">
            <Stack gap="16">
              <p className={styles.declarationText}>{t('bankCheck.none.why', { bank: unsupported[0].bank, banks: supportedBanksLine() })}</p>
              <SupportedBanks label={t('bankCheck.supportedLabel')} />
            </Stack>
          </Card>
          <Stack gap="08">
            <p className={styles.fine}>{t('bankCheck.none.yourBanks')}</p>
            {unsupported.map((bank) => <UnsupportedBankRow key={bank.id} bank={bank} />)}
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
      </ActivateSheet>
    )
  }

  const bank = supported.find((b) => b.id === picked) ?? supported[0]

  // us-stocks-97 · The bank check, run by us with the bank details we already have (no money sent). Can't be closed; moves on by itself.
  if (verifying) return <VerifyingSheet backdrop={backdrop} bank={bankLine(bank)} />

  if (adding) {
    return (
      <ActivateSheet
        backdrop={backdrop}
        labelledBy={headingId}
        header={<BottomSheetHeader size="sm" heading={t('bankCheck.add.title')} headingId={headingId} description={t('bankCheck.add.description')} />}
        footer={
          <ButtonGroup aria-label={t('bankCheck.none.cta')}>
            <Button size="lg" fullWidth iconLeft={<Icon icon={msAdd} />} onClick={addBank}>{t('bankCheck.none.cta')}</Button>
          </ButtonGroup>
        }
      >
        <SupportedBanks label={t('bankCheck.supportedLabel')} />
      </ActivateSheet>
    )
  }

  return (
    <ActivateSheet
      backdrop={backdrop}
      labelledBy={headingId}
      header={
        <BottomSheetHeader
          size="sm"
          heading={t('bankCheck.title')}
          headingId={headingId}
          description={t('bankCheck.description')}
          trailing={<Button variant="tertiary" size="sm" iconLeft={<Icon icon={msAdd} />} onClick={() => setAdding(true)}>{t('bankCheck.addAnother')}</Button>}
        />
      }
      footer={
        <ButtonGroup aria-label={t('bankCheck.actionsLabel')}>
          <Button size="lg" fullWidth onClick={() => { pickedBankId = bank.id; go(ACTIVATE_VERIFYING) }}>{t('bankCheck.cta')}</Button>
        </ButtonGroup>
      }
    >
      <Stack gap="08" aria-label={t('bankCheck.yourBanksLabel')}>
        {supported.map((b) => (
          <ListCell
            key={b.id}
            as="label"
            variant="card"
            selected={b.id === bank.id}
            iconLeft={<BankLogo bank={b} />}
            label={bankLine(b)}
            description={`${b.type} · ${b.branch}`}
            trailing={
              <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" gap="12">
                <Tag variant="secondary" color="success" size="sm">{t('bankCheck.eligible')}</Tag>
                <Radio name="activate-bank" checked={b.id === bank.id} onChange={() => setPicked(b.id)} />
              </Stack>
            }
          />
        ))}
        {unsupported.map((b) => <UnsupportedBankRow key={b.id} bank={b} />)}
      </Stack>
    </ActivateSheet>
  )
}

const BankLogo = ({ bank }: { bank: LinkedBank }) => (
  <Avatar src={getCompany(bank.logoSymbol)?.logoUrl} initials={bank.bank.slice(0, 2)} shape="rounded" size={32} label={bank.bank} />
)

/** A linked bank US Stocks money can't go from: its logo, greyed out, tagged "Not supported" — can't be picked. */
function UnsupportedBankRow({ bank }: { bank: LinkedBank }) {
  return (
    <ListCell
      variant="card"
      className={styles.unsupported}
      iconLeft={<BankLogo bank={bank} />}
      label={bankLine(bank)}
      description={`${bank.type} · ${bank.branch}`}
      trailing={<Tag size="sm" disabled>{t('bankCheck.notEligible')}</Tag>}
    />
  )
}

function VerifyingSheet({ bank, backdrop }: { bank: string; backdrop?: boolean }) {
  useAutoAdvance(backdrop ? undefined : ACTIVATION_SUBMITTED, 2200)
  const id = useId()
  return (
    <ActivateSheet
      backdrop={backdrop}
      labelledBy={id}
      dismissible={false}
      header={<BottomSheetHeader size="lg" headingId={id} icon={<Loader size="lg" label={null} />} heading={t('bankVerifying.title')} description={t('bankVerifying.description', { bank })} />}
    >
      <p className={`${styles.fine} ${styles.fineCentre}`}>{t('bankVerifying.fine')}</p>
    </ActivateSheet>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/activate/DeclarationsScreen.tsx`

```tsx
// us-stocks-94 · Activate US Stocks, step 1: the two declarations as a bottom sheet over the stock page, like the app's
// "agree to our Terms & Conditions" sheet — one checkbox each with the declaration written beside it: LRS (RBI's scheme
// for sending money abroad) and US tax (Form W-8BEN), the scheme / form as links to the full text. Not in Jojo's Figma:
// built on 4 Nov from the brief. "I agree and continue" turns on once both are ticked → the bank sheet (us-stocks-95).
import { useId, useState } from 'react'
import { BottomSheetHeader } from '@l3/components/BottomSheet'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@l3/components/ButtonGroup'
import { Checkbox } from '@l3/components/Checkbox'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { useUsNav } from '../../nav'
import { ActivateSheet } from './ActivateSheet'
import { t } from './copy'
import { ACTIVATE_BANK } from './ids'
import styles from './Activate.module.css'

const DECLARATIONS = ['lrs', 'tax'] as const
type DeclarationId = (typeof DECLARATIONS)[number]

export function DeclarationsScreen({ backdrop }: { backdrop?: boolean }) {
  const { go } = useUsNav()
  const headingId = useId()
  const [agreed, setAgreed] = useState<Record<DeclarationId, boolean>>({ lrs: false, tax: false })
  const allAgreed = DECLARATIONS.every((id) => agreed[id])
  return (
    <ActivateSheet
      backdrop={backdrop}
      labelledBy={headingId}
      header={<BottomSheetHeader size="sm" heading={t('declarations.title')} headingId={headingId} description={t('declarations.description')} />}
      footer={
        <ButtonGroup aria-label={t('declarations.actionsLabel')}>
          <Button size="lg" fullWidth disabled={!allAgreed} onClick={() => go(ACTIVATE_BANK)}>{t('declarations.cta')}</Button>
        </ButtonGroup>
      }
    >
      <Stack gap="24">
        {DECLARATIONS.map((id) => (
          // The whole row ticks the box (a label); the link opens the full text without ticking it.
          <label key={id} className={styles.declaration}>
            <Stack direction="horizontal" align="start" gap="12">
            <Checkbox checked={agreed[id]} onChange={(e) => setAgreed({ ...agreed, [id]: e.target.checked })} />
            <span className={styles.declarationText}>
              {t(`declarations.${id}.before`)}
              {/* The full scheme / form text (not in the prototype). */}
              <button type="button" className={styles.inlineLink} onClick={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>{t(`declarations.${id}.link`)}</button>
              {t(`declarations.${id}.after`)}
            </span>
            </Stack>
          </label>
        ))}
      </Stack>
    </ActivateSheet>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/activate/ids.ts`

```ts
// The US Stocks activation pages (not in Jojo's Figma: made on 4 Nov from the brief, in the KYC flow's patterns).
// Ids in the 9001: range like the other screens Figma doesn't have.
export const ACTIVATE_DECLARATIONS = '9001:60'
/** Bank verification, following "User status → Bank accounts": a supported bank linked → pick + automatic check; none → add one. */
export const ACTIVATE_BANK = '9001:61'
/** Bank verification with no supported bank linked, whatever the user status (to show that state in the list). */
export const ACTIVATE_BANK_NONE = '9001:62'
/** The bank check running over the bank page; moves on by itself. */
export const ACTIVATE_VERIFYING = '9001:63'

/** Activation submitted: the Stocks home's under-review US tab with its "activation under review" sheet. */
export const ACTIVATION_SUBMITTED = 'stocks-18'
/** Add bank account (the Deposit flow); it comes back here once the account is verified. */
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/activate/index.tsx`

```tsx
// Activate US Stocks: two bottom sheets over the stock page — the declarations (LRS, US tax), then the bank (pick a
// supported one, checked automatically, or add one). They replace the risk disclosure sheet (removed 4 Nov). Every "Activate US
// Stocks" / "Retry" goes here.
import type { UsScreenMap } from '../types'
import { BankCheckScreen } from './BankCheckScreen'
import { DeclarationsScreen } from './DeclarationsScreen'
import { ACTIVATE_BANK, ACTIVATE_BANK_NONE, ACTIVATE_DECLARATIONS, ACTIVATE_VERIFYING } from './ids'

export const screens: UsScreenMap = {
  [ACTIVATE_DECLARATIONS]: DeclarationsScreen,
  [ACTIVATE_BANK]: ({ backdrop }) => <BankCheckScreen backdrop={backdrop} />,
  [ACTIVATE_BANK_NONE]: ({ backdrop }) => <BankCheckScreen none backdrop={backdrop} />,
  [ACTIVATE_VERIFYING]: ({ backdrop }) => <BankCheckScreen verifying backdrop={backdrop} />,
}
```

```css
  place-items: center;
  display: grid;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.logoDisc img {
  object-fit: contain;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.changeAbs[data-down] {
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-down-default);
}

.events {
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-24) var(--l3-spacing-16);
}

.rateCard,
.fundGrid {
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-12);
  background: var(--l3-surface-default);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-light);
  margin: 0;
}

.rateCard {
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-16) var(--l3-spacing-12) var(--l3-spacing-12);
  flex-direction: column;
  display: flex;
}

.rateTop {
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-20);
  padding: 0 var(--l3-spacing-08);
  display: flex;
}

.rateCard .gauge {
  width: 72px; /* FLAG: raw px */
  height: 72px; /* FLAG: raw px */
}

.rateCard .ring {
  overflow: visible;
  rotate: 0deg;
}

.ringTrack {
  stroke: var(--l3-border-intense);
  stroke-width: 4px; /* FLAG: raw px */
}

.discTop {
  stop-color: var(--l3-surface-primary);
}

.discFoot {
  stop-color: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--l3-content-accent-success-default) 18%,
    var(--l3-surface-primary)
  );
}

/* One arc per rating (butt ends, gaps come from the dash lengths, as in the ETF Allocation donut). */
.ring .arc {
  fill: none;
  stroke-width: 5px; /* FLAG: raw px (svg units) */
  stroke-linecap: butt;
}

.ring .arc[data-tone='up'] {
  stroke: var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-up-default);
}

.ring .arc[data-tone='warning'] {
  stroke: var(--l3-surface-accent-warning-default);
}

.ring .arc[data-tone='down'] {
  stroke: var(--l3-surface-accent-indicator-down-default);
}

.rateCard .gauge strong,
.rateCard .gauge span {
  position: relative;
}

.rateCard .gauge strong {
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14);
}

.rateCard .gauge span {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
}

.rateCard .ratings {
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-16);
}

.rateCard .ratingRow {
  grid-template-columns: var(--l3-size-24) 1fr var(--l3-size-32);
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  display: grid;
}

.rateCard .ratingLabel {
  width: auto;
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

.rateCard .ratingValue {
  width: auto;
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  text-align: left;
}

.rateFoot {
  padding-top: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--l3-border-light);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
}

.rateSource {
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  display: inline-flex;
}

.fundGrid {
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  display: grid;
}

.fundGrid[data-columns="3"] {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.fundCell {
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
}

.fundCell dt {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
}

.fundCell dd {
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  margin: 0;
}

/* News & Events tab: toggle + events list + impact line (his newest prototype). */
.feed {
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-24);
  flex-direction: column;
  display: flex;
}

.news li,
.events li {
  align-items: stretch;
}

.why {
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-06);
  margin: var(--l3-spacing-04) 0 0;
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default);
  display: flex;
}

.why[data-down] {
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-down-default);
}

.why > span {
  font-size: 8px; /* FLAG: raw px, the ▲/▼ glyph size from his CSS */
}

.events {
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  flex-direction: column;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
}

.events li {
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  display: flex;
}

.events li > div {
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
}

.impact {
  margin-top: var(--l3-spacing-04);
  align-self: flex-start;
}

/* FLAG: hand-made date tile */
.eventDate {
  width: var(--l3-size-56);
  min-height: var(--l3-size-56);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-08);
  background: var(--l3-surface-primary);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-light);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: none;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
}

.eventDate b {
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

/* Related ETFs: a row of 160px cards that scrolls sideways. */
.etfs {
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  margin-inline: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-16));
  padding-inline: var(--l3-spacing-16);
  overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  display: flex;
  overflow-x: auto;
  /* Room for the cards' shadow: a sideways scroller clips vertically too, so it pads 12 above and below and takes it
     back with a negative margin (same layout, shadow not cut). */
  padding-block: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  margin-block: calc(-1 * var(--l3-spacing-12));
}

.etfs::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.etfs > * {
  flex: none;
  width: 160px; /* FLAG: raw px, card width from his CSS */
}

.etf {
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  padding: var(--l3-spacing-12);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-12);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--l3-border-light);
  flex-direction: column;
  display: flex;
}

.etfTop {
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  display: flex;
}

.etfTop b {
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-14);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
}

.etfSym {
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
}

.etfDisc {
  width: var(--l3-size-24);
  height: var(--l3-size-24);
  border-radius: var(--l3-radius-full);
  background: var(--l3-surface-secondary);
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  flex: none;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  display: flex;
}

.etfName {
  font: var(--l3-text-label-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-secondary);
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.etfPrice {
  gap: var(--l3-spacing-08);
  font: var(--l3-text-heading-12);
  color: var(--l3-content-primary);
  display: flex;
}

.etfPrice [data-change] {
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-down-default);
}

.etfPrice [data-change][data-up] {
  color: var(--l3-content-accent-indicator-up-default);
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/activation/StockPage.tsx`

```tsx
// The stock page in its three states: not activated (footer: Activate US Stocks), activated without holdings and
// holding (Buy / Sell footer, "Your Holdings" section). One component, `state` picks the variant; the data is the
// stock tapped last (currentStock()), scaled from the NVIDIA sample numbers.
// FLAG: copy not in copy.json yet (all UI text in this part is hard-coded).
// FLAG: price block, chart and period picker are hand-made (module CSS) instead of L3 Chart; see StockPage.module.css.
import { emailSupport } from '../../../../shared/support'
import { useEffect, useState, type CSSProperties } from 'react'
import { Actionbar, ActionbarAction } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@l3/components/ButtonGroup'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { PriceChange } from '@l3/components/PriceChange'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { Phone } from '../../components/Phone'
import { asset } from '../../asset'
import { currentStock } from '../../data'
import { useLiveQuote } from '../../../../shared/data/live'
import { usQuote } from '../../../../shared/data/usStocks'
import { Usd, formatInr, useUsd, useUsdInrRate } from '../../../../shared/money'
import { useUsNav } from '../../nav'
import { ImgIcon } from './components/ImgIcon'
import { NEWS, PERIODS, periodReturn, priceSeries, type NewsItem } from './data'
import { swapIcon } from './icons'
import {
  AboutCompany, AnalystRatings, DailyPerformance, Events, Financials, Fundamentals, HoldingsSection, KeyHolders, News, Peers, RelatedEtfs, stockDayStats,
} from './sections'
import {
  BUY_PAD, KYC_START, RISK_DISCLOSURE, SELL_PAD_HOLDING, SELL_PAD_NO_HOLDINGS,
} from './ids'
import { EtfMove } from '../etf/parts'
import styles from './StockPage.module.css'

/** kyc-pending: the user's Lemonn KYC isn't done, so US Stocks can't be activated yet (not in Jojo's Figma). */
export type StockState = 'kyc-pending' | 'not-activated' | 'review' | 'support' | 'failed' | 'no-holdings' | 'holding'

/** T03 · Buy · Empty US wallet (the trade part's id). */
const BUY_PAD_EMPTY_WALLET = '5837:96155'

/**
 * The footer of a stock / ETF page for a user who can't trade yet (KYC pending, not activated, under review, contact
 * support, failed); null once activated. Shared by the stock page and the ETF pages.
 */
export function activationFooter(state: StockState, go: (figma: string) => void) {
  const button =
    state === 'kyc-pending' ? <Button variant="primary" size="lg" fullWidth onClick={() => go(KYC_START)}>Complete KYC</Button>
    : state === 'not-activated' ? <Button variant="primary" size="lg" fullWidth onClick={() => go(RISK_DISCLOSURE)}>Activate US Stocks</Button>
    : state === 'review' ? <Button variant="primary" size="lg" fullWidth disabled>Activation under review</Button>
    : state === 'support' ? <Button variant="primary" size="lg" fullWidth onClick={() => emailSupport('US Stocks activation still under review')}>Contact support</Button>
    : state === 'failed' ? <Button variant="primary" size="lg" fullWidth onClick={() => go(RISK_DISCLOSURE)}>Retry activation</Button>
    : null
  if (!button) return null
  return <ButtonGroup aria-label="US Stocks" direction="horizontal" scrollIndicator>{button}</ButtonGroup>
}

export function StockPage({ state, backdrop, emptyWallet }: { state: StockState; backdrop?: boolean; emptyWallet?: boolean }) {
  const { go, back } = useUsNav()
  const usd = useUsd()
  const snapshotStock = currentStock()
  // The price ticks around its real (snapshot) level: live.ts.
  const live = useLiveQuote(snapshotStock.sym, snapshotStock.price, snapshotStock.change)
  const stock = { ...snapshotStock, price: live.price, change: live.changePct }
  const usdInr = useUsdInrRate()
  const quote = usQuote(stock.sym)
  const isNvda = stock.sym === 'NVDA'
  const shortName = isNvda ? 'NVIDIA' : stock.name.split(' ')[0]
  // The day's range is real (the snapshot) when it has one, else the NVDA sample scaled to this price.
  const scale = snapshotStock.price / 188.42
  const low = Math.min(quote?.dayLow ?? 185.9 * scale, stock.price)
  const high = Math.max(quote?.dayHigh ?? 189.6 * scale, stock.price)
  const dayChangeAbs = live.change
  const news: NewsItem[] = isNvda
    ? NEWS
    : [
        { ...NEWS[0], title: `${shortName} shares move as US markets open`, why: 'Buyers stepping in early' },
        { ...NEWS[1], title: `${shortName} faces tougher rules in a key market`, why: 'Could hurt sales there' },
        { ...NEWS[2], title: 'US stocks rally on fresh spending data', why: 'Lifts the whole market' },
        { ...NEWS[3], title: `What analysts expect from ${shortName} this quarter` },
      ]
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('overview')
  const [feed, setFeed] = useState('events')
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState('1D')
  // The period picker redraws the line, its axis and the change under the price (1D: the live day change).
  const periodPct = periodReturn(stock.sym, period, stock.change)
  const periodChangeAbs = period === '1D' ? dayChangeAbs : stock.price - stock.price / (1 + periodPct / 100)
  const series = priceSeries(stock.sym, period, stock.price, periodPct)
  const chartLow = Math.min(...series)
  const chartHigh = Math.max(...series)
  const yOf = (p: number) => ((chartHigh - p) / (chartHigh - chartLow || 1)) * 100
  const linePoints = series.map((p, i) => `${((i / (series.length - 1)) * 100).toFixed(2)},${yOf(p).toFixed(2)}`).join(' ')
  const yAxis = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => usd(chartHigh - ((chartHigh - chartLow) * i) / 7))
  const [body, setBody] = useState<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  // The Actionbar shows symbol + price once the big price has scrolled away.
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!body) return
    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(body.scrollTop > 64)
    onScroll()
    body.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => body.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  }, [body])

  const header = (
    <Actionbar
      onBack={() => back('stocks-01')}
      title={scrolled ? stock.name : undefined}
      description={scrolled ? <><Usd value={stock.price} layout="inline" /> <EtfMove change={stock.change} /></> : undefined}
      actions={<ActionbarAction icon={asset('assets/activation/watchlist.svg')} label={`Add ${stock.sym} to watchlist`} onClick={() => {}} />}
    />
  )

  const footer = activationFooter(state, go) ?? (
    <ButtonGroup aria-label={`Trade ${shortName}`} direction="horizontal" scrollIndicator>
      <Button variant="buy" size="lg" onClick={() => go(emptyWallet ? BUY_PAD_EMPTY_WALLET : BUY_PAD)}>Buy</Button>
      <Button variant="sell" size="lg" onClick={() => go(state === 'holding' ? SELL_PAD_HOLDING : SELL_PAD_NO_HOLDINGS)}>
        Sell
      </Button>
    </ButtonGroup>
  )

  return (
    <Phone label={stock.name} header={header} footer={footer} gesture="none" bodyRef={setBody} className={backdrop ? styles.still : undefined}>
      <div className={styles.assetHeader}>
        <div className={styles.titleRow}>
          <div className={styles.namePrice}>
            <h1 className={styles.name}>{stock.name}</h1>
            <div className={styles.priceRow}>
              <span className={styles.price}><Usd value={stock.price} layout="inline" /></span>
              <span className={styles.change}>
                <PriceChange value={periodPct} size="lg" />
                <span
                  className={styles.changeAbs}
                  data-down={periodChangeAbs < 0 || undefined}
                  aria-label={`${periodChangeAbs < 0 ? 'down' : 'up'} ${usd(Math.abs(periodChangeAbs))} over ${period}`}
                >
                  (<Usd value={periodChangeAbs} sign layout="inline" />) {period}
                </span>
              </span>
            </div>
            {/* The price in rupees at the live rate, always, small under the $ (no $ / ₹ switch on this page). */}
            <span className={styles.priceInr}>≈ {formatInr(stock.price * usdInr)}</span>
          </div>
          {isNvda ? (
            <img src={asset('assets/activation/nvda-logo.svg')} alt="" width={44} height={44} />
          ) : (
            <span
              className={styles.logoDisc}
              style={stock.plate ? ({ '--plate': stock.plate } as CSSProperties) : undefined}
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              {stock.logo ? <img src={/^(\/|https?:)/.test(stock.logo) ? stock.logo : asset(stock.logo)} alt="" /> : stock.sym[0]}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.tagsRow}>
          <div className={styles.tags}>
            <Tag variant="tertiary" color="neutral" size="md">Technology</Tag>
            <Tag variant="tertiary" color="neutral" size="md">Large Cap</Tag>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.chartActions}>
            <button type="button" className={styles.tradingView} aria-label="Open TradingView chart">
              <ImgIcon src="assets/activation/tradingview.svg" w={16} h={12} />
            </button>
            <button type="button" className={styles.exchange} aria-label={`Exchange: ${stock.exchange ?? 'NASDAQ'}`}>
              {stock.exchange ?? 'NASDAQ'}
              <Icon icon={swapIcon} size={16} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className={styles.chart} role="img" aria-label={`${shortName} price over ${period}, ${usd(chartLow)} to ${usd(chartHigh)}`}>
        <div className={styles.plot} data-down={periodPct < 0 || undefined}>
          <span className={styles.line} style={{ '--y': `${yOf(stock.price)}%` } as CSSProperties}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
              <polyline points={linePoints} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.5} vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" strokeLinejoin="round" />
            </svg>
            <span className={styles.halo} />
            <span className={styles.dot} />
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.yAxis} aria-hidden="true">
          {yAxis.map((p) => (
            <span key={p}>{p}</span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className={styles.tabsAndContent}>
        <Tabs
                    appearance="pill-group"
          size="sm"
          width="fill"
          aria-label="Chart period"
          value={period}
          onChange={setPeriod}
          items={PERIODS.map((p) => ({ value: p, label: p }))}
        />
        <div className={styles.tabsBlock}>
          <Tabs
            appearance="underline"
            width="fill"
            aria-label="Stock sections"
            className={styles.flatTabs}
            value={tab}
            onChange={setTab}
            items={[
              { value: 'overview', label: 'Overview' },
              { value: 'news', label: 'News & Events' },
            ]}
          />
          {tab === 'news' ? (
            <div className={styles.feed}>
              <Tabs
                appearance="pill"
                size="sm"
                aria-label="Show"
                value={feed}
                onChange={setFeed}
                items={[
                  { value: 'events', label: 'Events' },
                  { value: 'news', label: 'News' },
                ]}
              />
              {feed === 'events' ? <Events /> : <News items={news} stock={shortName} />}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className={styles.overview}>
              {state === 'holding' && <HoldingsSection stock={stock} dayChange={dayChangeAbs} />}
              <DailyPerformance price={stock.price} low={low} high={high} stats={stockDayStats(stock)} />
              <AnalystRatings />
              <Fundamentals />
              <AboutCompany stock={stock} />
              <Peers stock={stock} />
              {/* Related ETFs (leveraged only) are off for now (2 Nov). */}
              {false && <RelatedEtfs sym={stock.sym} />}
              <KeyHolders />
              <Financials />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Phone>
  )
}

export const StockKycPending = (props: { backdrop?: boolean }) => <StockPage state="kyc-pending" {...props} />
export const StockNotActivated = (props: { backdrop?: boolean }) => <StockPage state="not-activated" {...props} />
export const StockNoHoldings = (props: { backdrop?: boolean }) => <StockPage state="no-holdings" {...props} />
export const StockHolding = (props: { backdrop?: boolean }) => <StockPage state="holding" {...props} />
```
