### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/activation/components/PeerTable.tsx`

```tsx
// "Peers" section: this stock first (styled like the others, so it's easy to compare against) and five peers; the
// header cell cycles Overview / Returns / Ratios, rows open the peer's page. In each % column the best figure sits on a
// light yellow (warning light) highlight.
// FLAG: hand-made table (div role=table) with row buttons and a hand-made logo disc — L3 has no table; the logo is not L3 Avatar / BrandLogo.
// FLAG: layout is raw display:flex/grid + gap/padding instead of L3 Stack/Grid.
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Select } from '@l3/components/Select'
import { Usd, formatUsd } from '../../../../../shared/money'
import { homeLogoFor, isFullBleedLogo, logoFor, plateFor } from '../../../data'
import { PEERS, periodReturn, type Peer } from '../data'
import type { UsStock } from '../../../data'
import styles from './PeerTable.module.css'

const percent = (n: number) => `${n >= 0 ? '+' : '−'}${Math.abs(n).toFixed(2)}%`
const toneOf = (n: number) => (n >= 0 ? 'up' : 'down')

function CompanyLogo({ sym }: { sym: string }) {
  const home = homeLogoFor(sym)
  const src = home ?? logoFor(sym)
  const fill = !!home || isFullBleedLogo(sym)
  return (
    <span
      className={styles.logo}
      data-fill={(!!src && fill) || undefined}
      data-plate={(!!src && !fill) || undefined}
      style={{ background: src && !fill ? plateFor(sym) : undefined }}
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      {src ? <img src={src} alt="" /> : sym.slice(0, 2)}
    </span>
  )
}

/** `usd`: the text is a $ amount, shown in the currency picked (inline, no ₹ line: it's a table cell). */
type Cell = { text: string; tone?: 'up' | 'down'; usd?: boolean }
/** `best`: the column's figure to compare — the highest one gets the highlight. */
type Column = { label: string; v: (p: Peer) => Cell; best?: (p: Peer) => number }

const VIEWS = [
  { value: 'overview', label: 'Overview' },
  { value: 'returns', label: 'Returns' },
  { value: 'ratios', label: 'Ratios' },
] as const
type View = (typeof VIEWS)[number]['value']

const COLUMNS: Record<View, Column[]> = {
  overview: [
    { label: 'Price', v: (p) => ({ text: formatUsd(p.price), usd: true }) },
    { label: 'Today', v: (p) => ({ text: percent(p.change), tone: toneOf(p.change) }), best: (p) => p.change },
    { label: 'Mkt Cap', v: (p) => ({ text: p.cap, usd: true }) },
  ],
  returns: [
    { label: '1M', v: (p) => ({ text: percent(p.r1m), tone: toneOf(p.r1m) }), best: (p) => p.r1m },
    { label: '3M', v: (p) => ({ text: percent(p.r3m), tone: toneOf(p.r3m) }), best: (p) => p.r3m },
    { label: '1Y', v: (p) => ({ text: percent(p.r1y), tone: toneOf(p.r1y) }), best: (p) => p.r1y },
  ],
  ratios: [
    { label: 'P/E', v: (p) => ({ text: p.pe }) },
    { label: 'P/B', v: (p) => ({ text: p.pb }) },
    { label: 'Mkt Cap', v: (p) => ({ text: p.cap, usd: true }) },
  ],
}

/** The stock being looked at as a table row: its peer data where it has some, else its page's price and returns. */
function selfRow(stock: UsStock): Peer {
  const known = PEERS.find((p) => p.sym === stock.sym)
  if (known) return known
  const ret = (period: string) => periodReturn(stock.sym, period, stock.change)
  return { sym: stock.sym, name: stock.name, price: stock.price, change: stock.change, cap: '—', pe: '—', pb: '—', r1m: ret('1M'), r3m: ret('3M'), r1y: ret('1Y') }
}

export function PeerTable({ stock, onOpen }: { stock: UsStock; onOpen: (peer: { sym: string; name: string; logo?: string }) => void }) {
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>('returns')
  const self = selfRow(stock)
  const rows = [self, ...PEERS.filter((p) => p.sym !== stock.sym).slice(0, 5)]
  const current = VIEWS.find((v) => v.value === view)!
  const columns = COLUMNS[view]
  const bestOf = columns.map((c) => (c.best ? Math.max(...rows.map(c.best)) : undefined))
  return (
    <div className={styles.stack}>
      <div className={styles.table} role="table" aria-label="Peer comparison">
        <div className={styles.tr} data-head="" role="row">
          <span role="columnheader">
            <Select
              size="sm"
              subtle
              className={styles.viewSwitch}
              onClick={() => setView(VIEWS[(VIEWS.findIndex((v) => v.value === view) + 1) % VIEWS.length].value)}
              aria-label={`Showing ${current.label}, tap to switch`}
            >
              <span className={styles.viewName} key={view}>{current.label}</span>
            </Select>
          </span>
          {columns.map((c) => (
            <span role="columnheader" key={c.label}>{c.label}</span>
          ))}
        </div>
        {rows.map((p) => (
          <button
            key={p.sym}
            type="button"
            role="row"
            className={styles.tr}
            data-self={p === self || undefined}
            onClick={() => p !== self && onOpen({ sym: p.sym, name: p.name, logo: logoFor(p.sym) })}
          >
            <span className={styles.company} role="cell">
              <CompanyLogo sym={p.sym} />
              {/* The company's name only, no ticker line under it (3 Nov). */}
              <span className={styles.cardName}>{p.name}</span>
            </span>
            {columns.map((c, i) => {
              const cell = c.v(p)
              const best = c.best && c.best(p) === bestOf[i]
              return (
                <span key={c.label} role="cell" className={styles.num} data-tone={cell.tone} data-best={best || undefined}>
                  <span className={styles.figure}>{cell.usd ? <Usd text={cell.text} layout="inline" /> : cell.text}</span>
                </span>
              )
            })}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/activation/components/RatingRing.tsx`

```tsx
// The rating gauge's ring: a disc with one arc per rating (buy green, hold yellow, sell red), sized by its share and
// starting at the top, with a small gap between arcs — the same way the ETF page's Allocation donut is drawn.
// FLAG: hand-drawn gauge — L3 has no rating gauge; arcs are raw SVG circles.
import { RATINGS } from '../data'
import styles from '../StockPage.module.css'

const RING = { r: 32, gap: 2 }

export function RatingRing() {
  const length = 2 * Math.PI * RING.r
  const total = RATINGS.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.value, 0)
  let start = 0
  const arcs = RATINGS.map((r) => {
    const size = (r.value / total) * length
    const arc = { tone: r.tone, label: r.label, dash: Math.max(size - RING.gap, 0.5), offset: -start }
    start += size
    return arc
  })
  return (
    <svg className={styles.ring} viewBox="0 0 72 72" aria-hidden="true">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="rating-disc" x1="35" y1="18.5" x2="36" y2="72" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
          <stop className={styles.discTop} />
          <stop offset="1" className={styles.discFoot} />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <circle cx="36" cy="36" r="34" fill="url(#rating-disc)" className={styles.ringTrack} />
      {/* Rotated a quarter turn so the first arc (Buy) starts at 12 o'clock and runs clockwise. */}
      <g transform="rotate(-90 36 36)">
        {arcs.map((a) => (
          <circle
            key={a.label}
            cx="36"
            cy="36"
            r={RING.r}
            className={styles.arc}
            data-tone={a.tone}
            strokeDasharray={`${a.dash} ${length - a.dash}`}
            strokeDashoffset={a.offset}
          />
        ))}
      </g>
    </svg>
  )
}
```

```tsx
// Draws another screen of the flow, frozen, as the backdrop of a sheet (the teammate's `Z`): the screen is rendered
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/activation/data.ts`

```ts
// Sample data of the stock page (NVIDIA, scaled to the stock being looked at) and of the activation sheets.

/** Chart periods (L3 pill group, small); 1D is selected first. */
export const PERIODS = ['1D', '1W', '1M', '1Y', '3Y', '5Y']

/** How much NVDA moved over each chart period, in %; 1D is the live day change. Other stocks: their peer-table
 *  returns where they have them, else NVDA's scaled by a per-symbol factor (sample data). */
export const PERIOD_RETURNS: Record<string, number> = { '1W': 3.2, '1M': 6.8, '3M': 14.2, '1Y': 41.5, '3Y': 612.4, '5Y': 1840.6 }

/** How far the price wanders around its trend per chart period (share of the price). */
const PERIOD_VOLATILITY: Record<string, number> = { '1D': 0.004, '1W': 0.012, '1M': 0.025, '1Y': 0.06, '3Y': 0.1, '5Y': 0.12 }

/** Small seeded random numbers, so a stock + period always draws the same line. */
function seeded(text: string) {
  let h = 2166136261
  for (const c of text) h = Math.imul(h ^ c.charCodeAt(0), 16777619)
  return () => {
    h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 15), 2246822507) ^ Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 3266489909)
    return ((h >>> 0) % 10000) / 10000
  }
}

/** The stock's return over a chart period, in %. */
export function periodReturn(sym: string, period: string, dayChangePct: number): number {
  if (period === '1D') return dayChangePct
  const peer = PEERS.find((p) => p.sym === sym)
  if (peer && period === '1M') return peer.r1m
  if (peer && period === '3M') return peer.r3m
  if (peer && period === '1Y') return peer.r1y
  const factor = sym === 'NVDA' ? 1 : 0.15 + seeded(sym)() * 0.6
  return Number((PERIOD_RETURNS[period] * factor).toFixed(2))
}

/** Sample price line for the chart: `points` prices from the period's start to the current price (a seeded random
 *  walk around a smooth trend, so each period has its own shape and ends exactly at today's price). */
export function priceSeries(sym: string, period: string, price: number, returnPct: number, points = 90): number[] {
  const rand = seeded(`${sym}-${period}`)
  const start = price / (1 + returnPct / 100)
  const vol = PERIOD_VOLATILITY[period] ?? 0.02
  const walk = [0]
  for (let i = 1; i < points; i++) walk.push(walk[i - 1] + (rand() - 0.5) * 2)
  const last = walk[points - 1]
  const spread = Math.max(...walk.map((w, i) => Math.abs(w - (last * i) / (points - 1)))) || 1
  return walk.map((w, i) => {
    const t = i / (points - 1)
    const trend = start * Math.pow(price / start, t)
    const noise = (w - last * t) / spread
    return trend * (1 + noise * vol)
  })
}

/** [value, label] of the day stats. */
export const DAY_STATS: [string, string][] = [
  ['$186.10', 'Open'],
  ['$186.11', 'Prev. Close'],
  ['$4.59T', 'Mkt. Cap'],
  ['182.4M', 'Volume'],
  ['$212.19', '52-week high'],
  ['$86.62', '52-week low'],
]

export type RatingTone = 'up' | 'warning' | 'down'
export const RATINGS: { label: string; value: number; tone: RatingTone }[] = [
  { label: 'Buy', value: 78.13, tone: 'up' },
  { label: 'Hold', value: 18.75, tone: 'warning' },
  { label: 'Sell', value: 3.12, tone: 'down' },
]

/** [label, value] */
export const FUNDAMENTALS: [string, string][] = [
  ['Mkt Cap', '$4.59T'],
  ['ROE', '91.90%'],
  ['P/E Ratio (TTM)', '52.40'],
  ['EPS (TTM)', '$3.60'],
  ['Industry P/E', '38.10'],
  ['Book Value', '$4.22'],
  ['Debt to Equity', '0.10'],
  ['Dividend Yield', '0.02%'],
]

export const QUARTERS = ["Sep '25", "Jun '25", "Mar '25", "Dec '24", "Sep '24"]

/** [holder, %] per quarter of Key Holders. */
export const HOLDERS: Record<string, [string, number][]> = {
  "Sep '25": [['Institutions', 47.24], ['Retail & others', 28.45], ['Mutual Funds', 20.18], ['Insiders', 4.13]],
  "Jun '25": [['Institutions', 46.81], ['Retail & others', 28.92], ['Mutual Funds', 20.02], ['Insiders', 4.25]],
  "Mar '25": [['Institutions', 45.96], ['Retail & others', 29.64], ['Mutual Funds', 19.88], ['Insiders', 4.52]],
  "Dec '24": [['Institutions', 45.12], ['Retail & others', 30.21], ['Mutual Funds', 19.7], ['Insiders', 4.97]],
  "Sep '24": [['Institutions', 44.38], ['Retail & others', 30.95], ['Mutual Funds', 19.31], ['Insiders', 5.36]],
}

/** Company financials (NVIDIA, in $ billions). Each statement has two series, drawn as the two bars per period; the
 *  table shows both plus a third figure worked out from them. The first period of each list is only the base for the
 *  change of the second one and isn't drawn. */
export type Statement = 'income' | 'balance' | 'cashflow'
export type Frequency = 'annual' | 'quarterly'
export const STATEMENTS: Record<Statement, { label: string; series: [string, string]; third: string; thirdIsPercent: boolean }> = {
  income: { label: 'Income', series: ['Revenue', 'Net income'], third: 'Net profit margin', thirdIsPercent: true },
  balance: { label: 'Balance sheet', series: ['Total assets', 'Total liabilities'], third: "Shareholders' equity", thirdIsPercent: false },
  cashflow: { label: 'Cashflow', series: ['Operating cash flow', 'Free cash flow'], third: 'Capital spend', thirdIsPercent: false },
}
export const FINANCIALS: Record<Frequency, { periods: string[]; short: string[]; data: Record<Statement, [number[], number[]]> }> = {
  annual: {
    periods: ['FY 20', 'FY 21', 'FY 22', 'FY 23', 'FY 24', 'FY 25'],
    short: ['FY20', 'FY21', 'FY22', 'FY23', 'FY24', 'FY25'],
    data: {

const CHIP_STOCKS = ['NVDA', 'AMD', 'AVGO', 'MU', 'QCOM', 'INTC']
/** NVDA: its own 2x pair + the semiconductor ones; other chip stocks: semiconductor; everything else: Nasdaq 100. */
export function relatedEtfs(sym: string): RelatedEtf[] {
  const by = (t: string) => LEVERAGED_ETFS.filter((e) => e.tracks === t)
  if (sym === 'NVDA') return [...by('NVIDIA'), ...by('Semiconductors')]
  return CHIP_STOCKS.includes(sym) ? by('Semiconductors') : by('Nasdaq 100')
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/activation/index.tsx`

```tsx
// Activation: the stock page (not activated / no holdings / holding) and confirm details. Activating itself is
// screens/activate (4 Nov: the risk disclosure sheet is gone); the "activation submitted" sheet is the Stocks flow's stocks-18.
// Imported from the teammate's prototype; his `screens` map by Figma node id.
// FLAG: copy not in copy.json yet — all UI text in this part is hard-coded.
import { useUsJourney } from '../../../../shared/userStatus'
import { currentStock } from '../../data'
import type { UsScreenMap } from '../types'
import { CONFIRM_DETAILS, STOCK_HOLDING, STOCK_KYC_PENDING, STOCK_NO_HOLDINGS, STOCK_NOT_ACTIVATED } from './ids'
import { ConfirmDetailsScreen } from './sheets/ConfirmDetailsScreen'
import { StockHolding, StockKycPending, StockNoHoldings, StockNotActivated, StockPage } from './StockPage'

export { StockHolding, StockKycPending, StockNoHoldings, StockNotActivated, StockPage }

/**
 * The stock page in the user status picked in the prototype settings (src/shared/userStatus): KYC pending → Complete
 * KYC; not activated / under review / failed → Activate US Stocks; activated → Buy / Sell, with "Your Holdings" when the
 * user holds this stock (the sample holding is NVDA).
 */
function StockForStatus(props: { backdrop?: boolean }) {
  const journey = useUsJourney()
  // Keyed by the stock: opening another stock from this page (a peer) starts a fresh page — at the top, on Overview.
  const sym = currentStock().sym
  if (journey === 'kyc') return <StockKycPending key={sym} {...props} />
  if (journey === 'activate') return <StockNotActivated key={sym} {...props} />
  if (journey === 'review' || journey === 'support' || journey === 'failed') return <StockPage key={sym} state={journey} {...props} />
  if (journey === 'holding' && sym === 'NVDA') return <StockHolding key={sym} {...props} />
  // Activated with $0 or money on the way: Buy goes to the empty-wallet pad.
  return <StockPage key={sym} state="no-holdings" emptyWallet={journey === 'activated' || journey === 'onTheWay'} {...props} />
}

/** Screens of this part, by Figma node id. The not-activated frame's id is the one stock page that follows the user status. */
export const screens: UsScreenMap = {
  [STOCK_NOT_ACTIVATED]: StockForStatus,
  [STOCK_KYC_PENDING]: StockKycPending,
  [STOCK_NO_HOLDINGS]: StockNoHoldings,
  [STOCK_HOLDING]: StockHolding,
  // Sheets (his `Xr` map).
  [CONFIRM_DETAILS]: ConfirmDetailsScreen,
}
```

```tsx
// The scrolling sections of the stock page, top to bottom: holdings (holding state only), daily performance, analyst
// ratings, fundamentals, about, peers, related ETFs, key holders, company financials; and the News & Events tab (events, news).
// FLAG: layout is raw display:flex + gap/padding (module CSS) instead of L3 Stack/Section/Inset/Grid; panels, rows and bars are hand-made.
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { PriceChange } from '@l3/components/PriceChange'
import { Select } from '@l3/components/Select'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { asset } from '../../asset'
import { NVDA_HOLDING, openStock, plateFor, stockFor, type UsStock } from '../../data'
import { useUsNav } from '../../nav'
import { usQuote } from '../../../../shared/data/usStocks'
import { Usd, formatUsd, useUsd } from '../../../../shared/money'
import { setCurrentEtf } from '../etf/currentEtf'
import { ShareDonut } from '../etf/EtfHoldings'
import { LevTag } from '../etf/parts'
import { COMPANY_PROFILES } from './companyProfiles'
import { PeerTable } from './components/PeerTable'
import { RatingRing } from './components/RatingRing'
import { SectionTitle } from './components/SectionTitle'
import { Stat } from './components/Stat'
import {
  DAY_STATS, EVENTS, FINANCIALS, FUNDAMENTALS, HOLDERS, QUARTERS, RATINGS, STATEMENTS, relatedEtfs, type EventItem, type Frequency, type NewsItem, type Statement,
} from './data'
import { boltIcon, chevronLeftIcon, chevronRightIcon, historyIcon, infoIcon } from './icons'
import styles from './StockPage.module.css'

/** The day stats: the snapshot's real open, previous close, volume and 52-week range for this stock; the market cap
 *  (and every figure of a stock the snapshot doesn't have) is the NVDA sample. */
function dayStats(stock: UsStock): [string, string][] {
  const q = usQuote(stock.sym)
  if (!q) return DAY_STATS
  const volume = (n: number) => (n >= 1e9 ? `${(n / 1e9).toFixed(1)}B` : n >= 1e6 ? `${(n / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M` : `${(n / 1e3).toFixed(1)}K`)
  const real: Record<string, string | undefined> = {
    Open: q.open != null ? formatUsd(q.open) : undefined,
    'Prev. Close': formatUsd(q.prevClose),
    Volume: q.volume != null ? volume(q.volume) : undefined,
    '52-week high': q.high52 != null ? formatUsd(q.high52) : undefined,
    '52-week low': q.low52 != null ? formatUsd(q.low52) : undefined,
  }
  return DAY_STATS.map(([value, label]) => [real[label] ?? value, label])
}

/** The stock's day stats as Daily Performance cells: label, then the value in the currency picked. */
export function stockDayStats(stock: UsStock): [string, ReactNode][] {
  return dayStats(stock).map(([value, label]) => [label, <Usd text={value} />])
}

/** The sample holding (data.ts), shared with Portfolio's Holdings. */
const HOLDING = NVDA_HOLDING

/** "Total Returns" / "1D Returns" (the Select switches between them). */
export function HoldingsSection({ stock, dayChange }: { stock: UsStock; dayChange: number }) {
  const [daily, setDaily] = useState(false)
  const current = HOLDING.qty * stock.price
  const invested = HOLDING.qty * HOLDING.avg
  const returns = daily ? HOLDING.qty * dayChange : current - invested
  const returnsPct = daily ? stock.change : (returns / invested) * 100
  return (
    <section className={styles.section}>
      <SectionTitle
        title="Your Holdings"
        underline={false}
        action={
          <Select className={styles.accentSelect} size="md" aria-label="Returns shown" onClick={() => setDaily((d) => !d)}>
            {daily ? '1D Returns' : 'Total Returns'}
          </Select>
        }
      />
      <div className={styles.holdingsCard}>
        <div className={styles.holdingStats}>
          <div className={styles.statRow}>
            <Stat label="Quantity" value={String(HOLDING.qty)} />
            <Stat label="Avg. Price" value={<Usd value={HOLDING.avg} />} />
            <div className={styles.stat} data-end="">
              <span className={styles.statLabel}>{daily ? '1D Returns %' : 'Returns %'}</span>
              <PriceChange value={returnsPct} size="sm" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <hr className={styles.divider} />
          <div className={styles.statRow}>
            <Stat label="Current" value={<Usd value={current} />} />
            <Stat label="Invested" value={<Usd value={invested} />} />
            <Stat label={daily ? '1D Returns' : 'Returns'} value={<Usd value={returns} sign align="end" />} end up={returns >= 0} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" className={styles.protect}>
          <span>Protect your order</span>
          <span className={styles.protectAction}>
            Set TP/SL
            <Icon icon={chevronRightIcon} size={16} />
          </span>
        </button>
      </div>
      <button type="button" className={styles.orderHistory}>
        <Icon icon={historyIcon} size={20} />
        <span className={styles.orderLabel}>View Order History</span>
        <Icon icon={chevronRightIcon} size={20} />
      </button>
    </section>
  )
}

/** Daily Performance (stock and ETF pages): the day's low → high with the last traded price on it, then the day's
 *  numbers (`stats`: label, value) as a 3 × 2 grid. */
export function DailyPerformance({ price, low, high, stats }: { price: number; low: number; high: number; stats: [string, ReactNode][] }) {
  const usd = useUsd()
  const at = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, ((price - low) / (high - low)) * 100))
  return (
    <section className={styles.section}>
      <SectionTitle title="Daily Performance" info />
      <div className={styles.panel} data-gap="04">
        <div className={styles.lowHigh}>
          <Stat label="1D Low" value={<Usd value={low} />} />
          <Stat label="1D High" value={<Usd value={high} align="end" />} end />
        </div>
        <div
          className={styles.dayRange}
          role="meter"
          aria-label="Last traded price within today's range"
          aria-valuemin={low}
          aria-valuemax={high}
          aria-valuenow={price}
          aria-valuetext={`${usd(price)}, between ${usd(low)} and ${usd(high)}`}
          style={{ '--at': `${at}%` } as CSSProperties}
        >
          <span className={styles.dayTick} />
          <span className={styles.dayBolt}>
            <Icon icon={boltIcon} size={16} />
          </span>
        </div>
        <p className={styles.ltp}>
          <Icon icon={boltIcon} size={12} />
          Last Traded Price : <Usd value={price} layout="inline" />
        </p>
      </div>
      {/* The day's numbers as a 3 × 2 grid (label over value), like Fundamentals. */}
      <dl className={styles.fundGrid} data-columns="3">
        {stats.map(([label, value]) => (
          <div className={styles.fundCell} key={label}>
            <dt>{label}</dt>
            <dd>{value}</dd>
          </div>
        ))}
      </dl>
    </section>
  )
}

/** About Company: the company's real profile (companyProfiles.ts), three lines until Read more expands it (Read less folds
 *  it back). A stock with no profile gets a one-line note and no link. */
export function AboutCompany({ stock }: { stock: UsStock }) {
  const profile = COMPANY_PROFILES[stock.sym]
  return profile
    ? <AboutCard title="About Company" text={profile} />
    : <AboutCard title="About Company" text={`${stock.name} is listed on the ${stock.exchange ?? 'NASDAQ'} and trades in US dollars.`} short />
}

/** The About card (stock and ETF pages): the text in a card, three lines until Read more (Read less folds it back).
 *  Read more shows only when the text is cut (3 Nov: a one-line About had a Read more with nothing more to read).
 *  `short`: a one-liner with no link. */
export function AboutCard({ title, text, short }: { title: string; text: string; short?: boolean }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [cut, setCut] = useState(false)
  const para = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null)
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const p = para.current
    if (!p || short || open) return
    const measure = () => setCut(p.scrollHeight > p.clientHeight + 1)
    measure()
    const watch = new ResizeObserver(measure)
    watch.observe(p)
    return () => watch.disconnect()
  }, [text, short, open])
  return (
    <section className={styles.section}>
      <SectionTitle title={title} />
      <Card surface="primary">
        <div className={styles.about}>
          <p ref={para} data-collapsed={(!short && !open) || undefined}>{text}</p>
          {!short && (cut || open) && (
            <button type="button" className={styles.link} aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>
              {open ? 'Read less' : 'Read more'}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </Card>
    </section>
  )
}

/** The nearest part of the page that scrolls (the stock page's body). */
function scrollParent(el: HTMLElement | null): HTMLElement | null {
  for (let at = el?.parentElement; at; at = at.parentElement) {
    if (/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(at).overflowY)) return at
  }
  return null
}

export function Peers({ stock }: { stock: UsStock }) {
  const { go } = useUsNav()
  const section = useRef<HTMLElement>(null)
  return (
    <section ref={section} className={styles.section}>
      <SectionTitle title="Peers" />
      <PeerTable
        stock={stock}
        onOpen={(peer) => {
          // The peer opens on this same page: start it at the top, like a new page.
          const body = scrollParent(section.current)
          openStock(go, stockFor(peer.sym, { name: peer.name, logo: peer.logo, plate: peer.logo ? plateFor(peer.sym) : undefined }))
          if (body) body.scrollTop = 0
        }}
      />
    </section>
  )
}

/** Key Holders: who holds the stock, for the latest quarter only (no quarter picker, 3 Nov). Drawn like the ETF
 *  page's Allocation (3 Nov): a donut with the biggest holder in the middle, the legend beside it. */
export function KeyHolders() {
  const parts = HOLDERS[QUARTERS[0]].map(([name, pct]) => ({ name, weight: pct }))
  return (
    <section className={styles.section}>
      <SectionTitle title="Key Holders" />
      <ShareDonut parts={parts} of="the shares" legendLabel="Who holds the shares" format={(n) => `${n.toFixed(2)}%`} />
    </section>

}

/** A round top for the bar chart's axis: the max split into 4 nice steps (1, 2, 2.5, 5 × 10ⁿ). */
function axisStep(max: number) {
  const raw = max / 4
  const pow = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(raw))
  return ([1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].find((m) => m * pow >= raw) ?? 10) * pow
}

/** Company financials: the statement tabs, Annually / Quarterly and the period picker all change the bars and the
 *  table (the picked period's bars are highlighted). */
export function Financials() {
  const usd = useUsd()
  // Statements are in $ billions; shown in the currency picked (compact: $130.50B / ₹12.40 L Cr).
  const billions = (n: number) => usd(n * 1e9, { compact: true })
  const [statement, setStatement] = useState<Statement>('income')
  const [frequency, setFrequency] = useState<Frequency>('annual')
  const book = FINANCIALS[frequency]
  const last = book.periods.length - 1
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState(last)
  const spec = STATEMENTS[statement]
  const [a, b] = book.data[statement]
  const step = axisStep(Math.max(...a, ...b))
  const top = step * 4
  // Chart pixels: the 0 line sits at 136px and the top line at 6px (130px for the axis' top value).
  const barTop = (v: number) => 136 - (v / top) * 130
  // Axis labels drop trailing zeros ($200B, not $200.00B); the plot leaves room on its right for the longest one.
  const axisLabels = [4, 3, 2, 1, 0].map((n) => (n === 0 ? usd(0, { decimals: 0 }) : billions(step * n).replace(/\.0+(?=\D*$)/, '')))
  const axisWidth = `calc(${Math.max(...axisLabels.map((l) => l.length))}ch + var(--l3-spacing-08))`
  const third = (i: number) => (spec.thirdIsPercent ? (b[i] / a[i]) * 100 : a[i] - b[i])
  const change = (now: number, before: number, points: boolean) => (points ? now - before : ((now - before) / Math.abs(before)) * 100)
  const rows: [string, string, number, string][] = [
    [spec.series[0], billions(a[picked]), change(a[picked], a[picked - 1], false), '%'],
    [spec.series[1], billions(b[picked]), change(b[picked], b[picked - 1], false), '%'],
    [spec.third, spec.thirdIsPercent ? `${third(picked).toFixed(1)}%` : billions(third(picked)), change(third(picked), third(picked - 1), spec.thirdIsPercent), spec.thirdIsPercent ? ' pts' : '%'],
  ]
  const switchFrequency = () => {
    setFrequency((f) => (f === 'annual' ? 'quarterly' : 'annual'))
    setPicked(FINANCIALS[frequency === 'annual' ? 'quarterly' : 'annual'].periods.length - 1)
  }
  return (
    <section className={styles.section}>
      <SectionTitle title="Company financials" info />
      <div className={styles.financials}>
        <div className={styles.chartArea}>
          <Tabs
            appearance="pill"
            emphasis="primary"
            size="sm"
            aria-label="Statement"
            value={statement}
            onChange={(v) => setStatement(v as Statement)}
            items={(Object.keys(STATEMENTS) as Statement[]).map((k) => ({ value: k, label: STATEMENTS[k].label }))}
          />
          <div className={styles.legend}>
            <span data-tone="up">{spec.series[0].toUpperCase()}</span>
            <span>{spec.series[1].toUpperCase()}</span>
          </div>
          <div
            className={styles.bars}
            style={{ '--axis': axisWidth } as CSSProperties}
            role="img"
            aria-label={`${spec.series[0]} and ${spec.series[1].toLowerCase()}, ${book.periods[1]} to ${book.periods[last]}. ${book.periods[picked]}: ${billions(a[picked])} and ${billions(b[picked])}.`}
          >
            {axisLabels.map((label, i) => (
              <span className={styles.grid} style={{ top: 6 + i * 32.5 }} key={i}>
                <span>{label}</span>
              </span>
            ))}
            {book.short.slice(1).map((label, k) => {
              const i = k + 1
              return (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={styles.year}
                  data-active={i === picked || undefined}
                  style={{ left: `calc((100% - var(--axis)) * ${(17 + k * 52.75) / 264})` }}
                  aria-label={`Show ${book.periods[i]}`}
                  onClick={() => setPicked(i)}
                  key={label}
                >
                  <span className={styles.bar} data-tone="up" style={{ top: barTop(a[i]), height: 136 - barTop(a[i]) }} />
                  <span className={styles.bar} style={{ top: barTop(b[i]), height: 136 - barTop(b[i]), left: 11 }} />
                  <span className={styles.fy}>{label}</span>
                </button>
              )
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.tableHeader}>
          <Select size="sm" subtle aria-label="Annual or quarterly figures" onClick={switchFrequency}>
            {frequency === 'annual' ? 'Annually' : 'Quarterly'}
          </Select>
          <span className={styles.fyPicker}>
            <button type="button" aria-label="Previous period" disabled={picked <= 1} onClick={() => setPicked((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}>
              <Icon icon={chevronLeftIcon} size={12} />
            </button>
            {book.periods[picked]}
            <button type="button" aria-label="Next period" disabled={picked >= last} onClick={() => setPicked((p) => Math.min(last, p + 1))}>
              <Icon icon={chevronRightIcon} size={12} />
            </button>
          </span>
          <span className={styles.yoy}>{frequency === 'annual' ? 'Y/Y change' : 'Q/Q change'}</span>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.table}>
          {rows.map(([metric, value, delta, unit]) => (
            <div className={styles.tableRow} key={metric}>
              <span>{metric}</span>
              <span>{value}</span>
              <span data-down={delta < 0 || undefined}>
                {delta < 0 ? '−' : '+'}
                {Math.abs(delta).toFixed(1)}{unit}
              </span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}

/** Impact line under a news story ("▲ Could lift / ▼ weigh on"); neutral stories show none. */
function Why({ item, stock }: { item: NewsItem; stock: string }) {
  if (item.impact === 'neutral' || !item.why) return null
  const up = item.impact === 'positive'
  return (
    <p className={styles.why} data-down={!up || undefined} aria-label={`May ${up ? 'lift' : 'weigh on'} ${stock}: ${item.why}`}>
      <span aria-hidden="true">{up ? '▲' : '▼'}</span>
      {item.why}
    </p>
  )
}

export function News({ items, stock }: { items: NewsItem[]; stock: string }) {
  return (
    <section className={styles.section}>
      <SectionTitle title="News" />
      <ul className={styles.news}>
        {items.map((n) => (
          <li key={n.title}>
            <img src={asset(`assets/activation/${n.img}`)} alt="" width={56} height={56} />
            <div>
              <p className={styles.newsTitle}>{n.title}</p>
              <p className={styles.newsMeta}>
                {n.source}
                <span aria-hidden="true">•</span>
                {n.time}
              </p>
              <Why item={n} stock={stock} />
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  )
}

/** Events (stock and ETF pages): date block, title, detail and a type Tag. `items`: the ETF passes its own. */
export function Events({ items = EVENTS }: { items?: EventItem[] }) {
  return (
    <section className={styles.section}>
      <SectionTitle title="Events" />
      <ul className={styles.events}>
        {items.map((e) => (
          <li key={e.title}>
            <span className={styles.eventDate} aria-hidden="true">
              <b>{e.day}</b>
              {e.month}
            </span>
            <div>
              <p className={styles.newsTitle}>{e.title}</p>
              <p className={styles.newsMeta}>{e.detail}</p>
              <Tag variant="secondary" color="neutral" size="sm" className={styles.impact}>{e.type}</Tag>
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  )
}

/** Leveraged ETFs that track this stock; a card opens the ETF page (9001:2). */
// FLAG: the ETF logo disc is hand-made (his ETF logos are not in the repo yet: initials instead); the ETF page opens
// without being told which ETF was tapped (no shared "current ETF" yet).
export function RelatedEtfs({ sym }: { sym: string }) {
  const { go } = useUsNav()
  return (
    <section className={styles.section}>
      <SectionTitle title="Related ETFs" />
      <div className={styles.etfs}>
        {relatedEtfs(sym).map((e) => (
          <Card
            surface="primary"
            key={e.sym}
            className={styles.etf}
            onClick={() => { setCurrentEtf(e.sym); go('9001:2') }}
            aria-label={`${e.sym}, ${e.lev} ${e.side}, ${e.name}`}
          >
            <span className={styles.etfTop}>
              <span className={styles.etfSym}>
                <span className={styles.etfDisc} aria-hidden="true">{e.sym.slice(0, 2)}</span>
                <b>{e.sym}</b>
              </span>
              <LevTag long={e.side === 'long'}>{e.lev} {e.side === 'long' ? 'Long' : 'Short'}</LevTag>
            </span>
            <span className={styles.etfName}>{e.name}</span>
            <span className={styles.etfPrice}>
              <Usd value={e.price} layout="inline" />
              <span data-change="" data-up={e.change >= 0 || undefined}>
                {e.change >= 0 ? '+' : '−'}
                {Math.abs(e.change).toFixed(2)}%
              </span>
            </span>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}
```

```tsx
// 5756:72486 — Confirm Details: personal details from KYC, the risk disclosure and the declarations on one page;
// "Activate US Stocks" (enabled while "I agree" is ticked) opens the activation-submitted sheet.
// FLAG: copy not in copy.json yet (all UI text in this part is hard-coded).
// FLAG: three hand-made cards (.card) with dashed dividers instead of L3 Card; layout is raw display:flex + gap/padding.
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Actionbar } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@l3/components/ButtonGroup'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Phone } from '../../../components/Phone'
import { useUsNav } from '../../../nav'
import { ImgIcon } from '../components/ImgIcon'
import { ADDRESS, PERSONAL_DETAILS } from '../data'
import { checklistIcon, infoIcon, personIcon } from '../icons'
import { ACTIVATION_SUBMITTED } from '../ids'
import { Declarations } from './Declarations'
import { RiskBullets } from './RiskBullets'
import styles from './Activation.module.css'

function Field({ label, value, end }: { label: string; value: string; end?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.field} data-end={end || undefined}>
      <span className={styles.fieldLabel}>{label}</span>
      <span className={styles.fieldValue}>{value}</span>
    </div>
  )
}

function CardHeader({ icon, id, title }: { icon: string; id: string; title: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.cardHeader}>
        <span className={styles.cardIcon}>
          <Icon icon={icon} size={20} />
        </span>
        <h2 id={id}>{title}</h2>
      </div>
      <hr className={styles.dashed} />
    </>
  )
}

export function ConfirmDetailsScreen({ backdrop }: { backdrop?: boolean }) {
  const { go, back } = useUsNav()
  const [agreed, setAgreed] = useState(true)
  return (
    <Phone
      label="Confirm Details"
      gesture="primary"
      header={
        <Actionbar
          title="Confirm Details"
          onBack={() => back('5714:64982')}
          actions={<Button variant="ghost" size="sm">Help</Button>}
        />
      }
      footer={
        <ButtonGroup aria-label="Activate US Stocks">
          <Button variant="primary" size="lg" fullWidth disabled={!agreed} onClick={() => go(ACTIVATION_SUBMITTED)}>
            Activate US Stocks
          </Button>
        </ButtonGroup>
      }
      className={backdrop ? styles.still : undefined}
    >
      <div className={styles.body}>
        <section className={styles.card} aria-labelledby="pd-title">
          <CardHeader icon={personIcon} id="pd-title" title="Personal Details" />
          <div className={styles.details}>
            {PERSONAL_DETAILS.map(([l1, v1, l2, v2]) => (
              <div className={styles.detailRow} key={l1}>
                <Field label={l1} value={v1} />
                <Field label={l2} value={v2} end />
              </div>
            ))}
            <Field label="Address" value={ADDRESS} />
            <div className={styles.signatureField}>
              <span className={styles.fieldLabel}>Signature on file</span>
              <div className={styles.signature} role="img" aria-label="Your signature">
                <ImgIcon src="assets/activation/signature.svg" w={158} h={116} />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button type="button" className={styles.updateKyc}>Details wrong? Update KYC</button>
        </section>
        <section className={styles.card} aria-labelledby="risk-card-title">
          <CardHeader icon={infoIcon} id="risk-card-title" title="Risk Disclosure" />
          <RiskBullets className={styles.riskCard} />
        </section>
        <section className={styles.card} aria-labelledby="decl-title">
          <CardHeader icon={checklistIcon} id="decl-title" title="Declarations" />
          <Declarations agreed={agreed} onAgree={setAgreed} />
        </section>
      </div>
    </Phone>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/activation/sheets/Declarations.tsx`

```tsx
// "I agree to all of the following" + the expandable declarations list (Confirm Details).
// FLAG: hand-made accordion rows (button + chevron) and checkbox label row — L3 has no accordion.
import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Checkbox } from '@l3/components/Checkbox'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { chevronDownIcon, chevronUpIcon } from '../icons'
import styles from './Activation.module.css'

type Declaration = { id: string; text: ReactNode; more?: string; link?: string }

const DECLARATIONS: Declaration[] = [
  { id: 'a', text: 'a. US Stocks terms and the ViewTrade Global Access client agreement' },
  {
    id: 'b',
    text: (
      <>
        b. I'm an Indian resident. I'm neither a specified US person, US citizen/
        <wbr />
        green card holder nor a tax resident of any other country. <span className={styles.nowrap}>W-8BEN</span>
      </>
    ),
    more: 'Pre-filled from your KYC and signed with your signature on file.',
    link: 'View W-8BEN',
  },
  { id: 'c', text: 'c. Share my KYC with ViewTrade IFSC and India INX Global Access' },
  { id: 'd', text: 'd. Use my signature on file for US Stocks documents' },
  { id: 'e', text: 'e. Tax: report US holdings in Schedule FA; ITR-1 cannot be used' },
]

export function Declarations({ agreed, onAgree, open: initiallyOpen = 'b' }: { agreed: boolean; onAgree: (agreed: boolean) => void; open?: string }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(initiallyOpen)
  return (
    <>
      <label className={styles.agree}>
        <Checkbox checked={agreed} onChange={(e) => onAgree(e.target.checked)} />
        I agree to all of the following
      </label>
      <ul className={styles.declarations}>
        {DECLARATIONS.map((d) => {
          const expanded = open === d.id
          return (
            <li key={d.id}>
              <button type="button" className={styles.declRow} aria-expanded={expanded} onClick={() => setOpen(expanded ? null : d.id)}>
                <span>{d.text}</span>
                <Icon icon={expanded ? chevronUpIcon : chevronDownIcon} size={20} />
              </button>
              {expanded && d.more && (
                <div className={styles.declMore}>
                  <p>{d.more}</p>
                  {d.link && <button type="button" className={styles.smallLink}>{d.link}</button>}
                </div>
              )}
            </li>
          )
        })}
      </ul>
    </>
  )
}
```

```tsx
// The risk-disclosure bullets — in the Risk disclosure sheet and in the Risk Disclosure card of Confirm Details.
// FLAG: hand-made bullet list (ul with a pseudo-element dot) — no L3 list component.
import styles from './Activation.module.css'

export function RiskBullets({ className, link = true }: { className?: string; link?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <ul className={[styles.bullets, className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}>
      <li>US stocks carry price, currency and liquidity risk, and prices can move without a daily cap.</li>
      <li>Your account is with ViewTrade IFSC through India INX Global Access, in GIFT City, regulated by IFSCA.</li>
      <li>Your money is held in your own ViewTrade IFSC account, not by Lemonn.</li>
      <li>SEBI investor protection and grievance redressal do not apply to these investments.</li>
      {link && (
        <li>
          Read the full disclosure{' '}
          <button type="button" className={styles.inlineLink}>here</button>
        </li>
      )}
    </ul>
  )
}
```

```tsx
// E5 · Mutual Fund home with a "US Stocks on Lemonn" banner under the holdings card. Everything else is the MF home
// as it is today: SIPs, popular funds, explore funds, fund houses, experts. The banner has no click action in the
// original (a button without a target).
// FLAG: redraws the app's Mutual Fund home (no MF flow in src/flows yet) for this prototype.
// FLAG: hand-made category buttons, "See all" text buttons, scrollers and fixed-width cards
// (see MutualFundHome.module.css) — L3 Button / Card / Grid exist.
import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Actionbar } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { BottomNavbar } from '@l3/components/BottomNavbar'
import { NavIcon } from '@l3/components/BottomNavbar/NavIcon'
import { Card } from '@l3/components/Card'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'

import { Phone } from '../../components/Phone'

import { goToTab } from '../../../../shared/ui/MainNav'
import { Move } from './components/Primitives'
import { entryUrl } from './entryAssets'
import { arrowForward, chevronRight } from './icons'
import styles from './MutualFundHome.module.css'

const mfUrl = (file: string) => entryUrl(`mf/${file}`)
/** Path of an mf SVG for InlineSvg (its colours are L3 tokens). */
const mfPath = (file: string) => `assets/entry/mf/${file}`

/** A decorative image at a fixed size (his `va`). FLAG: raw inline px size on top of width/height. */
function Pic({ src, size, w = size, h = size, className }: { src: string; size?: number; w?: number; h?: number; className?: string }) {
  return <img src={src} alt="" aria-hidden="true" width={w} height={h} className={className} style={{ width: w, height: h }} />
}

/** The "See all" text button at the right of a section title. */
function SeeAll() {
  return (
    <button type="button" className={styles.seeAll}>
      See all
      <Pic src={mfUrl('see-all.svg')} size={12} />
    </button>
  )
}

/** A horizontally scrolling row of cards. */
function Scroller({ children, className }: { children: ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  return (
    // FLAG: inline gap: 12 (raw px)
    <div className={[styles.scroller, className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')} style={{ gap: 12 }}>
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}

/** The Quant fund mark: a tinted tile (variant 1 or 2) with the fund's picture over it. */
function QuantMark({ variant = 1 }: { variant?: 1 | 2 }) {
  return (
    <span className={styles.quant}>
      <Pic src={mfUrl(variant === 1 ? 'quant.svg' : 'quant-2.svg')} size={41} />
      <img src={mfUrl('quant-img.png')} alt="" className={styles.quantImg} />
    </span>
  )
}

const categories = [
  { label: ['All', 'Funds'], icon: 'all-funds.svg' },
  { label: ['High', 'Returns'], icon: 'high-returns.svg' },
  { label: ['Tax', 'Savings'], icon: 'tax-savings.svg' },
  { label: ['Large', 'Cap'], icon: 'large-cap.svg' },
]

/** A section title; with `seeAll` it sits in a row with the "See all" button, without it it is the bare heading. */
const SectionTitle = ({ children, seeAll = true }: { children: ReactNode; seeAll?: boolean }) =>
  seeAll ? (
    <div className={styles.head}>
      <h2 className={styles.title}>{children}</h2>
      <SeeAll />
    </div>
  ) : (
    <h2 className={styles.title}>{children}</h2>
  )
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/entry/PortfolioScreen.tsx`

```tsx
// E4 · Portfolio tab: Positions · Holdings · Orders, opening on Holdings (3 Nov, was Positions). Each tab is its own
// page (portfolio/PositionsTab, portfolio/HoldingsTab, components/OrdersTab): a grey top and the white sheet under it.
// This screen holds the frame — Actionbar with the section tabs, swiping between tabs, the navbar — and the sort sheet.
// NOTE: the US-market banner the Figma frames show ("opens tonight" / "LIVE till 2:30 AM IST") is no longer drawn, so
// the two Figma variants (before / after 8 PM IST) render the same.
// FLAG: redraws the app's Portfolio tab (no portfolio flow in src/flows yet) for this prototype.
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Actionbar, ActionbarAction } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Section } from '@l3/components/Section'
import { Phone } from '../../components/Phone'
import { UsMainNav } from '../../components/UsMainNav'
import { useUsNav } from '../../nav'
import { useUsMarketSnapshot } from '../../../../shared/data/usStocks'
import { useUsJourney } from '../../../../shared/userStatus'
import type { HoldingsMarket } from './components/HoldingsCards'
import { OrdersTab } from './components/OrdersTab'
import { SlidingTabs } from './components/SlidingTabs'
import { neighbour, useSwipePages } from './components/swipePages'
import { t } from './copy'
import { entryUrl } from './entryAssets'
import { SEARCH, WALLET, WALLET_US } from './ids'
import { HoldingsTab } from './portfolio/HoldingsTab'
import { PortfolioPage } from './portfolio/PortfolioPage'
import { PositionsTab } from './portfolio/PositionsTab'
import { portfolioTabs, type PortfolioTab } from './portfolioData'
import { SortSheet, type SortValue } from './sheets/SortSheet'
import styles from './portfolio/Portfolio.module.css'

/** `tab` / `market`: where it opens (Home's US holdings card opens Holdings with the US Stocks card upfront). */
export function PortfolioScreen({ tab: initialTab = 'holdings', market: initialMarket = 'in' }: { tab?: PortfolioTab; market?: HoldingsMarket }) {
  const { go } = useUsNav()
  const journey = useUsJourney()
  useUsMarketSnapshot() // re-render when US prices refresh
  const usActive = journey === 'activated' || journey === 'onTheWay' || journey === 'ready' || journey === 'holding'
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<PortfolioTab>(initialTab)
  const [market, setMarket] = useState<HoldingsMarket>(initialMarket)
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<SortValue>({ key: 'current', dir: 'desc' })
  const [sortOpen, setSortOpen] = useState(false)

  const swipe = useSwipePages({
    canGo: (direction) => !!neighbour(portfolioTabs, tab, direction),
    onSwitch: (direction) => setTab(neighbour(portfolioTabs, tab, direction)!),
    page: tab,
  })
  const pickTab = (next: PortfolioTab) => {
    if (next === tab) return
    swipe.entered(portfolioTabs.indexOf(next) > portfolioTabs.indexOf(tab) ? 1 : -1)
    setTab(next)
  }

  return (
    <Phone
      className={styles.screen}
      bodyRef={swipe.bind}
      label={t('portfolio.title')}
      header={
        <Actionbar
          title={t('portfolio.title')}
          actions={
            <>
              <ActionbarAction icon={entryUrl('search.svg')} label={t('portfolio.search')} onClick={() => go(SEARCH)} />
              <ActionbarAction icon={entryUrl('wallet.svg')} label={t('portfolio.wallet')} onClick={() => go(usActive ? WALLET_US : WALLET)} />
            </>
          }
          bottom={
            <SlidingTabs
              appearance="underline"
              aria-label={t('portfolio.sections')}
              width="auto"
              value={tab}
              onChange={(value) => pickTab(value as PortfolioTab)}
              items={portfolioTabs.map((value) => ({ value, label: t(`portfolio.tab.${value}`) }))}
            />
          }
        />
      }
      gesture="none"
      footer={<UsMainNav value="portfolio" />}
      overlay={
        <SortSheet
          key={String(sortOpen)} // a fresh draft each time it opens
          open={sortOpen}
          value={sort}
          onApply={(value) => {
            setSort(value)
            setSortOpen(false)
          }}
          onClose={() => setSortOpen(false)}
        />
      }
    >
      {/* Keyed by tab: the new tab's page mounts fresh, and its sheet is what slides in (swipe.contentRef). */}
      {tab === 'positions' && <PositionsTab key={tab} sheetRef={swipe.contentRef} />}
      {tab === 'holdings' && <HoldingsTab key={tab} market={market} onMarket={setMarket} sort={sort} onSort={() => setSortOpen(true)} sheetRef={swipe.contentRef} />}
      {tab === 'orders' && (
        <PortfolioPage key={tab} flat sheetRef={swipe.contentRef}>
          <OrdersPage market={market} />
        </PortfolioPage>
      )}
    </Phone>
  )
}

/** Orders sits 16 from the top of its square sheet and from its sides. */
function OrdersPage({ market }: { market: HoldingsMarket }) {
  return (
    <Section paddingInline="16" paddingBlock="08" className={styles.grow}>
      <OrdersTab initialMarket={market === 'us' ? 'us' : undefined} />
    </Section>
  )
}

// Figma's two variants (before / after 8 PM IST) render the same now (see the NOTE at the top).
export const PortfolioBannerScreen = () => <PortfolioScreen />
export const PortfolioBannerLiveScreen = () => <PortfolioScreen />
export const PortfolioUsHoldingsScreen = () => <PortfolioScreen tab="holdings" market="us" />
/** Portfolio on Orders, US side — where Order Details goes back to. */
export const PortfolioUsOrdersScreen = () => <PortfolioScreen tab="orders" market="us" />
/** Portfolio on Positions, US Stocks — where Position Details goes back to. */
export const PortfolioUsPositionsScreen = () => <PortfolioScreen tab="positions" market="us" />
```

```tsx
// E1a · S&P 500 index page (market open): name + value, the intraday chart, chart tools, the day's range, and the
// index's stocks — tapping one opens its stock page. Back and the footer CTA both lead to US Stocks home.
// FLAG: hand-made chart tools, and "See all" (see SpxIndex.module.css); the stock rows are the shared StockListCard — L3 Button / SectionHeader / Card / ListCell exist.
import { ActionbarAction, Actionbar } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@l3/components/ButtonGroup'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Usd } from '../../../../shared/money'
import { Phone } from '../../components/Phone'
import { openStock, stockFromRow } from '../../data'
import { useUsNav } from '../../nav'
import { Move } from './components/Primitives'
import { StockListCard } from '../../../../shared/ui/StockListCard'
import { SpxChart } from './components/SpxChart'
import { entryUrl } from './entryAssets'
import { chevronRight, functionIcon, settings, star, stylus, swapHoriz } from './icons'
import { STOCKS_HOME, STOCKS_HOME_ENTRY } from './ids'
import { InlineSvg } from '../../components/InlineSvg'
import { indexStocks } from './spxData'
import styles from './SpxIndex.module.css'

/** The row of chart tools under the chart: an icon or a text glyph + a caption. */
const chartTools: { label: string; icon?: string; text?: string }[] = [
  { label: 'Range', icon: swapHoriz },
  { label: 'Interval', text: '5m' },
  { label: 'Indicators', icon: functionIcon },
  { label: 'Drawings', icon: stylus },
  { label: 'Settings', icon: settings },
]

export function SpxIndexScreen() {
  const { back, go } = useUsNav()
  return (
    <Phone
      label="S&P 500"
      gesture="primary"
      header={
        <Actionbar
          onBack={() => back(STOCKS_HOME)}
          actions={<ActionbarAction icon={star} label="Add S&P 500 to watchlist" onClick={() => {}} />}
        />
      }
      footer={
        <ButtonGroup aria-label="S&P 500" scrollIndicator>
          <Button variant="primary" size="lg" fullWidth onClick={() => go(STOCKS_HOME_ENTRY)}>
            Explore US Stocks
          </Button>
        </ButtonGroup>
      }
    >
      <header className={styles.head}>
        <div className={styles.headRow}>
          <span className={styles.logo}>
            <img src={entryUrl('index/spx.png')} alt="" />
          </span>
          <span className={styles.headText}>
            <h1 className={styles.name}>S&P 500</h1>
            <span className={styles.valueRow}>
              <span className={styles.value}>₹1,40,018.35</span>
              <Move value="0.22% (-50)" up={false} />
            </span>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.metaRow}>
          <span className={styles.status}>Market open • Closes 2:30 AM IST</span>
          <span className={styles.provider}>S&P DJI</span>
        </div>
      </header>
      <SpxChart />
      <div className={styles.tools}>
        {chartTools.map((tool) => (
          <button key={tool.label} type="button" className={styles.tool}>
            {tool.icon ? <Icon icon={tool.icon} size={24} className={styles.toolIcon} /> : <span className={styles.toolText}>{tool.text}</span>}
            {tool.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <section className={styles.section} aria-labelledby="ix-daily">
        <h2 id="ix-daily" className={styles.sectionTitle}>Daily Performance</h2>
        <div className={styles.daily}>
          <div className={styles.lowHigh}>
            <span>
              <span className={styles.label}>24H Low</span>
              <span className={styles.lhValue}>540.95</span>
            </span>
            <span data-end>
              <span className={styles.label}>24H High</span>
              <span className={styles.lhValue}>740.95</span>
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.rangeBar} style={{ '--at': 0.5 } as React.CSSProperties}>
            <img className={styles.rangeLine} src={entryUrl('index/range-line.svg')} alt="" />
            <InlineSvg className={styles.rangeBolt} src="assets/entry/index/range-bolt.svg" w={16.43} h={19.24} />
          </div>
          <p className={styles.ltp}>
            <InlineSvg src="assets/entry/index/bolt.svg" w={7.44} h={9} />
            <span className={styles.label}>Last Traded Price :</span>
            {' ₹640.00'}
          </p>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section className={styles.section} aria-labelledby="ix-stocks">
        <div className={styles.sectionHead}>
          <h2 id="ix-stocks" className={styles.sectionTitle}>Stocks in S&P 500</h2>
          <button type="button" className={styles.seeAll}>
            See all
            <Icon icon={chevronRight} size={16} />
          </button>
        </div>
        <ul className={styles.stocks}>
          {indexStocks.map((stock) => (
            <li key={stock.symbol}>
              <StockListCard
                symbol={stock.symbol}
                name={stock.name}
                logoUrl={entryUrl(stock.logo)}
                price={<Usd text={stock.price} layout="inline" />}
                changePct={(stock.up ? 1 : -1) * Number.parseFloat(stock.change)}
                onOpen={() =>
                  openStock(
                    go,
                    stockFromRow({ sym: stock.symbol, logo: entryUrl(stock.logo), price: stock.price, change: stock.change, up: stock.up }),
                  )
                }
              />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </section>
    </Phone>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/entry/components/HoldingsCards.tsx`

```tsx
// Portfolio → Holdings: two swipeable cards (Indian Stocks P&L · US Stocks P&L) with dots under them. The card in view
// is the picked market; tapping a card or a dot picks it, scrolling the rail picks it too.
// FLAG: hand-made carousel cards (fixed 296px wide), pager dots and returns pill — L3 has Card and PriceChange.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { lmSwitchArrowVertical } from '@l3/icons/lemonnade'
import { Usd } from '../../../../../shared/money'
import styles from './HoldingsCards.module.css'

export type HoldingsMarket = 'in' | 'us'
export type HoldingsSummary = { pnl: string; pct: string; up: boolean; invested: string; current: string }

const order: HoldingsMarket[] = ['in', 'us']
const labels: Record<HoldingsMarket, { title: string; short: string; code: string }> = {
  in: { title: 'Indian Stocks P&L', short: 'Indian Stocks', code: 'IND' },
  us: { title: 'US Stocks P&L', short: 'US Stocks', code: 'US' },
}

/** '₹1,500.25' -> 1500.25 */
const amountOf = (text: string) => Number(text.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '')) || 0

export function HoldingsCards({
  market,
  onMarket,
  data,
}: {
  market: HoldingsMarket
  onMarket: (market: HoldingsMarket) => void
  data: Record<HoldingsMarket, HoldingsSummary>
}) {
  const railRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const scrollingToPick = useRef(false)
  const [oneDay, setOneDay] = useState(false)

  // bring the picked card into view
  useEffect(() => {
    const rail = railRef.current
    if (!rail) return
    const card = rail.children[order.indexOf(market)] as HTMLElement | undefined
    if (!card) return
    const left = card.offsetLeft - rail.offsetLeft - parseFloat(getComputedStyle(rail).paddingLeft)
    if (Math.abs(rail.scrollLeft - left) < 4) return
    scrollingToPick.current = true
    rail.scrollTo({ left, behavior: 'smooth' })
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => (scrollingToPick.current = false), 450)
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [market])

  return (
    <div className={styles.wrap}>
      <div
        className={styles.rail}
        ref={railRef}
        onScroll={() => {
          const rail = railRef.current
          if (!rail || scrollingToPick.current) return
          const step = (rail.children[1] as HTMLElement).offsetLeft - (rail.children[0] as HTMLElement).offsetLeft
          const next = order[Math.round(rail.scrollLeft / step)] ?? market
          if (next !== market) onMarket(next)
        }}
      >
        {order.map((id) => {
          const summary = data[id]
          const base = amountOf(summary.current)
          const day = base * 0.0124
          const returns = oneDay
            ? {
                pct: base ? `${((day / (base - day)) * 100).toFixed(2)}%` : '0.00%',
                pnl: `+${summary.current.replace(/[\d.,]/g, '')}${day.toFixed(2)}`,
              }
            : { pct: summary.pct, pnl: summary.pnl }
          return (
            <section key={id} className={styles.card} data-market={id} aria-label={labels[id].title} onClick={() => onMarket(id)}>
              <span className={styles.facts}>
                <span className={styles.fact}>
                  <span className={styles.factLabel}>{labels[id].code} Current Value</span>
                  <span className={styles.factValue}><Usd text={summary.current} /></span>
                </span>
                <span className={styles.fact} data-end="">
                  <span className={styles.factLabel}>Invested Value</span>
                  <span className={styles.factValue}><Usd text={summary.invested} align="end" /></span>
                </span>
              </span>
              <span className={styles.fact}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={`${styles.factLabel} ${styles.factSwitch}`}
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation()
                    setOneDay((v) => !v)
                  }}
                >
                  <span className={styles.swap} key={String(oneDay)}>{oneDay ? '1D Returns' : 'Total Returns'}</span>
                  <Icon icon={lmSwitchArrowVertical} size={16} />
                </button>
                <span className={`${styles.returns} ${styles.swap}`} key={String(oneDay)}>
                  <span className={styles.pill} data-up={summary.up || undefined}>
                    {/^[+\-−]/.test(returns.pct) ? returns.pct : `${summary.up ? '+' : '−'}${returns.pct}`}
                  </span>
                  <span className={styles.amount}><Usd text={returns.pnl} /></span>
                </span>
              </span>
            </section>
          )
        })}
      </div>
      <span className={styles.dots} role="tablist" aria-label="Market">
        {order.map((id) => (
          <button
            key={id}
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={id === market}
            aria-label={labels[id].short}
            className={styles.dot}
            onClick={() => onMarket(id)}
          />
        ))}
      </span>
    </div>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/entry/components/OrdersTab.tsx`

```tsx
// Portfolio → Orders: an IND / US switcher and pill tabs. Indian: Open · SIP · History, each an empty state.
// US: Open (n) · History (n) (US Stocks have no SIPs), then "All orders ⇕" (Stocks / ETFs) and Filters, then the order
// cards — layout from "Positions & orders" (nLs24dTJdPz9A5pu3AWMbe, 6754:65685 / 6754:66744, empty 6754:66494…66560).
// The US lists show the sample orders only for a user who holds US stocks (User status → journey 'holding'); every
// other user (not activated, under review, $0, money on the way, funded but nothing bought yet) sees the empty states.
// The picker and the filters are shared by Open and History (switching tabs keeps them). The US side remembers Open /
// History, the picker and the applied filters across remounts (module-level, like `currentOrder` in orders/data.ts), so
// coming back from Order Details shows the same list. The Indian side starts on Open each time, as before.
// "All orders ⇕" is an L3 action pill with the switch icon (AGENTS: a switcher beside order tabs), as Filters next to it.
// FLAG: the IND / USD Select is restyled into an outlined pill and the Tabs row is custom-sized (see OrdersTab.module.css).
import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Badge } from '@l3/components/Badge'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { EmptyState } from '@l3/components/EmptyState'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { lmSwitchArrowVertical } from '@l3/components/icons/glyphs'
import { Select } from '@l3/components/Select'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Tab, Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { msFilterList } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { useUsMarketSnapshot } from '../../../../../shared/data/usStocks'
import { useUsJourney } from '../../../../../shared/userStatus'
import { useUsNav } from '../../../nav'
import { historyOrders, openOrder, openOrders, type UsOrder } from '../../orders/data'
import { OrderCard } from '../../orders/OrderCard'
import { NO_FILTERS, OrderFilterSheet, applyFilters, filterCount, type OrderFilters } from '../../orders/OrderFilterSheet'
import { ORDER_KIND_LABEL, type OrderKind } from '../../orders/OrderKindSheet'
import styles from './OrdersTab.module.css'

type OrderTab = 'open' | 'sip' | 'history'
type UsList = 'open' | 'history'
export type OrderMarket = 'in' | 'us'

const markets: Record<OrderMarket, { code: string; name: string }> = {
  in: { code: 'IND', name: 'Indian' },
  us: { code: 'USD', name: 'US' },
}

/** What the US side was showing last (kept across remounts: Portfolio → Order Details → back). */
let lastUsList: UsList = 'open'
let lastKind: OrderKind = 'all'
let lastFilters: OrderFilters = NO_FILTERS

const EMPTY_KIND: Record<OrderKind, string> = { all: '', stock: ' of stocks', etf: ' of ETFs' }

/**
 * `banner` is a slot between the tabs and the empty state (the US-market banner, which the current build no longer passes).
 * `initialMarket` opens the tab on the US side (e.g. from a US screen); the switcher still flips it.
 */
export function OrdersTab({ banner, initialMarket = 'in' }: { banner?: ReactNode; initialMarket?: OrderMarket }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<OrderTab>(initialMarket === 'us' ? lastUsList : 'open')
  const [market, setMarket] = useState<OrderMarket>(initialMarket)
  const [kind, setKindState] = useState<OrderKind>(lastKind)
  const [filters, setFiltersState] = useState<OrderFilters>(lastFilters)
  const setKind = (next: OrderKind) => {
    lastKind = next
    setKindState(next)
  }
  const setFilters = (next: OrderFilters) => {
    lastFilters = next
    setFiltersState(next)
  }
  const lists = useUsOrderLists()
  const current = markets[market]
  // US has no SIP tab: coming over from SIP lands on Open.
  const usList: UsList = tab === 'history' ? 'history' : 'open'

  return (
    <div className={styles.orders}>
      <div className={styles.tabRow}>
        <Select
          size="md"
          icon="swap"
          onClick={() => setMarket((m) => (m === 'in' ? 'us' : 'in'))}
          className={styles.switcher}
          aria-label={`Showing ${current.name} orders, tap for ${market === 'in' ? 'US' : 'Indian'}`}
        >
          <span className={styles.switchLabel} key={market}>{current.code}</span>
        </Select>
        <span className={styles.rule} aria-hidden="true" />
        {market === 'us' ? (
          <Tabs
            appearance="pill"
            behavior="tabs"
            width="fill"
            aria-label="US orders"
            className={`${styles.pills} ${styles.tabs}`}
            value={usList}
            onChange={(value) => {
              lastUsList = value
              setTab(value)
            }}
            items={[
              { value: 'open', label: `Open (${countOf(lists.open, kind)})` },
              { value: 'history', label: `History (${countOf(lists.history, kind)})` },
            ]}
          />
        ) : (
          <Tabs
            appearance="pill"
            behavior="tabs"
            width="fill"
            aria-label="Orders"
            className={`${styles.pills} ${styles.tabs}`}
            value={tab}
            onChange={(value) => setTab(value as OrderTab)}
            items={[
              { value: 'open', label: 'Open' },
              { value: 'sip', label: 'SIP' },
              { value: 'history', label: 'History' },
            ]}
          />
        )}
      </div>
      {banner}
      {market === 'us' ? (
        <UsOrders list={usList} orders={lists[usList]} kind={kind} onKind={setKind} filters={filters} onFilters={setFilters} />
      ) : (
        /* L3 Empty state with its default illustration, centred in the space under the tabs. */
        <EmptyState
          key={`${tab}${market}`}
          className={styles.empty}
          title={{ open: 'You do not have any pending Indian orders', sip: 'You do not have any Indian SIPs', history: 'No Indian orders in your history yet' }[tab]}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

/** The US sample orders the user has (none until they hold US stocks). */
function useUsOrderLists(): Record<UsList, UsOrder[]> {
  const journey = useUsJourney()
  useUsMarketSnapshot() // re-render when prices tick (the cards' LTP)
  return journey === 'holding' ? { open: openOrders, history: historyOrders } : { open: [], history: [] }
}

/** The picker is a switcher, as the USD / INR one: each tap steps All orders → Stocks → ETFs (no sheet, 3 Nov). */
const nextKind = (kind: OrderKind): OrderKind => (kind === 'all' ? 'stock' : kind === 'stock' ? 'etf' : 'all')
const ofKind = (orders: UsOrder[], kind: OrderKind) => (kind === 'all' ? orders : orders.filter((o) => o.kind === kind))
/** The count on a tab: its orders of the picked kind (before filters, as the picker narrows the whole tab). */
const countOf = (orders: UsOrder[], kind: OrderKind) => ofKind(orders, kind).length

/** A US list: the picker + Filters row, then the cards (or the empty state that fits). */
function UsOrders({
  list,
  orders,
  kind,
  onKind,
  filters,
  onFilters,
}: {
  list: UsList
  orders: UsOrder[]
  kind: OrderKind
  onKind: (kind: OrderKind) => void
  filters: OrderFilters
  onFilters: (filters: OrderFilters) => void
}) {
  const { go } = useUsNav()
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState<'filters' | null>(null)
  // A fresh filter sheet each time it opens (its picks start from the applied filters), kept while it closes.
  const [filterRun, setFilterRun] = useState(0)
  const narrowed = ofKind(orders, kind)
  const shown = applyFilters(narrowed, filters, list)
  const activeFilters = filterCount(filters, list)

  let content: ReactNode
  if (shown.length) {
    content = (
      <Stack as="ul" gap="16" className={styles.list} aria-label={list === 'open' ? 'Open US orders' : 'US order history'}>
        {shown.map((order) => (
          <li key={order.id}>
            <OrderCard order={order} onOpen={() => openOrder(go, order)} />
          </li>
        ))}
      </Stack>
    )
  } else if (narrowed.length && activeFilters) {
    content = (
      <EmptyState
        className={styles.empty}
        title="No orders match these filters"
        action={<Button size="sm" onClick={() => onFilters(NO_FILTERS)}>Clear filters</Button>}
      />
    )
  } else {
    content = (
      <EmptyState
        key={`${list}${kind}`}
        className={styles.empty}
        title={list === 'open' ? `No pending US orders${EMPTY_KIND[kind]}` : `No US orders${EMPTY_KIND[kind]} in your history yet`}
      />
    )
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="between" gap="12" className={styles.pickerRow}>
        <Tab
          action
          appearance="pill"
          size="sm"
          iconRight={<Icon icon={lmSwitchArrowVertical} />}
          aria-label={`Showing ${ORDER_KIND_LABEL[kind]}, tap for ${ORDER_KIND_LABEL[nextKind(kind)]}`}
          onClick={() => onKind(nextKind(kind))}
        >
          {ORDER_KIND_LABEL[kind]}
        </Tab>
        {/* FLAG: Figma's "Filters" is a blue text link with a count; L3 has no text link with a badge, so it's the
            L3 action pill (Tab action — "open a filter sheet") with an L3 Badge. */}
        <Tab
          action
          appearance="pill"
          size="sm"
          iconLeft={<Icon icon={msFilterList} />}
          badge={activeFilters ? <Badge count={activeFilters} color="discover" label="filters on" /> : undefined}
          aria-label={activeFilters ? `Filters, ${activeFilters} on. Change` : 'Filters'}
          onClick={() => {
            setFilterRun((n) => n + 1)
            setSheet('filters')
          }}
        >
          Filters
        </Tab>
      </Stack>
      {content}
      <OrderFilterSheet
        key={filterRun}
        open={sheet === 'filters'}
        list={list}
        value={filters}
        onApply={(next) => {
          onFilters(next)
          setSheet(null)
        }}
        onClose={() => setSheet(null)}
      />
    </>
  )
}
```

```tsx
// Three small pieces several screens in this part share: the up/down % indicator, the round logo, the navbar footer.
// FLAG: hand-made price-change indicator and logo plate (L3 has PriceChange; its company logos are for Indian stocks only).
import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from 'react'
import styles from './Primitives.module.css'

/** A signed percentage in green / red — his `hi`, without his ▲/▼ (sign, never an arrow: the user's rule, 3 Nov). */
export function Move({ value, up, className, style }: { value: string; up?: boolean; className?: string; style?: CSSProperties }) {
  return (
    <span className={[styles.move, className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')} data-up={up || undefined} style={style}>
      {/^[+\-−]/.test(value) ? value : `${up ? '+' : '−'}${value}`}
    </span>
  )
}

/** A round (or, at 24, rounded-square) logo with an optional plate colour — his `gi`. */
export function RoundLogo({ src, size, bg, fit, pad }: { src: string; size: 24 | 32 | 40; bg?: string; fit?: string; pad?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <span
      className={styles.logo}
      data-size={size}
      data-pad={pad || undefined}
      style={bg ? ({ '--logo-bg': bg } as CSSProperties) : undefined}
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <img src={src} alt="" data-fit={fit} />
    </span>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/entry/components/SlidingTabs.tsx`

```tsx
// L3 Tabs with a hand-drawn sliding underline that follows the selected tab (and scrolls it into view) — his `Mi`.
// FLAG: hand-made indicator on top of L3 Tabs (the L3 underline tabs draw their own).
// DUPLICATE: the home part uses this too (his Mi) — it will have its own copy.
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { Tabs, type TabsProps } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import styles from './SlidingTabs.module.css'

type SlidingTabsProps = TabsProps & {
  /** Class for the wrapper div (the Tabs' own `className` goes to the tab list). */
  wrapClassName?: string
  /** Inset the bar by the selected tab's horizontal padding, so it fits the label. */
  fitLabel?: boolean
}

export function SlidingTabs({ className, wrapClassName, fitLabel, ...tabs }: SlidingTabsProps) {
  const wrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [bar, setBar] = useState<{ x: number; w: number } | null>(null)
  const signature = `${tabs.value}|${tabs.items.map((item) => item.label).join('|')}`

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const list = wrapRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role="tablist"]')
    const tab = list?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[aria-selected="true"]')
    if (!list || !tab) return
    const inner = tab.firstElementChild
    const inset = fitLabel
      ? (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(tab).paddingLeft) || 0) + ((inner && parseFloat(getComputedStyle(inner).paddingLeft)) || 0)
      : 0
    const place = () =>
      setBar({
        x: tab.offsetLeft - list.scrollLeft + list.offsetLeft + inset,
        w: tab.offsetWidth - inset * 2,
      })
    if (list.scrollWidth > list.clientWidth) {
      const left = Math.max(0, Math.min(tab.offsetLeft - (list.clientWidth - tab.offsetWidth) / 2, list.scrollWidth - list.clientWidth))
      list.scrollTo({ left, behavior: 'smooth' })
    }
    place()
    list.addEventListener('scroll', place, { passive: true })
    addEventListener('resize', place)
    return () => {
      list.removeEventListener('scroll', place)
      removeEventListener('resize', place)
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- re-measure only when the selection or labels change, like the original
  }, [signature])

  return (
    <div className={[styles.wrap, wrapClassName].filter(Boolean).join(' ')} ref={wrapRef}>
      <Tabs {...tabs} className={[styles.tabs, className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')} />
      {bar && <span className={styles.bar} style={{ '--x': `${bar.x}px`, '--w': `${bar.w}px` } as React.CSSProperties} aria-hidden="true" />}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
// The S&P 500 intraday chart on the index page: volume bars, candles with wicks, a last-price line, the axes and a few

      </span>
      <span className={styles.tv} aria-hidden="true">

      </span>

}
```
