### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/orders/data.ts`

```ts
// Portfolio → Orders and Positions for US Stocks: the sample orders and positions, every state they can be in, and the
// screen ids. Layout from the F&O dev-handoff file's "Positions & orders" (nLs24dTJdPz9A5pu3AWMbe, 6754:65598), drawn
// there for commodities; the content here is US stocks and ETFs.
// This file is the API contract: an order has one status; the list it sits in (Open / History), its tags, its timeline
// and its dock actions all follow from that status.
// FLAG: hard-coded sample orders (the API would send them).
import { catalogue } from '../../data'
import { ETFS } from '../etf/data'

/** Order Details (one screen, every status). */
export const ORDER_DETAILS = '9001:40'
/** Position Details (a US position's page). */
export const POSITION_DETAILS = '9001:41'

export type OrderSide = 'buy' | 'sell'
export type OrderType = 'market' | 'limit' | 'sl'
/** Stocks or ETFs — the "All orders ⇕" picker splits the lists by it. */
export type AssetKind = 'stock' | 'etf'

/**
 * Where an order is.
 * Open list: `open` (at the exchange, waiting for its price), `queued` (placed while the US market was closed — sent
 * when it opens), `partial` (some shares bought / sold, the rest still waiting).
 * History list: `executed`, `partial-executed` (the day ended with only some shares filled — the rest cancelled),
 * `failed` (rejected by Lemonn's broker or the exchange), `cancelled` (by the user), `expired` (a Day order that never
 * reached its price before the close).
 */
export type OrderStatus = 'open' | 'queued' | 'partial' | 'executed' | 'partial-executed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled' | 'expired'

export const OPEN_STATUSES: OrderStatus[] = ['open', 'queued', 'partial']
export const isOpen = (order: UsOrder) => OPEN_STATUSES.includes(order.status)

/** The status label and its tone (the card maps the tone to an L3 Tag colour: warning → processing, positive → success, negative → error). */
export const STATUS_TAG: Record<OrderStatus, { label: string; tone: 'warning' | 'positive' | 'negative' | 'neutral' }> = {
  open: { label: 'Open', tone: 'warning' },
  queued: { label: 'Queued', tone: 'warning' },
  partial: { label: 'Partly filled', tone: 'warning' },
  executed: { label: 'Executed', tone: 'positive' },
  'partial-executed': { label: 'Partly executed', tone: 'positive' },
  failed: { label: 'Failed', tone: 'negative' },
  cancelled: { label: 'Cancelled', tone: 'neutral' },
  expired: { label: 'Expired', tone: 'neutral' },
}

export const TYPE_LABEL: Record<OrderType, string> = { market: 'Market', limit: 'Limit', sl: 'Stop loss' }

/** One step of Order Details' "Order Status" timeline. `state` colours the dot: done (grey), now (the status colour). */
export type TimelineStep = { label: string; time?: string; state: 'done' | 'now' | 'failed' }

export type UsOrder = {
  id: string
  sym: string
  kind: AssetKind
  side: OrderSide
  type: OrderType
  /** Shares asked for (US shares can be fractional). */
  qty: number
  /** Shares bought / sold so far. */
  filled: number
  /** Limit orders and the limit part of a stop loss. */
  limitPrice?: number
  /** Stop loss: the price that triggers it. */
  triggerPrice?: number
  /** Average price the filled shares went at. */
  avgPrice?: number
  status: OrderStatus
  /** US orders are Day orders. */
  validity: 'Day'
  /** "3 Nov, 9:42 PM" (IST). */
  placedAt: string
  /** Lemonn's order id and the exchange's — both copyable on Order Details. */
  orderId: string
  exchangeId?: string
  /** Why it failed / was cancelled / expired — shown on Order Details. */
  reason?: string
  timeline: TimelineStep[]
}

/** The stock / ETF behind an order or position (name, exchange, live price). */
export function assetFor(item: Pick<UsOrder, 'sym' | 'kind'>): { name: string; exchange: string; price: number } {
  // The live catalogue has ETFs too (from the US snapshot); the ETF list is the fallback for a name.
  const live = catalogue[item.sym]
  const etf = item.kind === 'etf' ? ETFS.find((e) => e.sym === item.sym) : undefined
  return {
    name: etf?.name ?? live?.name ?? item.sym,
    exchange: live?.exchange ?? (item.kind === 'etf' ? 'NYSE ARCA' : 'NASDAQ'),
    price: live?.price ?? etf?.price ?? 0,
  }
}

// The order Order Details shows (set by the card that opens it).

export const getCurrentOrder = () => currentOrder
export function openOrder(go: (figma: string) => void, order: UsOrder) {
  currentOrder = order
  go(ORDER_DETAILS)
}

/** A US position: shares bought or sold today, before they settle into Holdings (T+1). US Stocks are delivery only. */
export type UsPosition = {

}
```

```tsx
// T11 · Fee Breakdown sheet over the order pad (opened from "View Charges" on the SL order).
// FLAG: the sheet's rows are hand-laid: <hr> dividers, "•" bullets typed into labels, small grey notes — not L3 KeyValueList groups.
// FLAG: layout is raw display:flex + gap (FeeBreakdown.module.css), not L3 Stack / Section.
// FLAG: the close button is a hand-made <button> (not an L3 Button) and the sheet draws its own grabber.
import { BottomSheet, BottomSheetHeader } from '@l3/components/BottomSheet'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { KeyValueList, KeyValueRow } from '@l3/components/KeyValueList'
import { useSheetLayer } from '../../components/Phone'
import { useUsNav } from '../../nav'
import { Usd } from '../../../../shared/money'
import { closeIcon } from '../money/icons'
import { useSheetClose } from '../money/useSheetClose'
import { OrderPad } from './OrderPad'
import { tradeIds } from './ids'
import { orderPads } from './orderPads'
import styles from './FeeBreakdown.module.css'

const FEES = { total: 1.13, brokerage: 0.94, charges: 0.02, taxes: 0.17 }

/** The order pad (Shares state) drawn behind, with the fee sheet on top. */
export function FeeBreakdownScreen({ backdrop }: { backdrop?: boolean }) {
  const { back } = useUsNav()
  return <OrderPad config={orderPads[tradeIds.T02]} backdrop sheet={backdrop ? undefined : <FeeBreakdownSheet onClose={() => back(tradeIds.T08)} />} />
}

function FeeBreakdownSheet({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const layer = useSheetLayer()
  const { open, close } = useSheetClose(onClose)
  return (
    <BottomSheet
      open={open}
      onClose={close}
      container={layer}
      aria-labelledby="fee-title"
      header={
        <BottomSheetHeader
          size="sm"
          heading="Fee Breakdown"
          headingId="fee-title"
          trailing={
            <button type="button" className={styles.close} aria-label="Close" onClick={close}>
              <Icon icon={closeIcon} size={24} />
            </button>
          }
        />
      }
      utility={<span className={styles.gesture} aria-hidden="true"><span /></span>}
    >
      <div className={styles.body}>
        <KeyValueList aria-label="Estimated fee">
          <KeyValueRow total label="Estimated Fee" value={<Usd value={FEES.total} align="end" layout="stack" />} />
        </KeyValueList>
        <hr className={styles.divider} />
        <div className={styles.group} data-gap="4">
          <KeyValueList aria-label="Brokerage">
            <KeyValueRow label="Brokerage" value={<Usd value={FEES.brokerage} align="end" layout="stack" />} />
          </KeyValueList>
          <p className={styles.small} data-narrow>Note: Brokerage is 0.25% of the order value. GST at 18% is charged on it.</p>
        </div>
        <hr className={styles.divider} />
        <KeyValueList size="sm" aria-label="Charges">
          <KeyValueRow size="md" label="Charges" value={<Usd value={FEES.charges} align="end" layout="stack" />} />
          <KeyValueRow label="• IFSCA turnover fee" value={<Usd value={FEES.charges} align="end" layout="stack" />} />
        </KeyValueList>
        <hr className={styles.divider} />
        <KeyValueList size="sm" aria-label="Taxes">
          <KeyValueRow size="md" label="Taxes" value={<Usd value={FEES.taxes} align="end" layout="stack" />} />
          <KeyValueRow label="• GST on brokerage" value={<Usd value={FEES.taxes} align="end" layout="stack" />} />
        </KeyValueList>
        <hr className={styles.divider} />
        <p className={styles.small} data-center>Note: The amounts mentioned above are approximate values and may vary slightly at the time of execution.</p>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/trade/OrderPad.tsx`

```tsx
// The Buy / Sell order pad (T01–T10, H03–H05, H11): order type tabs, amount or shares field, limit / trigger prices,
// helper line, and the dock with Avail. / Req. and the main button.
// Layout and look follow the commodity options order pad (F&O fno-25 … 31): header with the price and signed change,
// small pill order types with the validity Select beside them, 40-high bordered rows with L3 Stepper Small, and the
// dock with the note, Avail. · Req. and a Large button. The content (amount in $ or shares, limit / trigger prices as %
// from the last price, chips, the helper line) is the US pad's own.
// FLAG: the amount is a raw <input> in a bordered row, not an L3 field (the commodity pad has no amount field to copy).
// FLAG: the amount field is a plain <input> on the device's own keyboard, not the app's shared Keyboard (src/shared/ui/Keyboard).
// FLAG: duplicates the app's Indian order pad (src/flows/stocks) for US stocks.
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Actionbar } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { PriceChange } from '@l3/components/PriceChange'
import { Stack } from '@l3/components/Stack'
import { Stepper } from '@l3/components/Stepper'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { lmSwitchArrowVertical } from '@l3/icons/lemonnade'
import { Phone } from '../../components/Phone'
import { useUsNav } from '../../nav'
import { Usd, useInrEquivalent, useUsd } from '../../../../shared/money'
import { al, forCurrentStock, il } from './format'
import type { Derived, OrderPadConfig, OrderType, PadMode } from './types'
import styles from './OrderPad.module.css'

const ORDER_TYPES: { value: OrderType; label: string }[] = [
  { value: 'market', label: 'Market' },
  { value: 'limit', label: 'Limit' },
  { value: 'sl', label: 'SL' },
]

/**
 * The pad on screen (its order type, and when it closed — null while it's still shown). The pads are one page (screen
 * group 'order-pad'), so a tap on Market / Limit / SL swaps this pad for another in place: a pad that renders while
 * another is shown, or a moment after one closed, slides its fields in from that side. Opened later, it's a fresh visit.
 */
let shownPad: { type: OrderType; closedAt: number | null } | null = null

/**
 * The order pad. Switching order type keeps the header, tabs and dock in place; only the fields under the tabs slide in —
 * from the right when the new type is further along (Market → Limit → SL), from the left when it's back.
 */
export function OrderPad({ config, backdrop, sheet }: { config: OrderPadConfig; backdrop?: boolean; sheet?: ReactNode }) {
  const { go, back } = useUsNav()
  const usd = useUsd()
  const inr = useInrEquivalent()
  // The unit the field is showing; `value` is always kept in the config's own unit (config.mode).
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<PadMode>(config.mode)
  const [value, setValue] = useState(config.value)
  const [amountText, setAmountText] = useState(String(config.value))
  const [pcts, setPcts] = useState(() => (config.prices ?? []).map((price) => price.pct))

  const prices = pcts.map((pct) => al(config.stock.price, pct))
  // The price one share costs: market price, or the last price field (limit / SL limit).
  const unitPrice = config.type === 'market' ? config.stock.price : (prices[prices.length - 1] ?? config.stock.price)
  const shown = (m: PadMode) => (m === config.mode ? value : Number(m === 'shares' ? (value / unitPrice).toFixed(4) : (value * unitPrice).toFixed(2)))
  const current = shown(mode)
  const setShown = (next: number) => setValue(mode === config.mode ? next : config.mode === 'amount' ? next * unitPrice : next / unitPrice)

  const derived: Derived = config.derive(value, prices, mode, { usd, inr: (n) => inr(n) })
  const ctaDisabled = typeof config.cta.disabled === 'function' ? config.cta.disabled(derived) : config.cta.disabled
  const goTo = (key: keyof NonNullable<OrderPadConfig['to']>) => (config.to?.[key] ? () => go(config.to![key]!) : undefined)
  const onReq = goTo('req')

  const switchMode = () => {
    const next: PadMode = mode === 'amount' ? 'shares' : 'amount'
    if (next === 'amount') setAmountText(String(shown('amount')))
    setMode(next)
  }
  const typeAmount = (text: string) => {
    const cleaned = text.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '').replace(/(\..*)\./g, '$1')
    setAmountText(cleaned)
    setShown(Number(cleaned) || 0)
  }
  const applyChip = (apply: (current: number) => number) => {
    const next = Number(apply(current).toFixed(mode === 'amount' ? 2 : 4))
    setShown(next)
    if (mode === 'amount') setAmountText(String(next))
  }

  const fieldLabel = (label: string, switchable?: boolean) =>
    switchable ? (
      <span className={styles.fieldLabel}>
        <button type="button" className={styles.toggle} onClick={switchMode} aria-label={`${label}. Switch to ${mode === 'amount' ? 'shares' : 'amount'}`}>
          {label}
          <Icon icon={lmSwitchArrowVertical} size={12} />
        </button>
      </span>
    ) : (
      <span className={styles.fieldLabel}>{label}</span>
    )

  // Header as on the commodity order pad (fno-25): the symbol over its price and signed change, the exchange on the right.
  const header = (
    <Actionbar
      headingLevel={1}
      onBack={() => back(config.back)}
      title={
        <span className={styles.contract}>
          <span className={styles.contractName}>{config.stock.symbol}</span>
          <span className={styles.contractPrice}><Usd value={config.stock.price} layout="inline" /><PriceChange value={config.stock.change} unit="percent" size="sm" /></span>
        </span>
      }
      actions={<span className={styles.exchange}>{config.stock.exchange}</span>}
    />
  )

  // Dock as on the commodity order pad: the note above, then Avail. · Req. (a link when it opens something) and the action.
  const reqLabel = onReq
    ? <button type="button" className={styles.req} onClick={onReq}>{config.reqLabel}</button>
    : <span className={styles.muted}>{config.reqLabel}</span>
  const footer = (
    <div className={styles.dock}>
      {derived.note && <p className={styles.note}>{forCurrentStock(derived.note)}</p>}
      <div className={styles.dockBody}>
        <div className={styles.funds}>
          <span><span className={styles.muted}>{config.availLabel}</span> <strong><Usd text={config.avail} layout="inline" /></strong></span>
          <span>{reqLabel}{derived.req && <> <strong>{derived.req}</strong></>}</span>
        </div>
        <Button variant={config.side === 'buy' ? 'brand' : 'sell'} size="lg" fullWidth disabled={ctaDisabled} onClick={goTo('cta')}>
          {config.cta.label}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )

  // Slides the fields in once, when they first attach (a callback ref: the phone mounts its body after this pad renders).
  const [cameFrom] = useState(() => (shownPad && (shownPad.closedAt === null || performance.now() - shownPad.closedAt < 500) ? shownPad.type : undefined))
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const pad = { type: config.type, closedAt: null as number | null }
    shownPad = pad
    return () => { pad.closedAt = performance.now() }
  }, [config.type])
  const slid = useRef(false)
  const fields = (el: HTMLElement | null) => {
    if (!el || slid.current) return
    slid.current = true
    if (!cameFrom || cameFrom === config.type || matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return
    const order = ORDER_TYPES.map((t) => t.value)
    const from = order.indexOf(config.type) > order.indexOf(cameFrom) ? 1 : -1
    el.animate(
      [{ translate: `${from * 100}% 0`, opacity: 0 }, { translate: '0 0', opacity: 1 }],
      { duration: 280, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)' },
    )
  }

  const fieldError = typeof config.fieldError === 'function' ? config.fieldError(derived) : config.fieldError

  return (
    <Phone label={forCurrentStock(config.label)} header={header} footer={footer} gesture="none" topLine>
      <Stack gap="16" className={styles.body} inert={backdrop || undefined}>
        <Stack direction="horizontal" align="center" justify="between">
          {/* FLAG: order type switch is L3 Tabs (pill, toggle) but its choice also goes to another screen of the same page group. */}
          <Tabs
            appearance="pill"
            size="sm"
            behavior="toggle"
            aria-label="Order type"
            items={ORDER_TYPES}
            value={config.type}
            onChange={(type) => {
              const target = config.to?.[type]
              if (type !== config.type && target) go(target)
            }}
          />
          {/* US orders are Day orders only: the validity is a label (a Tag), not the commodity pad's Select — nothing to pick. */}
          <Tag variant="secondary" color="neutral" aria-label="Validity: Day">Day</Tag>
        </Stack>
        {/* The part that changes with the order type: it slides, the tabs above it stay put. */}
        <Stack gap="16" ref={fields}>
          <div className={styles.field} data-error={fieldError || undefined}>
            {mode === 'amount' ? (
              <>
                {fieldLabel('Amount', config.toggle)}
                <input className={styles.amount} inputMode="decimal" aria-label="Amount in dollars" value={`$${amountText}`} onChange={(e) => typeAmount(e.target.value)} />
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                {fieldLabel('Shares', config.toggle)}
                <Stepper
                  size="sm"
                  className={styles.stepper}
                  label="Shares"
                  value={current}
                  onChange={setShown}
                  min={mode === config.mode ? (config.min ?? 0) : 0}
                  step={1}
                  autoCorrect={mode === config.mode && (config.min ?? 0) >= 1}
                  format={il}
                />
              </>
            )}
          </div>
          {(config.prices ?? []).map((price, i) => (
            <div className={styles.field} key={price.label}>
              {fieldLabel(price.label)}
              <span className={styles.fieldValue}><Usd value={prices[i]} layout="inline" /></span>
              <Stepper
                size="sm"
                className={styles.stepper}
                label={`${price.label} % from last price`}
                value={pcts[i]}
                onChange={(pct) => setPcts((all) => all.map((old, j) => (j === i ? pct : old)))}
                min={-20}
                max={20}
                step={0.5}
                format={(pct) => `${pct.toFixed(1)}%`}
              />
            </div>
          ))}
          {derived.error && <p className={styles.error}>{forCurrentStock(derived.error)}</p>}
          {(derived.left || derived.right) && (
            <div className={styles.helper}>
              <span>{derived.left}</span>
              <span>{derived.right}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          {config.chips && mode === config.mode && (
            <Tabs
              appearance="pill"
              size="sm"
              behavior="filter"
              aria-label={mode === 'amount' ? 'Add amount' : 'Shares to sell'}
              items={config.chips.map((chip, i) => ({ value: String(i), label: typeof chip.label === 'function' ? chip.label(usd) : chip.label }))}
              value=""
              onChange={(label) => {
                const chip = config.chips?.[Number(label)]
                if (chip) applyChip(chip.apply)
              }}
            />
          )}
        </Stack>
      </Stack>
      {sheet}
    </Phone>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/trade/OrderResult.tsx`

```tsx
// Order result screen: processing spinner, success tick or error cross, title, order rows, optional note and actions.
// FLAG: layout is raw display:flex + gap/padding (OrderResult.module.css), not L3 Stack / Section / Inset.
// FLAG: result art (success / error SVGs, hand-spun loading arc) is the teammate's, not an L3 / app result pattern.
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@l3/components/ButtonGroup'
import { KeyValueList, KeyValueRow } from '@l3/components/KeyValueList'
import { Phone } from '../../components/Phone'
import { InlineSvg } from '../../components/InlineSvg'
import { useUsNav } from '../../nav'
import { Usd } from '../../../../shared/money'
import { MaskImage } from '../money/components/MaskImage'
import { forCurrentStock } from './format'
import type { OrderResultConfig } from './types'
import styles from './OrderResult.module.css'

/** After 2 s on the processing screen, move on to `to` (not when it is only drawn behind another screen). */
export function useAutoAdvance(to: string, backdrop?: boolean) {
  const { go } = useUsNav()
  // `go` is a new function on every render of the nav provider; keep the timer from restarting because of that.
  const goRef = useRef(go)
  goRef.current = go
  useEffect(() => {
    if (backdrop) return
    const timer = setTimeout(() => goRef.current(to), 2000)
    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [backdrop, to])
}

export function OrderResult({ config }: { config: OrderResultConfig }) {
  const { back, go } = useUsNav()
  const exit = () => back(config.back)
  const footer = config.actions?.length ? (
    <ButtonGroup direction="horizontal" aria-label="Order result">
      {config.actions.map((action) => (
        <Button key={action.label} variant={action.variant} size="lg" onClick={action.to ? () => go(action.to!) : action.exit ? exit : undefined}>
          {action.label}
        </Button>
      ))}
    </ButtonGroup>
  ) : undefined
  return (
    <Phone label={forCurrentStock(config.label)} footer={footer} gesture="none">
      <div className={styles.content}>
        <span className={styles.art} aria-hidden="true">
          {config.art === 'loading' ? (
            <MaskImage src="assets/trade/loading-arc.svg" w={72} className={styles.spinner} />
          ) : (
            <InlineSvg src={`assets/trade/${config.art}.svg`} w={72} />
          )}
        </span>
        <div className={styles.title} role={config.art === 'loading' ? 'status' : undefined}>
          <h1 className={styles.heading}>{forCurrentStock(config.title)}</h1>
          <p className={styles.description}>{forCurrentStock(config.description)}</p>
        </div>
        <KeyValueList variant="card" size="md" aria-label="Order details">
          {config.rows.map(([label, value]) => (
            <KeyValueRow key={label} label={label} value={<Usd text={value} align="end" />} />
          ))}
        </KeyValueList>
        {config.note && <p className={styles.note}>{forCurrentStock(config.note)}</p>}
      </div>
    </Phone>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/trade/format.ts`

```ts
import { currentStock } from '../../data'

/** A share count without float noise: 0.5307, 2.5. */
export const il = (n: number) => String(Number(n.toFixed(4)))
/** A price moved by a percentage from the last price. */
export const al = (price: number, pct: number) => Number((price * (1 + pct / 100)).toFixed(2))

/** The copy is written for NVDA; for any other stock opened from the stock page, the symbol is swapped in. */
export const forCurrentStock = (text: string) => {
  const sym = currentStock().sym
  return sym === 'NVDA' ? text : text.replace(/\bNVDA\b/g, sym)
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/trade/orderPads.tsx`

```tsx
// The order pad's states — Buy (T01–T10) and Sell (H03–H05, H11) — as data: what the pad shows, what the helper line
// says, and where the buttons go. OrderPad.tsx renders one of these.
import { currentStock } from '../../data'
import feeStyles from './FeeBreakdown.module.css'
import { tradeIds as ids } from './ids'
import { il } from './format'
import type { Derived, OrderPadConfig, PadChip, PadMode, PadMoney, PadStock } from './types'

/** The stock being traded: the one tapped last (read live, so the pad follows the stock page). */
const liveStock: PadStock = {
  get symbol() { return currentStock().sym },
  get price() { return currentStock().price },
  get change() { return currentStock().change },
  get exchange() { return currentStock().exchange ?? 'NASDAQ' },
}
/** A stock that only trades in whole shares. */
const brkB: PadStock = { symbol: 'BRK.B', price: 498.3, change: 0.42, exchange: 'NYSE' }

/** Order value → amount charged (0.3% on top). */
const CHARGE_FACTOR = 1.003
/** Shares held in the Sell screens. */
const HELD_SHARES = 2.5307
/** Shares that $100 buys in the Shares screen. */
const SHARES_FOR_100 = 0.5307
const AVAILABLE_USD = 520.4
const LIVE_NOTE = 'US market is live till 2:30 AM IST'
export const SELL_NOTE = '👉 Note : Sale money can be withdrawn after 1 working day'

/** "+$10" chip: adds to the current value. */
const addChip = (usd: number): PadChip => ({ label: (fmt) => `+${fmt(usd, { decimals: 0 })}`, apply: (value) => value + usd })
/** "Max" chip: sets the field to a fixed value. */
const setChip = (label: PadChip['label'], value: number): PadChip => ({ label, apply: () => value })
/** "25%" chip: a share of the shares held. */
const heldChip = (label: string, share: number): PadChip => ({ label, apply: () => HELD_SHARES * share })

/** The helper line + "Req." for a market buy. */
const marketBuy = () => (value: number, _prices: number[], mode: PadMode, { usd, inr }: PadMoney): Derived => ({
  left: mode === 'shares' ? `≈ ${usd(value)}` : `≈ ${(value / liveStock.price).toFixed(4)} shares`,
  right: inr(value),
  req: usd(value * CHARGE_FACTOR),
})
/** Adds a note under the helper line. */
const withNote = (derive: OrderPadConfig['derive'], note: string): OrderPadConfig['derive'] => (value, prices, mode, money) => ({ ...derive(value, prices, mode, money), note })

const heldHint = (value: number, mode: PadMode) => (mode === 'amount' ? `≈ ${il(value)} of your ${il(HELD_SHARES)} shares` : `You hold ${il(HELD_SHARES)} shares`)
const sellLimitError = (value: number) => (value > HELD_SHARES ? `You can sell up to ${il(HELD_SHARES)} shares` : undefined)

const buy = (config: Partial<OrderPadConfig> & Pick<OrderPadConfig, 'label' | 'type' | 'mode' | 'value' | 'derive'>): OrderPadConfig => ({
  side: 'buy',
  stock: liveStock,
  availLabel: 'Avail.',
  avail: '$520.40',
  reqLabel: 'Req.',
  cta: { label: 'Buy' },
  back: ids.stockStatus,
  ...config,
})

const sell = (config: Partial<OrderPadConfig> & Pick<OrderPadConfig, 'label' | 'value' | 'avail' | 'derive'>): OrderPadConfig => ({
  side: 'sell',
  stock: liveStock,
  type: 'market',
  mode: 'shares',
  toggle: true,
  availLabel: 'Avail. Qty',
  reqLabel: 'View Charges',
  cta: { label: 'Sell', disabled: (derived) => !!derived.error },
  back: ids.stockStatus,
  ...config,
})

const fullBuyChips = [addChip(10), addChip(50), addChip(100), setChip('Max', AVAILABLE_USD / CHARGE_FACTOR)]
const heldChips = [heldChip('25%', 0.25), heldChip('50%', 0.5), heldChip('Max', 1)]

export const orderPads: Record<string, OrderPadConfig> = {
  [ids.T01]: buy({
    label: 'Buy NVDA · Amount',
    type: 'market',
    mode: 'amount',
    toggle: true,
    value: 100,
    chips: fullBuyChips,
    derive: withNote(marketBuy(), LIVE_NOTE),
    to: { toggle: ids.T02, limit: ids.T07, sl: ids.T08, cta: ids.T12 },
  }),
  [ids.T02]: buy({
    label: 'Buy NVDA · Shares',
    type: 'market',
    mode: 'shares',
    toggle: true,
    value: SHARES_FOR_100,
    derive: (value, _prices, mode, { usd, inr }) => ({
      left: mode === 'amount' ? `≈ ${il(value)} shares` : `≈ ${usd((value / SHARES_FOR_100) * 100)}`,
      right: inr(value * liveStock.price),
      req: usd((value / SHARES_FOR_100) * 100 * CHARGE_FACTOR),
      note: LIVE_NOTE,
    }),
    to: { limit: ids.T07, sl: ids.T08, cta: ids.T12 },
  }),
  [ids.T03]: buy({
    label: 'Buy NVDA · Empty US wallet',
    type: 'market',
    mode: 'amount',
    toggle: true,
    value: 10,
    avail: '$0.00',
    cta: { label: 'Add Money' },
    to: { cta: '5776:84630' },
    chips: [addChip(10), addChip(50), addChip(100)],
    derive: (value, prices, mode, money) => ({ ...marketBuy()(value, prices, mode, money), error: 'Your US wallet is empty. Orders start at $1.', note: LIVE_NOTE }),
  }),
  [ids.T04]: buy({
    label: 'Buy NVDA · Short of money',
    type: 'market',
    mode: 'amount',
    toggle: true,
    value: 100,
    avail: '$42.38',
    cta: { label: 'Add Money' },
    to: { cta: '5776:84630' },
    chips: [addChip(10), addChip(50), addChip(100), setChip((usd) => `Max ${usd(42.25)}`, 42.25)],
    derive: (value, prices, mode, money) => {
      const { usd } = money
      const short = value * CHARGE_FACTOR - 42.38
      return short > 0
        ? { req: usd(value * CHARGE_FACTOR), error: `Available Amount is short by ${usd(short)}`, note: LIVE_NOTE }
        : { ...marketBuy()(value, prices, mode, money), note: LIVE_NOTE }
    },
  }),
  [ids.T09]: buy({
    label: 'Buy NVDA · US market closed',
    type: 'market',
    mode: 'amount',
    toggle: true,
    value: 100,
    chips: fullBuyChips,
    derive: withNote(marketBuy(), 'Order will be placed once the US market opens at 8:00 PM IST on Thursday, Nov 5. Shares are worked out at the opening price.'),
    to: { cta: ids.T12 },
  }),
  [ids.T10]: buy({
    label: 'Buy NVDA · US market holiday',
    type: 'market',
    mode: 'amount',
    toggle: true,
    value: 100,
    chips: fullBuyChips,
    derive: withNote(
      marketBuy(),
      'US markets are closed on Thursday, Nov 26 for Thanksgiving. Order will be placed once the market opens at 8:00 PM IST on Friday, Nov 27. Shares are worked out at the opening price.',
    ),
  }),
  [ids.T06]: buy({
    label: 'Buy BRK.B · Whole shares only',
    stock: brkB,
    type: 'market',
    mode: 'shares',
    value: 1,
    min: 1,
    derive: (value, _prices, _mode, { usd, inr }) => ({
      left: 'BRK.B trades in whole shares only',
      right: inr(value * brkB.price),
      req: usd(value * brkB.price * CHARGE_FACTOR),
      note: LIVE_NOTE,
    }),
    to: { limit: ids.T07, sl: ids.T08, cta: ids.T12 },
  }),
  [ids.T07]: buy({
    label: 'Buy NVDA · Limit',
    type: 'limit',
    mode: 'amount',
    toggle: true,
    value: 100,
    prices: [{ label: 'Limit', pct: -1 }],
    derive: (value, [limit], mode, { usd, inr }) => ({
      left: mode === 'shares' ? `≈ ${usd(value)} at your limit price` : `≈ ${(value / limit).toFixed(4)} shares at your limit price`,
      right: inr(value),
      req: usd(value * CHARGE_FACTOR),
      note: `Buys only if NVDA trades at ${usd(limit)} or lower today`,
    }),
    to: { sl: ids.T08, market: ids.T01, cta: ids.T12 },
  }),
  [ids.T08]: buy({
    label: 'Buy NVDA · SL',
    type: 'sl',
    mode: 'shares',
    value: 2,
    min: 1,
    prices: [{ label: 'Trigger Price', pct: 3.5 }, { label: 'Limit', pct: 4 }],
    derive: (value, [trigger, limit], _mode, { usd, inr }) => ({
      left: `≈ ${usd(value * limit)} at your limit price`,
      right: inr(value * limit),
      req: usd(value * limit * CHARGE_FACTOR),
      note: `Buys at up to ${usd(limit)} once NVDA reaches ${usd(trigger)}`,
    }),
    to: { req: ids.T11, cta: ids.T12, market: ids.T01, limit: ids.T07 },
  }),
  [ids.H03]: sell({
    label: 'Sell NVDA · Holding',
    value: HELD_SHARES,
    avail: il(HELD_SHARES),
    reqLabel: 'Proceeds',
    chips: heldChips,
    derive: (value, _prices, mode, { usd }) => ({ left: heldHint(value, mode), right: usd(476.84), req: usd(value * 187.865), error: sellLimitError(value), note: SELL_NOTE }),
    to: { cta: ids.H06 },
  }),
  [ids.H04]: sell({
    label: 'Sell NVDA · No shares',
    value: 1,
    avail: '0',
    fieldError: true,
    derive: () => ({ error: 'Your account has no shares to sell', note: SELL_NOTE }),
    cta: { label: 'Sell', disabled: true },
  }),
  [ids.H05]: sell({
    label: 'Sell NVDA · More than you hold',
    value: 3,
    avail: il(HELD_SHARES),
    fieldError: (derived) => !!derived.error,
    chips: heldChips,
    derive: (value, _prices, mode, { usd }) => ({ left: heldHint(value, mode), right: usd(476.84), error: sellLimitError(value), note: SELL_NOTE }),
  }),
  [ids.H11]: sell({
    label: 'Sell NVDA · Open buy order',
    value: HELD_SHARES,
    avail: '0',
    fieldError: true,
    derive: () => ({
      error: 'You have an open buy order for NVDA. You can sell once it executes, or after you cancel it.',
      left: `${il(HELD_SHARES)} shares on hold`,
      right: <span className={feeStyles.link}>View Order</span>,
      note: SELL_NOTE,
    }),
    cta: { label: 'Sell', disabled: true },
    to: { cta: ids.H06 },
  }),
}
```

```ts
// The order result screens as data: processing (T12), buy created / executed / rejected (T13–T15), sell executed /
// rejected (H06, H07). OrderResult.tsx renders one of these.
import { tradeIds as ids } from './ids'
import { SELL_NOTE } from './orderPads'
import type { OrderResultConfig } from './types'


const orderRows: [string, string][] = [
  ['Order Value', '$376.84'],
  ['Number of Shares', '2'],
  ['Order Type', 'Market'],
  ['Validity', 'Day'],
]

/** A brand button that leaves the screen (back), or goes to `to`. */
const brandAction = (label: string, to?: string) => ({ label, variant: 'brand' as const, exit: true, to })
/** "Order Details" (secondary, does nothing) + a brand button. */
const detailsAndBrand = (label: string, to: string) => [{ label: 'Order Details', variant: 'secondary' as const }, brandAction(label, to)]

export const orderResults: Record<string, OrderResultConfig> = {
  [ids.T12]: { label: 'Order processing', art: 'loading', title: 'We are working on it', description: 'This may take a few seconds', rows: orderRows, back: ids.T01 },
  [ids.T13]: {
    label: 'Buy order created',
    art: 'success',
    title: 'Yay! Buy Order Created',
    description: 'Your order to buy NVDA is successfully created',
    rows: orderRows,
    note: 'The US market is closed. Your order will be sent when it opens at 8:00 PM IST.',
    actions: [brandAction('View Orders')],
    back: ids.stockStatus,
  },
  [ids.T14]: {
    label: 'Buy order executed',
    art: 'success',
    title: 'Yay! Buy Order Executed',
    description: 'Execution successful of an order to buy 2 qty of NVDA',
    rows: [['Order Value', '$376.84'], ['Number of Shares', '2'], ['Avg. Price', '$188.42'], ['Validity', 'Day']],
    actions: detailsAndBrand('Holdings', ids.stockStatus),
    back: ids.stockStatus,
  },
  [ids.T15]: {
    label: 'Buy order rejected',
    art: 'error',
    title: 'Oops! Buy Order not Placed',
    description: 'We could not place your order to buy NVDA at the exchange: Trading in this stock is temporarily halted',
    rows: orderRows,
    actions: [brandAction('Okay')],
    back: ids.stockStatus,
  },
  [ids.H06]: {
    label: 'Sell order executed',
    art: 'success',
    title: 'Yay! Sell Order Executed',
    description: 'Execution successful of an order to sell 2 qty of NVDA',
    rows: [['Order Value', '$385.20'], ['Number of Shares', '2'], ['Avg. Price', '$192.60'], ['Validity', 'Day']],
    note: SELL_NOTE,
    actions: detailsAndBrand('Holdings', ids.stockStatus),
    back: ids.stockStatus,
  },
  [ids.H07]: {
    label: 'Sell order rejected',
    art: 'error',
    title: 'Oops! Sell Order not Placed',
    description: 'We could not place your order to sell NVDA at the exchange: Trading in this stock is temporarily halted',
    rows: orderRows,
    actions: [brandAction('Okay')],
    back: ids.stockStatus,
  },
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/trade/types.ts`

```ts
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import type { MoneyFormat } from '../../../../shared/money'

/** The stock the order pad is for. */
export type PadStock = { symbol: string; price: number; change: number; exchange: string }

export type OrderType = 'market' | 'limit' | 'sl'
/** What the main field counts: dollars or shares. */
export type PadMode = 'amount' | 'shares'

/** The money formatters a `derive` gets (hooks can't run in data): `usd` = a $ amount as text (₹ with the switch on ₹), `inr` = the "≈ ₹…" hint (nothing unless "₹ below"). */
export type PadMoney = { usd: (n: number, format?: MoneyFormat) => string; inr: (n: number) => string | undefined }

/** What the pad shows under the field, worked out from the entered value. */
export type Derived = {
  left?: ReactNode
  right?: ReactNode
  /** "Req." / "Proceeds" value in the dock. */
  req?: string
  error?: string
  note?: string
}

/** A quick-fill chip: sets the field to `apply(current value)`. */
export type PadChip = { label: string | ((usd: PadMoney['usd']) => string); apply: (current: number) => number }

/** One order pad screen (Buy / Sell, per state). */
export type OrderPadConfig = {
  /** Screen label (aria-label) — "NVDA" is swapped for the current stock. */
  label: string
  side: 'buy' | 'sell'
  stock: PadStock
  type: OrderType
  /** Which unit `value` is in. */
  mode: PadMode
  /** Show the amount / shares switch in the field label. */
  toggle?: boolean
  value: number
  /** Smallest shares value (whole-share stocks). */
  min?: number
  /** Price fields under the main one (limit, trigger), as % from the last price. */
  prices?: { label: string; pct: number }[]
  chips?: PadChip[]
  availLabel: string
  avail: string
  reqLabel: string
  cta: { label: string; disabled?: boolean | ((derived: Derived) => boolean) }
  /** Screen the back arrow goes to. */
  back: string
  derive: (value: number, prices: number[], mode: PadMode, money: PadMoney) => Derived
  /** Red border on the field. */
  fieldError?: boolean | ((derived: Derived) => boolean)
  /** Where taps go: order type tabs (market / limit / sl), the "Req." link, the main button. */
  to?: Partial<Record<'toggle' | 'market' | 'limit' | 'sl' | 'req' | 'cta', string>>
}

/** One order result screen (processing, executed, rejected …). */
export type OrderResultConfig = {
  label: string
  art: 'loading' | 'success' | 'error'
  title: string
  description: string
  rows: [string, string][]
  note?: string
  actions?: { label: string; variant: 'brand' | 'secondary'; to?: string; exit?: boolean }[]
  /** Screen "exit" actions go back to. */
  back: string
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/wallet/BalanceCard.tsx`

```tsx
// The big balance card on top of the wallet: a rolling-digits ticker for the amount, and several "looks" the teammate tried
// (the wallet itself uses `dashed`). Digits roll to the new value when the amount changes; switching INR <-> USD flips
// from the previous tab's amount (passed through sessionStorage).
// FLAG: hand-made balance card + digit ticker + split bar (not L3 Card/KeyValueList); raw display:flex/grid in the CSS.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { chevronRightIcon } from './lib/icons'
import styles from './BalanceCard.module.css'

/** sessionStorage key: the amount of the tab we came from, so the digits roll from it. */
export const FLIP_KEY = 'wallet:flipFrom'

/** Reads (and clears) the amount the previous wallet tab left behind. */
const takeFlipFrom = (): string | null => {
  try {
    const value = sessionStorage.getItem(FLIP_KEY)
    sessionStorage.removeItem(FLIP_KEY)
    return value
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

/** "₹1,100.00" -> ["₹", "1,100.00"]. */
export const splitCurrency = (amount: string): [string, string] => {
  const match = amount.trim().match(/^([^\d-]*)(.*)$/)
  return [match?.[1] ?? '', match?.[2] ?? amount]
}

/** The number in an amount, e.g. "$1,234.50" -> 1234.5. */
export const amountValue = (amount: string) => Number(splitCurrency(amount)[1].replace(/,/g, '')) || 0

/** Big amounts shorten to ₹ 1.23 Cr / $ 1.23 M; null when the amount is small enough to show in full. */
export const compactAmount = (amount: string): { figures: string; unit: string } | null => {
  const [prefix, rest] = splitCurrency(amount)
  const n = Number(rest.replace(/,/g, '')) || 0
  if (prefix.includes('₹') && n >= 1e7) return { figures: (n / 1e7).toFixed(2), unit: 'Cr' }
  if (prefix.includes('$') && n >= 1e6) return { figures: (n / 1e6).toFixed(2), unit: 'M' }
  return null
}

const DIGITS = [...'0123456789']

/** A piece of text that slides in when it changes (`fresh`: animate on first show too). */
function Swap({ fresh, children, className }: { fresh: boolean; children: ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  const [animate] = useState(fresh)
  return (
    <span className={[styles.swap, className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')} data-fresh={animate || undefined}>
      {children}
    </span>
  )
}

/** The amount's figures as a row of rolling-digit slots. `from`: the figures to roll from on first show. */
function Ticker({ value, from }: { value: string; from?: string | null }) {
  const [text, setText] = useState(from ?? value)
  const [width, setWidth] = useState((from ?? value).length)
  const [live, setLive] = useState(false)
  const timer = useRef(0)

  useEffect(() => {
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      setLive(true)
      setText((previous) => {
        setWidth(Math.max(previous.length, value.length))
        return value
      })
      window.clearTimeout(timer.current)
      timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setWidth(value.length), 900)
    })
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame)
  }, [value])
  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), [])

  const slots = Math.max(text.length, width)
  const dot = text.indexOf('.')
  const decimals = dot < 0 ? -1 : text.length - 1 - dot

  return (
    <span className={styles.ticker} data-live={live || undefined}>
      {Array.from({ length: slots }, (_, i) => {
        const fromRight = slots - 1 - i
        const char = text[text.length - 1 - fromRight] ?? ''
        const style = { '--delay': `${i * 45}ms` } as CSSProperties
        const dim = fromRight <= decimals || undefined
        return /\d/.test(char) ? (
          <span key={fromRight} className={styles.slot} data-dim={dim} style={style}>
            <span className={`${styles.face} ${styles.sizer}`}>{char}</span>
            <span className={styles.roller} style={{ '--d': Number(char) } as CSSProperties}>
              {DIGITS.map((digit) => (
                <span key={digit} className={styles.face}>
                  {digit}
                </span>
              ))}
            </span>
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span key={fromRight} className={styles.slot} data-dim={dim} data-empty={char === '' || undefined} style={style}>
            <Swap key={char} fresh={live} className={styles.face}>
              {char}
            </Swap>
          </span>
        )
      })}
    </span>
  )
}

export type BalanceFact = { label: string; value: string }
export type BalanceLook = 'dashed' | 'centred' | 'centred-facts' | 'centred-surface' | 'centred-line' | 'statement' | 'surface' | 'bar' | 'open'

export type BalanceCardProps = {
  /** The balance, e.g. "$520.40" or "₹1,100.00". */
  total: string
  /** Small label/value pairs shown by the facts-style looks. */
  facts?: BalanceFact[]
  /** Tap on "View details" / "Withdrawable". */
  onDetails?: () => void
  /** Static: no roll-in animation, and ignores the previous tab's amount (used for backdrops). */
  still?: boolean
  look?: BalanceLook
  /** `?link=1|2|3` experiment: how the card joins the tabs above it. */
  link?: string
  /** Content revealed under the card (grows out of its bottom edge). */
  extra?: ReactNode
  /** The withdrawable amount, shown as a ghost button under the balance (`dashed` look). */
  withdrawable?: string
  /** Which wallet it is. Default: read from the amount's symbol — pass it when a USD balance is shown in ₹ (the $ / ₹ switch). */
  currency?: 'INR' | 'USD'
  /** A line under the amount (the "≈ ₹…" equivalent of a $ balance). */
  below?: ReactNode
}

export function BalanceCard({ total, facts = [], onDetails, still, look = 'dashed', link, extra, withdrawable, currency: wallet, below }: BalanceCardProps) {
  const [flipFrom] = useState(() => {
    const from = still ? null : takeFlipFrom()
    return from && from !== total ? from : null
  })
  const mounted = useRef(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    mounted.current = true
  }, [])
  const fresh = !!flipFrom || mounted.current

  const [prefix, figures] = splitCurrency(total)
  const compact = compactAmount(total)
  const rollFrom = flipFrom ? (compactAmount(flipFrom)?.figures ?? splitCurrency(flipFrom)[1]) : null
  const currency = wallet ?? (prefix.includes('₹') ? 'INR' : 'USD')
  const centred = look === 'dashed' || look.startsWith('centred')
  const label = centred ? `${currency} balance` : `${currency} BALANCE`

  const detailsButton = (
    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className={styles.details} iconRight={<Icon icon={chevronRightIcon} size={16} />} onClick={onDetails}>
      {centred ? 'View details' : 'Details'}
    </Button>
  )

  const rows = facts.map((fact) => ({ ...fact, n: amountValue(fact.value) }))
  const sum = rows.reduce((acc, row) => acc + row.n, 0) || 1

  const card = (
    <section className={styles.hero} data-look={look} data-link={link} data-extra={extra ? '' : undefined} aria-label={`${currency} balance ${total}`}>
      <div className={styles.head}>
        <p className={styles.label}>
          <Swap key={label} fresh={fresh}>
            {label}
          </Swap>
        </p>
        {!centred && detailsButton}
      </div>
      <p className={styles.amount} aria-hidden="true">
        <span className={styles.sign}>
          <Swap key={prefix} fresh={fresh}>
            {prefix}
          </Swap>
        </span>
        <Ticker value={compact?.figures ?? figures} from={rollFrom} />
        {compact && (
          <span className={styles.unit} data-unit={compact.unit}>
            <Swap key={compact.unit} fresh={fresh}>
              {compact.unit}
            </Swap>
          </span>
        )}
      </p>
      {below && <p className={styles.exact}>{below}</p>}
      {compact && (
        <p className={styles.exact}>
          <Swap key={total} fresh={fresh}>
            {total}
          </Swap>
        </p>
      )}
      {look === 'centred-line' && facts.length > 0 && (
        <p className={styles.line}>
          {facts.map((fact, i) => (
            <span key={fact.label}>
              {i > 0 && <span className={styles.sep}>·</span>}
              {fact.label}{' '}
              <b>
                <Swap key={fact.value} fresh={fresh}>
                  {fact.value}
                </Swap>
              </b>
            </span>
          ))}
        </p>
      )}
      {look === 'centred-facts' && facts.length > 0 && (
        <dl className={styles.facts}>
          {facts.map((fact) => (
            <div key={fact.label}>
              <dt>{fact.label}</dt>
              <dd>
                <Swap key={fact.value} fresh={fresh}>
                  {fact.value}
                </Swap>
              </dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}
      {look === 'dashed' && withdrawable ? (
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          className={`${styles.details} ${styles.withdrawable}`}
          iconRight={<Icon icon={chevronRightIcon} size={16} />}
          onClick={onDetails}
        >
          Withdrawable{' '}
          <b>
            <Swap key={withdrawable} fresh={fresh}>
              {withdrawable}
            </Swap>
          </b>
        </Button>
      ) : (
        centred && detailsButton
      )}
      {look === 'bar' && rows.length > 0 && (
        <div className={styles.split}>
          <span className={styles.bar} aria-hidden="true">
            {rows.map((row, i) => (
              <span key={i} data-i={i} style={{ flexGrow: row.n / sum }} />
            ))}
          </span>
          <ul className={styles.legend}>
            {rows.map((row, i) => (
              <li key={i}>
                <span className={styles.key} data-i={i} />
                {row.label}
                <b>
                  <Swap key={row.value} fresh={fresh}>
                    {row.value}
                  </Swap>
                </b>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
      {(look === 'statement' || look === 'surface' || look === 'open') && facts.length > 0 && (
        <dl className={styles.facts}>
          {facts.map((fact) => (
            <div key={fact.label}>
              <dt>{fact.label}</dt>
              <dd>
                <Swap key={fact.value} fresh={fresh}>
                  {fact.value}
                </Swap>
              </dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}
    </section>
  )

  return extra ? (
    <div className={styles.group} data-still={still || undefined}>
      {card}
      <div className={styles.reveal}>
        <div className={styles.extraBelow}>{extra}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  ) : (
    card
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/wallet/BalanceDetails.tsx`

```tsx
// W2d / W2d-x · Balance Details: the wallet's balance broken into opening balance, credits, debits and settlement.
// "Credits" and "Debits" expand into their rows (the expanded screen is a separate Figma frame, so the toggle navigates).
// FLAG: raw <hr> dividers and a hand-made body layout (see BalanceDetails.module.css); the "👉 Note" copy has an emoji.
import { Actionbar } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { KeyValueList, KeyValueRow } from '@l3/components/KeyValueList'
import { Phone } from '../../components/Phone'
import { useUsNav } from '../../nav'
import { Usd } from '../../../../shared/money'
import { CREDIT_ROWS, DEBIT_ROWS, FIGMA } from './data'
import { chevronDownIcon } from './lib/icons'
import styles from './BalanceDetails.module.css'

export function BalanceDetails({ expanded = false }: { expanded?: boolean }) {
  const { go, back } = useUsNav()

  const toggle = (name: string) => (
    <Button
      variant="ghost"
      size="sm"
      iconLeft={<Icon icon={chevronDownIcon} size={16} />}
      aria-label={`${expanded ? 'Hide' : 'Show'} ${name}`}
      aria-expanded={expanded}
      onClick={() => !expanded && go(FIGMA.balanceDetailsExpanded)}
    />
  )

  const group = (label: string, value: string, rows: [string, string][]) => (
    <KeyValueList size="sm" aria-label={label}>
      <KeyValueRow size="md" label={label} value={<Usd text={value} align="end" />} valueEnd={toggle(label.toLowerCase())} />
      {expanded && rows.map(([rowLabel, rowValue]) => <KeyValueRow key={rowLabel} label={rowLabel} value={<Usd text={rowValue} align="end" layout="inline" />} />)}
    </KeyValueList>
  )

  return (
    <Phone
      label={expanded ? 'Balance Details, Credits and Debits expanded' : 'Balance Details'}
      gesture="none"
      header={
        <Actionbar
          title="Balance Details"
          onBack={() => back(FIGMA.walletUsActivate)}
          actions={
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
              Help
            </Button>
          }
        />
      }
    >
      <div className={styles.body}>
        <KeyValueList aria-label="Available balance">
          <KeyValueRow total label="Available Bal." value={<Usd text="$520.40" align="end" />} />
        </KeyValueList>
        <hr className={styles.divider} />
        <KeyValueList size="sm" aria-label="Opening balance">
          <KeyValueRow size="md" label="Opening balance" value={<Usd text="$350.00" align="end" />} />
        </KeyValueList>
        {group('Credits', '$621.80', CREDIT_ROWS)}
        {group('Debits', '$451.40', DEBIT_ROWS)}
        <hr className={styles.divider} />
        <KeyValueList aria-label="Withdrawable balance">
          <KeyValueRow total label="Withdrawable Bal." value={<Usd text="$417.03" align="end" />} />
        </KeyValueList>
        <div className={styles.settlement}>
          <KeyValueList aria-label="Settlement pending">
            <KeyValueRow label="Settlement Pending" value={<Usd text="$103.37" align="end" />} />
          </KeyValueList>
          <p className={styles.note}>👉 Note : Sale money can be withdrawn after 1 working day</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Phone>
  )
}
```

```css
.stage {
  /* coin shades from L3 success green: light, base, and base darkened with static black for the rim and ink */
  --hi: var(--l3-border-accent-success-light);
  --mid: var(--l3-content-accent-success-default);
  --lo: var(--l3-surface-accent-success-default);
  --rim: color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-content-accent-success-default) 60%, var(--l3-static-black));
  --ink: color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-content-accent-success-default) 45%, var(--l3-static-black));
  place-items:center;
  /* FLAG: fixed 96x64 px stage and 44/36 px coins; hand-made coin art, not an L3 illustration */
  width:96px;
  height:64px;
  display:grid;
  position:relative;
}

.coin {
  border-radius:50%;
  place-items:center;
  width:44px;
  height:44px;
  display:grid;
  position:absolute;
  overflow:hidden;
}

.coin[data-side=inr] {
  width:36px;
  height:36px;
  color:var(--l3-base-neutral-charcoal-900);
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 32% 26%, var(--l3-base-neutral-charcoal-600), var(--l3-base-neutral-charcoal-700) 50%, var(--l3-base-neutral-charcoal-800));
  box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--l3-base-neutral-charcoal-900), inset 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-black) 25%, transparent), inset 0 2px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-white) 12%, transparent);
  translate:-15px 7px;
}

.lead {
  width:44px;
  height:44px;
  animation:.9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) .25s both lead-in,4.5s ease-in-out 1.15s infinite alternate drift;
  position:absolute;
  translate:11px -1px;
}

.coin[data-side=usd] {
  color:var(--ink);
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 32% 26%, var(--hi), var(--mid) 48%, var(--lo));
  box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--rim), inset 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--rim) 45%, transparent), inset 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-white) 16%, transparent), inset 0 2px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-white) 35%, transparent);
}

.coin svg {
  filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-white) 30%, transparent));
}

.coin[data-side=usd]:after {
  content:"";
  background:linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 38%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--l3-static-white) 38%, transparent) 50%, transparent 62%);
  animation:8s ease-in-out 1.6s infinite sheen;
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  translate:-130%;
}

.shadow {
  background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--mid) 18%, transparent);
  filter:blur(3px);
  border-radius:50%;
  width:38px;
  height:6px;
  margin-left:-8px;
  animation:4.5s ease-in-out 1.15s infinite alternate shadow;
  position:absolute;
  bottom:1px;
  left:50%;
}

@keyframes lead-in {
  0% {
    opacity:0;
    translate:-15px 7px;
    scale:.82;
  }
  35% {
    opacity:1;
  }
}

@keyframes drift {
  0% {
    translate:11px -1px;
  }
  to {
    translate:11px -4px;
  }
}

@keyframes sheen {
  0% {
    translate:-130%;
  }
  16%,to {
    translate:130%;
  }
}

@keyframes shadow {
  to {
    opacity:.7;
    scale:.85;
  }
}

.stage[data-still] :is(.lead,.shadow),.stage[data-still] .coin:after {
  animation:none;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
  .lead,.shadow,.coin[data-side=usd]:after {
    animation:none;
  }
}
```

```tsx
// The warning status bar above the wallet's Deposit / Withdraw buttons ("$100.00 withdrawal pending" …): an L3 Aerobar,
// full width (edge to edge), warning tint.
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Aerobar } from '@l3/components/Aerobar'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { scheduleIcon } from './lib/icons'

export type PendingBannerProps = {
  /** Text with its $ amounts in <Usd layout="inline" /> (a tight banner: no ≈ ₹ line). */
  title: ReactNode
  sub: string
  /** A small Ghost button on the right (Cancel a withdrawal …). */
  action?: { label: string; onClick: () => void }
  /** The whole bar opens more about it (a deposit: why it takes 1–2 days); Aerobar shows a chevron. No `action` with it. */
  onOpen?: () => void
}

export function PendingBanner({ title, sub, action, onOpen }: PendingBannerProps) {
  return (
    <Aerobar
      type="warning"
      icon={<Icon icon={scheduleIcon} />}
      heading={title}
      paragraph={sub}
      action={onOpen ? undefined : action}
      onClick={onOpen}
    />
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/wallet/WalletScreen.tsx`

```tsx
// The wallet screen frame all W* screens share: actionbar with an INR / USD tab switch, the balance card, the screen's own
// content, and the Deposit / Withdraw dock. One page with two views: every wallet screen carries its USD view (the props)
// and the INR view (INR_VIEW below); a screen only picks the tab it opens on. Switching tabs never leaves the page — only
// the body changes (a tap or a swipe). The USD tab always wears its NEW tag.
// FLAG: hand-made pending banner.
// FLAG: layout with raw display:flex + gap/padding (WalletScreen.module.css) instead of L3 Stack/Section/Inset/Grid.
import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Actionbar } from '@l3/components/Actionbar'
import { Aerobar } from '@l3/components/Aerobar'
import { Button } from '@l3/components/Button'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@l3/components/ButtonGroup'
import { Icon } from '@l3/components/Icon'
import { Tabs } from '@l3/components/Tabs'
import { Tag } from '@l3/components/Tag'
import { Phone } from '../../components/Phone'
import { useUsNav } from '../../nav'
import { startAddBank, useLinkedBanks } from '../../../../shared/userStatus'
import { msAccountBalance } from '@l3/icons/material'
import { moneyIds } from '../money/ids'
import { parseUsd, useInrEquivalent, useUsd } from '../../../../shared/money'
import { BalanceCard } from './BalanceCard'
import { FIGMA } from './data'
import { GrowNudge } from './GrowNudge'
import { bigAmount, useBigAmounts } from './lib/bigAmounts'
import { infoIcon } from './lib/icons'
import { neighbour, useSwipeTabs } from './lib/swipeTabs'
import { PendingBanner, type PendingBannerProps } from './PendingBanner'
import { WithdrawableSheet } from './sheets/WithdrawableSheet'
import styles from './WalletScreen.module.css'

// FLAG: experiment switch read from the URL (?link=1|2|3) — three looks for joining the tabs to the balance card.
const linkLook = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('link') ?? undefined

export type WalletTab = 'inr' | 'usd'
const TABS: WalletTab[] = ['inr', 'usd']
/** The deposit flow's "Add bank account" screen (another flow: an app screen id, not a Figma id). */
const ADD_BANK = 'deposit-12'

export type WalletDock = {
  primary: string
  /** Figma id the primary button goes to. */
  primaryTo?: string
  /** `false` hides the Withdraw button. */
  withdraw?: boolean
  withdrawDisabled?: boolean
  withdrawTo?: string
}

export type WalletScreenProps = {
  /** Accessible name of the screen. */
  label?: string
  /** Drawn behind another screen's sheet: static, taps do nothing. */
  backdrop?: boolean
  /** The tab it opens on (default USD). The props describe the USD view; the INR view is INR_VIEW. */
  tab?: WalletTab
  /** The balance as written: "$520.40" (a US wallet, shown in the currency the $ / ₹ switch picks) or "₹1,100.00". */
  total: string
  withdrawable: string
  /** `true`: the "Withdrawable" tap opens the sheet; a Figma id also adds "Full balance details" to it. */
  details?: boolean | string
  /** Unused by the original's component (kept because the screens pass it). */
  tight?: boolean
  children?: ReactNode
  dock?: WalletDock
  /** Figma id the back arrow goes to (default: back). */
  backTo?: string
  /** A sheet this screen shows over itself. */
  sheet?: ReactNode
  /** Marks the body as part of a withdrawal flow (removes the gap above the custodian line). */
  noteFlow?: boolean
  /** The INR view: no custodian line, shows the late-deposit note instead. */
  inr?: boolean
  /** Show the "Grow Wealth in Dollars" nudge. */
  nudge?: boolean
  pending?: PendingBannerProps
}

/** The INR view's data: what every wallet screen shows on its INR tab. */
export const INR_VIEW = {
  inr: true,
  total: '₹1,100.00',
  withdrawable: '₹10.00',
  dock: { primary: 'Deposit', primaryTo: 'deposit-09' } as WalletDock,
  children: undefined,
} as const


export function WalletScreen(props: WalletScreenProps) {
  const { tab = 'usd', backdrop } = props
  const [active, setActive] = useState<WalletTab>(tab)
  const { label, total, withdrawable, details, children, dock, backTo, sheet, noteFlow, inr, nudge, pending } =
    active === 'usd' ? props : { ...props, ...INR_VIEW, nudge: false, details: undefined, sheet: undefined, noteFlow: false, pending: undefined }

  const bigAmounts = useBigAmounts()
  const rawTotal = bigAmounts ? bigAmount(total, 'total') : total
  const rawWithdrawable = bigAmounts ? bigAmount(withdrawable, 'withdrawable') : withdrawable
  // A "$…" amount turns into ₹ when the switch is on ₹; ₹ amounts (the INR wallet) stay as they are.
  const usd = useUsd()
  const localise = (text: string) => {
    const parsed = parseUsd(text)
    return parsed ? usd(parsed.value, parsed.format) : text
  }
  const shownTotal = localise(rawTotal)
  const shownWithdrawable = localise(rawWithdrawable)
  const totalUsd = parseUsd(rawTotal)?.value
  // The USD balance in rupees at the live rate, small under it — only with the "₹ below" setting (off by default);
  // none on a $0 wallet.
  const balanceInr = useInrEquivalent()(totalUsd ?? 0, { decimals: 2 })
  const { go, open, back } = useUsNav()

  const switchTab = (next: WalletTab, animate = false) => {
    if (next === active || backdrop) return
    if (animate) swipe.entered(TABS.indexOf(next) > TABS.indexOf(active) ? 1 : -1)
    setActive(next)
  }

  const swipe = useSwipeTabs({
    canGo: (direction) => !backdrop && !!neighbour(TABS, active, direction),
    onSwitch: (direction) => {
      const next = neighbour(TABS, active, direction)
      if (next) switchTab(next)
    },
    page: active,
  })

  // The "Withdrawable" sheet: open, or closing (stays mounted while it slides away).
  const [detailsState, setDetailsState] = useState<'open' | 'closing' | null>(null)
  const fullDetailsTo = !inr && typeof details === 'string' ? details : undefined
  const detailsSheet = detailsState && (
    <WithdrawableSheet
      open={detailsState === 'open'}
      onClose={() => {
        setDetailsState('closing')
        setTimeout(() => setDetailsState(null), 300)
      }}
      total={rawTotal}
      withdrawable={rawWithdrawable}
      onFullDetails={fullDetailsTo ? () => open(fullDetailsTo) : undefined}
    />
  )

  // Deposit, Withdraw and Add bank open a page on top of the wallet (in from the right; back slides it out right).
  const goTo = (figma?: string) => () => {
    if (figma && !backdrop) open(figma)
  }

  const header = (
    <Actionbar
      className={styles.actionbar}
      onBack={() => (backTo ? go(backTo) : back('5714:64982'))}
      actions={
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className={styles.link}>
          All Transactions
        </Button>
      }
      bottom={
        <div className={styles.switch}>
          <Tabs
            appearance="pill-group"
            width="fill"
            behavior="tabs"
            aria-label="Wallet"
            value={active}
            onChange={(next) => switchTab(next, true)}
            items={[
              { value: 'inr', label: 'INR Wallet' },
              {
                value: 'usd',
                label: 'USD Wallet',
                badge: (
                  <Tag variant="primary" color="discover" size="sm">
                    NEW
                  </Tag>
                ),
              },
            ]}
          />
        </div>
      }
    />
  )

  // No bank linked (User status → Bank accounts: None): money can't come in or go out yet. A bar above the dock asks to
  // add one, Deposit opens add-money in its "no bank" state, Withdraw is off. Money in progress (a deposit or withdrawal
  // banner) means a bank is linked — it came from or goes to one — so then the bar never shows.
  const noBank = useLinkedBanks().length === 0 && dock?.primary === 'Deposit' && !pending
  const depositTo = noBank ? (inr ? 'deposit-10' : moneyIds.noBank) : dock?.primaryTo

  const footer = dock && (
    <>
      {pending && <PendingBanner {...pending} />}
      {noBank && (
        <Aerobar
          placement="inline"
          type="discover"
          icon={<Icon icon={msAccountBalance} />}
          heading="Add a bank account to deposit or withdraw"
          // From the USD tab the bank must be one that can send money abroad; from the INR tab any bank.
          action={{ label: 'Add', onClick: () => { if (!backdrop) startAddBank(inr ? undefined : 'us-stocks-21', { usStocks: !inr }); goTo(ADD_BANK)() } }}
        />
      )}
      <ButtonGroup direction="horizontal" aria-label="Wallet actions" className={styles.dock}>
        {/* Deposit is the brand button; other first actions (Activate US Stocks) stay primary. */}
        <Button variant={dock.primary === 'Deposit' ? 'brand' : 'primary'} size="lg" onClick={goTo(depositTo)}>
          {dock.primary}
        </Button>
        {dock.withdraw !== false && (
          <Button variant="secondary" size="lg" disabled={dock.withdrawDisabled || noBank} onClick={goTo(dock.withdrawTo)}>
            Withdraw
          </Button>
        )}
      </ButtonGroup>
    </>
  )

  return (
    <Phone
      label={label}
      className={[styles.screen, linkLook && styles[`link${linkLook}`]].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}
      bodyRef={swipe.bind}
      statusbar="transparent"
      gesture="default"
      backdropArt={<div className={styles.wash} data-sheet={sheet || detailsState ? '' : undefined} />}
      header={header}
      footer={footer}
      overlay={sheet ?? detailsSheet}
    >
      {/* The whole body (balance card and what's under it) pushes left / right when the wallet switches. */}
      <div className={styles.stack} ref={swipe.contentRef}>
        <BalanceCard
          look="dashed"
          link={linkLook}
          total={shownTotal}
          still={backdrop}
          withdrawable={shownWithdrawable}
          currency={inr ? 'INR' : 'USD'}
          below={!inr && totalUsd && balanceInr ? <span className={styles.balanceInr}>{balanceInr}</span> : undefined}
          onDetails={backdrop ? undefined : () => setDetailsState('open')}
        />
        <div className={`${styles.page} ${styles.body}`} data-flow={noteFlow || undefined}>
          {children}
          {nudge && !inr && <GrowNudge />}
          {!inr && <p className={styles.custodian}>US Stocks wallet · held at ViewTrade IFSC</p>}
          {inr && (
            <p className={styles.foot}>
              <Icon icon={infoIcon} size={14} />
              Deposits after 11 pm reflect after 3 am
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Phone>
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/wallet/WalletScreens.tsx`

```tsx
// The wallet's Figma frames. Each one is the shared WalletScreen with different data.
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useUsNav } from '../../nav'
import { Usd } from '../../../../shared/money'
import { FIGMA, WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTS } from './data'
import { WalletScreen, type WalletDock, type WalletScreenProps, type WalletTab } from './WalletScreen'
import { DepositProgressSheet } from './sheets/DepositProgressSheet'
import { sentDeposit, type SentDeposit } from '../money/handoff'
import { CancelWithdrawalSheet } from './sheets/CancelWithdrawalSheet'
import { WithdrawalRequestsSheet } from './sheets/WithdrawalRequestsSheet'

/** `openOn`: the tab the wallet opens on (INR for W0 · Indian tab); the other tab flips in place. */
type ScreenProps = { backdrop?: boolean; openOn?: WalletTab }

/** Empty USD wallet: $0 and the "Grow Wealth in Dollars" nudge. */
const EMPTY = { total: '$0.00', withdrawable: '$0.00', nudge: true } as const
/** USD wallet mid-withdrawal ("tight" is passed by the original but its component ignores it). */
const WITH_BALANCE = { total: '$520.40', withdrawable: '$317.03', details: true, tight: true } as const
const DEPOSIT_ONLY: WalletDock = { primary: 'Deposit', primaryTo: FIGMA.addMoney, withdrawDisabled: true }

/** W0 · Wallet · US tab · Activate US Stocks. */
export function WalletUsActivateScreen({ backdrop, openOn }: ScreenProps) {
  return (
    <WalletScreen
      label="Wallet, USD, activate US Stocks"
      backdrop={backdrop}
      tab={openOn}
      {...EMPTY}
      dock={{ primary: 'Activate US Stocks', primaryTo: FIGMA.activate, withdraw: false }}
    />
  )
}

/** Wallet · US tab · Lemonn KYC pending: Complete KYC (→ the KYC flow) in place of Activate. Not in Jojo's Figma. */
export function WalletUsKycPendingScreen({ backdrop, openOn }: ScreenProps) {
  return (
    <WalletScreen
      label="Wallet, USD, complete KYC"
      backdrop={backdrop}
      tab={openOn}
      {...EMPTY}
      dock={{ primary: 'Complete KYC', primaryTo: 'kyc-01', withdraw: false }}
    />
  )
}

/** W1 · Wallet · US tab · $0 balance. */
export function WalletZeroBalanceScreen({ backdrop, openOn }: ScreenProps) {
  return <WalletScreen label="Wallet, USD, zero balance" backdrop={backdrop} tab={openOn} {...EMPTY} details dock={DEPOSIT_ONLY} />
}

// FLAG: the three activation-state wallet frames (under review / failed / contact support) all render the zero-balance wallet.
export function WalletUnderReviewScreen({ backdrop, openOn }: ScreenProps) {
  return <WalletZeroBalanceScreen backdrop={backdrop} openOn={openOn} />
}
export function WalletActivationFailedScreen({ backdrop, openOn }: ScreenProps) {
  return <WalletZeroBalanceScreen backdrop={backdrop} openOn={openOn} />
}
export function WalletContactSupportScreen({ backdrop, openOn }: ScreenProps) {
  return <WalletZeroBalanceScreen backdrop={backdrop} openOn={openOn} />
}

/** W2 · Wallet · US tab · Funded. */
export function WalletFundedScreen({ backdrop, openOn }: ScreenProps) {
  return (
    <WalletScreen
      label="Wallet, USD, funded"
      backdrop={backdrop}
      tab={openOn}
      total="$520.40"
      withdrawable="$417.03"
      details={FIGMA.balanceDetails}
      dock={{ primary: 'Deposit', primaryTo: FIGMA.addMoney, withdrawTo: FIGMA.withdraw }}
    />
  )
}

/** The deposit shown when the wallet is opened straight from the list (nothing was paid in this visit). */
const SAMPLE_DEPOSIT: SentDeposit = { usd: 1035.37, inr: '₹91,320', bank: 'HDFC Bank ••7821' }

/**
 * Wallet · US tab · Add money transfer in progress. `sent`: just back from the bank's page (us-stocks-93) — the sheet
 * opens at once to say the money is on its way and when it lands; "Got it" leaves the wallet with its pending banner.
 */
export function WalletTransferInProgressScreen({ backdrop, openOn, sent }: ScreenProps & { sent?: boolean }) {
  const deposit = sentDeposit(SAMPLE_DEPOSIT)
  // Tapping the banner explains the wait: Paid → Sent to US → Ready, and why it takes 1–2 working days.
  const [explaining, setExplaining] = useState(!!sent && !backdrop)
  return (
    <WalletScreen
      label="Wallet, USD, transfer in progress"
      backdrop={backdrop}
      tab={openOn}
      {...WITH_BALANCE}
      total="$0"
      withdrawable="$0.00"
      backTo="stocks-01"
      dock={DEPOSIT_ONLY}
      pending={{ title: <><Usd value={deposit.usd} layout="inline" /> deposit in progress</>, sub: 'Arrives in your wallet by Thu 8 PM (or Fri)', onOpen: () => !backdrop && setExplaining(true) }}
      sheet={explaining && <DepositProgressSheet deposit={deposit} eta="by Thu 8 PM" sent={sent} onClose={() => setExplaining(false)} />}
    />
  )
}

/** Back from the bank's page: the in-progress wallet with the "money sent" sheet open (not in Figma). */
export function WalletMoneySentScreen(props: ScreenProps) {
  return <WalletTransferInProgressScreen {...props} sent />
}

/** W3 · Withdrawing · in progress (Cancel asks to confirm, then the banner goes). */
export function WalletWithdrawalInProgressScreen({ backdrop, openOn }: ScreenProps) {
  const [asking, setAsking] = useState(false)
  const [cancelled, setCancelled] = useState(false)
  return (
    <WalletScreen
      label="Wallet, USD, withdrawal in progress"
      backdrop={backdrop}
      tab={openOn}
      {...WITH_BALANCE}
      dock={DEPOSIT_ONLY}
      pending={
        cancelled
          ? undefined
          : {
              title: <><Usd value={100} layout="inline" /> withdrawal pending</>,
              sub: 'Processed by 11 AM next day',
              action: { label: 'Cancel', onClick: () => !backdrop && setAsking(true) },
            }
      }
      sheet={
        asking ? (
          <CancelWithdrawalSheet
            amount={100}
            onNo={() => setAsking(false)}
            onYes={() => {
              setAsking(false)
              setCancelled(true)
            }}
          />
        ) : undefined
      }
    />
  )
}

/** W3 · Withdrawing · sent to bank. */
export function WalletWithdrawalSentScreen({ backdrop, openOn }: ScreenProps) {
  return (
    <WalletScreen
      label="Wallet, USD, withdrawal sent to bank"
      backdrop={backdrop}
      tab={openOn}
      {...WITH_BALANCE}
      dock={DEPOSIT_ONLY}
      pending={{ title: <><Usd value={100} layout="inline" /> withdrawal sent to bank</>, sub: 'Credited to HDFC Bank by Wed' }}
    />
  )
}

/** W3 · Withdrawal credited. */
export function WalletWithdrawalCreditedScreen({ backdrop, openOn }: ScreenProps) {
  return <WalletScreen label="Wallet, USD, withdrawal credited" backdrop={backdrop} tab={openOn} {...WITH_BALANCE} dock={DEPOSIT_ONLY} />
}

/** W3b · 2 withdrawals pending (View opens the requests sheet). `sheet` is set by the W3c frame. */
export function WalletTwoWithdrawalsScreen({ backdrop, openOn, sheet }: ScreenProps & { sheet?: WalletScreenProps['sheet'] }) {
  const { go } = useUsNav()
  return (
    <WalletScreen
      label="Wallet, USD, two withdrawals pending"
      backdrop={backdrop}
      tab={openOn}
      {...WITH_BALANCE}
      dock={DEPOSIT_ONLY}
      sheet={sheet}
      pending={{
        title: <><Usd value={WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTS.reduce((sum, request) => sum + request.amount, 0)} layout="inline" /> Total withdrawal pending</>,
        sub: 'Processed by 11 AM next day',
        action: { label: 'View', onClick: () => !backdrop && !sheet && go(FIGMA.withdrawalRequests) },
      }}
    />
  )
}

/** W3c · Withdrawal requests sheet over the two-withdrawals wallet. */
export function WalletWithdrawalRequestsScreen({ backdrop, openOn }: ScreenProps) {
  return <WalletTwoWithdrawalsScreen backdrop={backdrop} sheet={backdrop ? undefined : <WithdrawalRequestsSheet />} />
}

/** W3d · Withdrawal taking longer. */
export function WalletWithdrawalDelayedScreen({ backdrop, openOn }: ScreenProps) {
  return (
    <WalletScreen
      label="Wallet, USD, withdrawal taking longer"
      backdrop={backdrop}
      tab={openOn}
      {...WITH_BALANCE}
      dock={DEPOSIT_ONLY}
      pending={{ title: <><Usd value={100} layout="inline" /> withdrawal pending</>, sub: 'Taking longer than usual, we’re on it' }}
    />
  )
}
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/wallet/index.tsx`

```tsx
// USD wallet (W0–W3d): the wallet in every state (INR tab, US tab before/after activation, funded, withdrawals in flight)
// plus Balance Details. Screens are keyed by Figma node id.
// FLAG: all UI copy is hard-coded in the components — copy not in copy.json yet.
// FLAG: the wallet redraws the app's own wallet/portfolio money screens (duplicates the app's wallet flow) with a hand-made
//       balance card, tab switch and pending banner.
import { useUsJourney } from '../../../../shared/userStatus'
import type { UsScreenMap } from '../types'
import { BalanceDetails } from './BalanceDetails'
import {
  WalletActivationFailedScreen,
  WalletContactSupportScreen,
  WalletFundedScreen,
  WalletTransferInProgressScreen,
  WalletMoneySentScreen,
  WalletTwoWithdrawalsScreen,
  WalletUnderReviewScreen,
  WalletUsKycPendingScreen,
  WalletUsActivateScreen,
  WalletWithdrawalCreditedScreen,
  WalletWithdrawalDelayedScreen,
  WalletWithdrawalInProgressScreen,
  WalletWithdrawalRequestsScreen,
  WalletWithdrawalSentScreen,
  WalletZeroBalanceScreen,
} from './WalletScreens'

/**
 * The wallet's US tab in the user status picked in the prototype settings (src/shared/userStatus): not activated (or KYC
 * pending) → Activate US Stocks; under review / contact support / failed; activated → $0, money on the way, or funded.
 */
function WalletUsForStatus(props: { backdrop?: boolean; openOn?: 'inr' | 'usd' }) {
  switch (useUsJourney()) {
    case 'kyc': return <WalletUsKycPendingScreen {...props} />
    case 'review': return <WalletUnderReviewScreen {...props} />
    case 'support': return <WalletContactSupportScreen {...props} />
    case 'failed': return <WalletActivationFailedScreen {...props} />
    case 'activated': return <WalletZeroBalanceScreen {...props} />
    case 'onTheWay': return <WalletTransferInProgressScreen {...props} />
    case 'ready':
    case 'holding': return <WalletFundedScreen {...props} />
    default: return <WalletUsActivateScreen {...props} />
  }
}

/** Screens of this part, by Figma node id. The US tab's "Activate" frame is the one US tab that follows the user status. */
export const screens: UsScreenMap = {
  // W0 · Indian tab: the same wallet page, opened on INR; its USD tab is the one the user status picks.
  '5852:99084': (props) => <WalletUsForStatus {...props} openOn="inr" />,
  '5852:99057': WalletUsForStatus,
```

### `src/flows/us-stocks/screens/wallet/lib/bigAmounts.ts`

```ts
// "Big amounts" test switch: a preview toggle that swaps the sample balances for very large numbers to check the layout.
// DUPLICATE: from entry (the teammate's shared `_` / `y` helpers).
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

const STORAGE_KEY = 'us-happy-flow:big-amounts'
const EVENT = 'big-amounts'

function read(): boolean {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) === '1'
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

export function setBigAmounts(on: boolean) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, on ? '1' : '0')
  } catch {
    /* storage blocked */
  }
  dispatchEvent(new Event(EVENT))
}

/** true while the "big amounts" switch is on (re-renders when it flips). */
export function useBigAmounts(): boolean {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(read)
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => setOn(read())
    addEventListener(EVENT, update)
    return () => removeEventListener(EVENT, update)
  }, [])
  return on
}

const isZero = (value: string) => !/[1-9]/.test(value)

/** The big sample amount that replaces `value` while the switch is on (zero balances stay zero). */
export function bigAmount(value: string, kind: 'total' | 'withdrawable'): string {
  if (isZero(value)) return value
  if (value.includes('₹')) return kind === 'total' ? '₹1,23,45,67,890.50' : '₹8,40,12,000.00'
  if (value.includes('$')) return kind === 'total' ? '$123,456,789.90' : '$9,876,543.21'
  return value
}
```
